'use strict';

/**
 * StreamVerse Studios — Directorial Orchestrator
 *
 * The single deterministic bridge between authored story state and downstream
 * production modules.
 */

const directorState = require('./directorState');
const blockingDirector = require('./blockingDirector');
const dialogueDirector = require('./dialogueDirector');
const travel = require('./travelChoreography');
const editorial = require('./editorialDirector');
const audio = require('./audioContinuity');

function clean(value) {
  return directorState.clean(value);
}

function sceneFor(scenes, sceneNumber) {
  return (scenes || []).find(s => Number(s.scene_number) === Number(sceneNumber)) || {};
}

function applyToShotSimulation(shotSimulation, scenes = [], episode = {}) {
  if (!shotSimulation || !Array.isArray(shotSimulation.shots)) return shotSimulation;

  const grouped = new Map();
  for (const shot of shotSimulation.shots) {
    const n = Number(shot.scene_number);
    if (!grouped.has(n)) grouped.set(n, []);
    grouped.get(n).push(shot);
  }

  const final = [];
  let priorShot = null;

  for (const scene of scenes) {
    const n = Number(scene.scene_number);
    let shots = (grouped.get(n) || []).slice().sort((a,b) => Number(a.shot_index) - Number(b.shot_index));
    if (!shots.length) continue;

    const raw = scene.location_transition && String(scene.location_transition).toLowerCase() !== 'none'
      ? scene.location_transition
      : '';
    const previousLocation = clean(priorShot?._director_state?.world?.location);
    const destination = clean(
      scene.destination_location ||
      shots[shots.length - 1].destination_location ||
      scene.location
    );
    const origin = clean(
      scene.origin_location ||
      shots[0].origin_location ||
      previousLocation ||
      scene.location
    );
    const mode = clean(scene.travel_mode || shots.find(s => s.travel_mode)?.travel_mode || 'none');

    const isTravel = (origin && destination && origin.toLowerCase() !== destination.toLowerCase())
      && (Boolean(raw) || mode !== 'none' || Boolean(scene.location_transition));

    if (isTravel) {
      shots = travel.enrichTravelSequence(shots, {
        originLocation: origin,
        destinationLocation: destination,
        travelMode: mode,
      });
    }

    const normalized = directorState.normalizeSequence(shots, {
      scene,
      episode,
      previousState: priorShot?._director_state || null,
    }).map((shot) => {
      const solved = blockingDirector.solveBlocking(shot, priorShot);
      const rebuilt = directorState.attachDirectorState(solved, {
        scene,
        episode,
        previousState: priorShot?._director_state || null,
      });
      rebuilt._conversation_plan = dialogueDirector.buildConversationPlan(rebuilt);
      return rebuilt;
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
      const shot = normalized[i];
      if (i > 0) {
        const repaired = travel.repairTravelTeleport(normalized[i - 1], shot);
        normalized[i] = directorState.attachDirectorState(repaired, {
          scene,
          episode,
          previousState: normalized[i - 1]._director_state || null,
        });
      }
      final.push(normalized[i]);
      priorShot = normalized[i];
    }
  }

  return {
    ...shotSimulation,
    shots: final,
    directorial_state_version: 2,
  };
}

function applyToScript(script, { seasonNumber = null, episodeNumber = null } = {}) {
  if (!script || !Array.isArray(script.scenes)) return script;

  let previousShot = null;
  let previousLocation = '';

  for (const scene of script.scenes) {
    let shots = Array.isArray(scene.shots) ? scene.shots.slice() : [];
    const destination = clean(scene.location);
    const origin = previousLocation || destination;

    const sceneSaysTravel = String(scene.location_transition || '').toLowerCase() !== 'none';
    const mode = clean(scene.travel_mode || shots.find(s => s.travel_mode)?.travel_mode || 'none');
    const actualTravel = origin && destination && origin.toLowerCase() !== destination.toLowerCase();

    if (actualTravel || sceneSaysTravel) {
      shots = travel.enrichTravelSequence(shots, {
        originLocation: origin,
        destinationLocation: destination,
        travelMode: mode,
      });
    }

    const normalized = directorState.normalizeSequence(shots, {
      scene,
      episode: {
        season: Number(seasonNumber || script.season_number || 0),
        episode: Number(episodeNumber || script.episode_number || 0),
      },
      previousState: previousShot?._director_state || null,
    });

    const solved = [];
    for (const raw of normalized) {
      let shot = blockingDirector.solveBlocking(raw, solved[solved.length - 1] || previousShot);
      shot = travel.repairTravelTeleport(previousShot || solved[solved.length - 1], shot);
      shot = directorState.attachDirectorState(shot, {
        scene,
        episode: {
          season: Number(seasonNumber || script.season_number || 0),
          episode: Number(episodeNumber || script.episode_number || 0),
        },
        previousState: previousShot?._director_state || solved[solved.length - 1]?._director_state || null,
      });
      shot._conversation_plan = dialogueDirector.buildConversationPlan(shot);
      solved.push(shot);
      previousShot = shot;
    }

    scene.shots = solved;
    previousLocation = destination || previousLocation;
  }

  dialogueDirector.applyConversationDirector(script);
  editorial.applyEditorialContinuity(script);
  audio.applyAudioContinuity(script);
  script.directorial_state_version = 2;
  script.directorial_architecture = {
    source: 'canonical_movie_state',
    layers: ['world', 'blocking', 'performance', 'camera', 'travel', 'editorial', 'audio'],
    no_teleportation: true,
    provider_prompts_render_from_state: true,
  };

  return script;
}

module.exports = {
  applyToShotSimulation,
  applyToScript,
};

'use strict';
/**
 * Discord Webhook — delivers completed episodes to the configured server channel.
 *
 * WEBHOOK_URL : full webhook URL from Discord channel settings.
 *               Also accepts DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL as a fallback alias.
 *
 * Each completed episode is posted as a rich embed containing:
 *   - Episode title
 *   - Caption + hashtags (as generated by the director AI)
 *   - The actual video file as an attachment (downloaded from Cloudinary first)
 */
const axios      = require('axios');
const FormData   = require('form-data');
const config     = require('./config');

/**
 * Post a completed episode to the Discord webhook, downloading the video first
 * so Discord receives the actual file instead of a link.
 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * @param {string} opts.videoUrl   Cloudinary URL of the final compiled episode
 * @param {string} opts.title      Full episode title (Show — S01E01 — Episode Name)
 * @param {string} opts.caption    AI-generated caption / post copy
 * @param {string} opts.hashtags   Hashtag string to post alongside the caption
 * @returns {string|null}          videoUrl on success, null if webhook not configured
 */
async function postEpisode({ videoUrl, title, caption, hashtags }) {
  const webhookUrl = config.discordWebhookUrl;
  if (!webhookUrl) {
    console.warn('[Discord] WEBHOOK_URL not configured — skipping Discord post');
    return null;
  }

  const captionBody  = (caption   || '').slice(0, 3800);
  const hashtagBody  = (hashtags  || '').slice(0, 200);
  const description  = [captionBody, hashtagBody].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

  // Download the video from Cloudinary so we can attach the actual file.
  // Discord webhook file uploads are capped (10MB standard / 50MB with a Level 2
  // server boost — see config.discordMaxUploadBytes). If the file is over that
  // limit, or the download fails, we skip the attachment and fall back to a
  // link embed instead — that still counts as a successful post so the job
  // completes and the pipeline moves on to the next episode.
  const maxUploadBytes = config.discordMaxUploadBytes;
  let videoBuffer = null;
  let fileName = `episode_${Date.now()}.mp4`;
  let skipReason = null;

  try {
    // HEAD first so an oversized file is never fully downloaded into memory
    // just to be thrown away.
    const headResp = await axios.head(videoUrl, { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => null);
    const declaredLength = parseInt(headResp?.headers?.['content-length'] || '', 10);

    if (Number.isFinite(declaredLength) && declaredLength > maxUploadBytes) {
      skipReason = `video is ${(declaredLength / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB, ` +
        `over the ${(maxUploadBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(0)}MB Discord upload limit`;
    } else {
      const dlResp = await axios.get(videoUrl, { responseType: 'arraybuffer', timeout: 180000 });
      const buf = Buffer.from(dlResp.data);

      if (buf.length > maxUploadBytes) {
        skipReason = `video is ${(buf.length / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB, ` +
          `over the ${(maxUploadBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(0)}MB Discord upload limit`;
      } else {
        videoBuffer = buf;
        // Try to extract a filename from the URL path
        const urlPath = new URL(videoUrl).pathname;
        const lastSeg = urlPath.split('/').pop();
        if (lastSeg && lastSeg.includes('.')) fileName = lastSeg;
        console.log(`[Discord] Downloaded video for attachment: ${videoBuffer.length} bytes`);
      }
    }
  } catch (dlErr) {
    skipReason = `download failed: ${dlErr.message}`;
  }

  if (skipReason) {
    console.warn(`[Discord] Skipping file attachment — falling back to link embed (${skipReason})`);
  }

  const payload = {
    embeds: [
      {
        title:       title.slice(0, 256),
        description: description || '*No caption generated.*',
        color:       0x7B2FBE,
        fields: videoBuffer
          ? []
          : [{ name: '📺 Watch / Download', value: videoUrl.slice(0, 1024), inline: false }],
        footer:    { text: 'StreamVerse Studios' },
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    ],
  };

  try {
    if (videoBuffer) {
      // Send the video as a file attachment via multipart form data.
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('payload_json', JSON.stringify(payload));
      form.append('file', videoBuffer, { filename: fileName, contentType: 'video/mp4' });

      const resp = await axios.post(webhookUrl, form, {
        headers: { ...form.getHeaders() },
        timeout: 30000,
      });
      console.log(`[Discord] Episode posted with video attachment (HTTP ${resp.status}): ${title}`);
    } else {
      // Fallback: just send the embed with the link
      const resp = await axios.post(webhookUrl, payload, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        timeout: 20000,
      });
      console.log(`[Discord] Episode posted with link (HTTP ${resp.status}): ${title}`);
    }
    return videoUrl;
  } catch (err) {
    const detail = err.response?.data ? JSON.stringify(err.response.data).slice(0, 300) : err.message;
    throw new Error(`[Discord] Webhook post failed: ${detail}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Send a plain-text announcement to the Discord webhook (series premiere, finale, etc.)
 *
 * @param {string} message  Plain text — kept under Discord's 2000-char content limit.
 */
async function postAnnouncement(message) {
  const webhookUrl = config.discordWebhookUrl;
  if (!webhookUrl) {
    console.warn('[Discord] WEBHOOK_URL not configured — skipping announcement');
    return;
  }
  try {
    await axios.post(
      webhookUrl,
      { content: String(message).slice(0, 2000) },
      { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, timeout: 10000 }
    );
    console.log('[Discord] Announcement sent');
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Discord] Announcement failed:', err.message);
  }
}

module.exports = { postEpisode, postAnnouncement };

'use strict';

/**
 * StreamVerse Studios — Editorial Continuity Director
 *
 * Makes the reason for the cut explicit. FFmpeg still performs only the
 * provider-approved basic assembly; this module supplies narrative continuity
 * metadata to the scene/shot compiler.
 */

const { clean } = require('./directorState');

function chooseTransition(prevShot, shot) {
  if (!prevShot) return {
    type: 'opening',
    reason: 'establish the scene geography and dramatic state',
  };

  const prevEnd = clean(prevShot.end_frame_state || prevShot.end_state || prevShot.handoff_to_next);
  const currentStart = clean(shot.start_frame_state || shot.start_state);
  const sameLocation =
    clean(prevShot._director_state?.world?.location).toLowerCase() ===
    clean(shot._director_state?.world?.location).toLowerCase();

  if (clean(shot.travel_stage).toLowerCase() === 'arrive') {
    return {
      type: 'arrival_match',
      reason: 'complete the physical journey before handing control to the destination scene',
    };
  }

  if (clean(shot.travel_stage).toLowerCase() === 'in_transit') {
    return {
      type: 'action_match',
      reason: 'continue the same physical journey from the previous terminal travel state',
    };
  }

  if (prevShot.speaker && shot.speaker && clean(prevShot.speaker) !== clean(shot.speaker)) {
    return {
      type: 'eyeline_cut',
      reason: 'transfer audience attention through the established conversation and listener reaction',
    };
  }

  if (sameLocation && /\b(hand|reach|open|close|turn|stand|sit|walk|move)\b/i.test(currentStart)) {
    return {
      type: 'match_on_action',
      reason: 'preserve continuous physical action across the cut',
    };
  }

  if (!sameLocation) {
    return {
      type: 'spatial_reveal',
      reason: 're-establish the new geography only after the causal transition is complete',
    };
  }

  return {
    type: 'causal_cut',
    reason: clean(prevEnd || currentStart) || 'advance the dramatic beat while retaining continuity',
  };
}

function applyEditorialContinuity(script) {
  if (!script || !Array.isArray(script.scenes)) return script;
  let previous = null;

  for (const scene of script.scenes) {
    for (const shot of scene.shots || []) {
      const transition = chooseTransition(previous, shot);
      shot.editorial_transition = transition.type;
      shot.editorial_transition_reason = transition.reason;
      shot._transition_state = {
        ...shot._transition_state,
        type: transition.type,
        editorial_reason: transition.reason,
        from_state: previous ? clean(previous.end_state || previous.handoff_to_next) : '',
        to_state: clean(shot.start_state || shot.start_frame_state),
      };
      previous = shot;
    }
  }
  return script;
}

module.exports = { chooseTransition, applyEditorialContinuity };

'use strict';

/**
 * Episode-level character reconciliation.
 *
 * The series cast is authoritative for recurring characters, but an episode
 * may introduce a legitimate supporting/background speaking character that
 * was not part of the original cast bible. Those names must become real DB
 * characters before still/video generation so the normal identity pipeline can
 * generate anchors, reference portraits, voice data and stable seeds.
 */

function _norm(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[“”’']/g, '')
    .replace(/\b(?:dr|mr|mrs|ms|prof|sir|lady)\b\.?\s*/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function _matches(a, b) {
  const left = _norm(a);
  const right = _norm(b);
  if (!left || !right) return false;
  if (left === right || left.includes(right) || right.includes(left)) return true;

  const leftTokens = new Set(left.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
  const rightTokens = new Set(right.split(' ').filter(Boolean));
  for (const token of leftTokens) {
    if (token.length >= 3 && rightTokens.has(token)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function _speakerNames(dialogue) {
  const text = String(dialogue || '');
  const pattern = /([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.'’-]*(?:\s+[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.'’-]*){0,4})\s*:\s+/g;
  const names = [];
  let match;
  while ((match = pattern.exec(text))) {
    const raw = String(match[1] || '').trim();
    const lower = raw.toLowerCase();
    if (/^(note|cut to|fade|smash cut|int|ext|scene|action)$/.test(lower)) continue;
    if (!names.some(name => _matches(name, raw))) names.push(raw);
  }
  return names;
}

async function reconcileMissingEpisodeCharacters({
  storyline,
  episodeScript,
  characterList,
  insertCharactersWithConsistency,
  getCharacters,
}) {
  if (!storyline?.id || !episodeScript || !Array.isArray(characterList)) return characterList;
  if (typeof insertCharactersWithConsistency !== 'function' || typeof getCharacters !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('[CharRecovery] Canonical character persistence functions are unavailable.');
  }

  const requested = new Map();
  const addRequested = (rawName, context = '') => {
    const name = String(rawName || '').trim();
    const key = _norm(name);
    if (!name || !key) return;
    let entry = requested.get(key);
    if (!entry) {
      entry = { name, contexts: [] };
      requested.set(key, entry);
    }
    if (context) entry.contexts.push(context);
  };

  for (const scene of episodeScript.scenes || []) {
    const sceneContext = [
      scene.location,
      scene.scene_description,
      scene.visual_description,
      scene.emotional_beat,
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

    for (const name of scene.characters_present || []) addRequested(name, sceneContext);

    for (const shot of scene.shots || []) {
      const shotContext = [
        sceneContext,
        shot.shot_description,
        shot.image_prompt,
        shot.dialogue_or_action,
        shot.emotional_subtext,
        shot.character_positions,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

      for (const name of shot.characters_in_shot || []) addRequested(name, shotContext);
      for (const name of shot.speakers_in_shot || []) addRequested(name, shotContext);
      if (shot.speaker_name) addRequested(shot.speaker_name, shotContext);
      for (const name of _speakerNames(shot.dialogue_or_action)) addRequested(name, shotContext);
    }
  }

  const missing = [];
  for (const entry of requested.values()) {
    const exists = characterList.some(character => _matches(entry.name, character?.name));
    if (!exists) missing.push(entry);
  }

  if (!missing.length) return characterList;

  console.warn(
    `[CharRecovery] Missing episode character(s): ${missing.map(item => item.name).join(', ')} — creating canonical character records before media generation.`
  );

  const newCharacters = missing.map(entry => {
    const context = [...new Set(entry.contexts.filter(Boolean))].join(' | ').slice(0, 2500);
    return {
      name: entry.name,
      role: 'episode_supporting_character',
      description: [
        `${entry.name} is a supporting on-screen character introduced by the locked episode script.`,
        context ? `Episode production context: ${context}` : 'Use the role/name context to establish a coherent fictional casting identity.',
      ].join(' '),
      visual_profile: {},
    };
  });

  await insertCharactersWithConsistency(storyline.id, newCharacters);

  const refreshed = await getCharacters(storyline.id);
  characterList.length = 0;
  characterList.push(...refreshed);

  for (const entry of missing) {
    const created = refreshed.find(character => _matches(entry.name, character?.name));
    console.log(
      `[CharRecovery] ${entry.name}: ${created?.reference_image_url ? 'canonical reference portrait ready' : 'DB character created; reference portrait unavailable'}`
    );
  }

  return characterList;
}

module.exports = { reconcileMissingEpisodeCharacters };

'use strict';
/**
 * FFmpeg assembly of APPROVED shots into the master.
 *
 *  - Stream-copy concat whenever every clip shares the same codec parameters (fast, lossless).
 *  - Only clips that differ (size/fps/pix_fmt/audio layout, or missing audio) are normalised.
 *  - Scene boundaries get a short dip-to-black by re-encoding ONLY the two edge clips.
 *  - The concat intermediate is MPEG-TS (in-band SPS/PPS), so mixing a normalised/faded clip with
 *    copied ones cannot break decoders; the mandatory branding pass then produces the final MP4.
 *  - Optional music bed / loudness normalisation touch audio only (video is copied).
 *  - EVERY master is branded (StreamVerse Studio logo + name) — assembly refuses to skip it unless
 *    BRAND_ENABLED=false is set explicitly (and QC then fails the branding check).
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { run, ffmpegBin, probe, brandMasterFile, settings } = require('../branding');
const { ensureDir, sha256File } = require('./util');
const frames = require('./frames');

const sigOf = (i) => [i.width, i.height, i.fps, i.videoCodec, i.profile, i.pixFmt, i.audioCodec, i.audioSamples, i.channels].join('|');
const most = (arr) => { const m = new Map(); arr.forEach(a => m.set(a, (m.get(a) || 0) + 1)); return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0]; };

async function normalizeClip(src, dst, ref) {
  const info = await probe(src);
  const args = ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', src];
  if (!info.hasAudio) args.push('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `anullsrc=r=${ref.audioSamples || 44100}:cl=${(ref.channels || 2) === 1 ? 'mono' : 'stereo'}`);
  args.push('-vf', `scale=${ref.width}:${ref.height}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=${ref.width}:${ref.height}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1,fps=${ref.fps},format=${ref.pixFmt || 'yuv420p'}`,
    '-af', `aresample=${ref.audioSamples || 44100}`, '-ac', String(ref.channels || 2),
    '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'veryfast', '-crf', '17', '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '192k');
  if (!info.hasAudio) args.push('-map', '0:v:0', '-map', '1:a:0', '-shortest');
  args.push(dst);
  await run(ffmpegBin(), args, { timeoutMs: 20 * 60 * 1000 }); return dst;
}

async function fadeClip(src, dst, { fadeIn, fadeOut, dur = 0.35 }, ref) {
  const info = await probe(src); const vf = [], af = [];
  if (fadeIn) { vf.push(`fade=t=in:st=0:d=${dur}`); af.push(`afade=t=in:st=0:d=${dur}`); }
  if (fadeOut) { const st = Math.max(0, info.duration - dur); vf.push(`fade=t=out:st=${st.toFixed(3)}:d=${dur}`); af.push(`afade=t=out:st=${st.toFixed(3)}:d=${dur}`); }
  const args = ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', src, '-vf', vf.join(','), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'veryfast', '-crf', '17', '-pix_fmt', ref.pixFmt || 'yuv420p'];
  if (info.hasAudio) args.push('-af', af.join(','), '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '192k'); else args.push('-an');
  args.push(dst); await run(ffmpegBin(), args, { timeoutMs: 20 * 60 * 1000 }); return dst;
}

/**
 * @param orch FilmOrchestrator (only reads plan + approved files)
 * @returns {{raw:string, master:string, report:object}}
 */
async function assembleMaster(orch, { outDir, sceneFades = true, music = null, normalizeLoudness = false, brandCfg = settings() } = {}) {
  const { shots, scenes } = orch.plan();
  ensureDir(outDir); const work = ensureDir(path.join(outDir, 'work'));
  const clips = shots.map(s => { const a = orch.store.getApproved(s.shot_id); if (!a) throw new Error(`cannot assemble: ${s.shot_id} has no approved output`); return { shot: s, file: a.video }; });
  const infos = await Promise.all(clips.map(c => probe(c.file)));
  const ref = infos.find(i => sigOf(i) === most(infos.filter(i => i.hasAudio).map(sigOf))) || infos[0];
  const report = { shots: shots.map(s => s.shot_id), normalized: [], faded: [], concat: 'stream_copy', per_shot_duration: infos.map(i => i.duration) };

  // 1) normalise only what differs
  for (let i = 0; i < clips.length; i++) {
    if (sigOf(infos[i]) !== sigOf(ref) || !infos[i].hasAudio) {
      const dst = path.join(work, `norm_${i}.mp4`); await normalizeClip(clips[i].file, dst, ref); clips[i].file = dst; report.normalized.push(clips[i].shot.shot_id); report.concat = 'mixed';
    }
  }
  // 2) dip-to-black at scene boundaries: only the two edge clips are re-encoded
  if (sceneFades) {
    const fadeOut = new Set(), fadeIn = new Set();
    clips.forEach((c, i) => { if (i > 0 && c.shot.opening_transition.type === 'scene_boundary') { fadeIn.add(i); fadeOut.add(i - 1); } });
    const edge = new Set([...fadeIn, ...fadeOut]);
    for (const i of edge) { const dst = path.join(work, `fade_${i}.mp4`); await fadeClip(clips[i].file, dst, { fadeIn: fadeIn.has(i), fadeOut: fadeOut.has(i) }, ref); clips[i].file = dst; report.faded.push(clips[i].shot.shot_id); }
    if (edge.size) report.concat = 'mixed';
  }
  // 3) concat -> MPEG-TS (stream copy)
  const list = path.join(work, 'concat.txt');
  fs.writeFileSync(list, clips.map(c => `file '${c.file.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`).join('\n'));
  let raw = path.join(work, 'concat.ts');
  await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', list, '-c', 'copy', '-f', 'mpegts', raw], { timeoutMs: 30 * 60 * 1000 });
  // 4) optional audio-only processing (video copied)
  if (music || normalizeLoudness) {
    const out = path.join(work, 'audio_mix.ts'); const a = ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', raw];
    let filter;
    if (music) { a.push('-stream_loop', '-1', '-i', music.path); filter = `[1:a]volume=${music.gain ?? 0.18}[m];[0:a][m]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=0,volume=2${normalizeLoudness ? ',loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11' : ''}[a]`; a.push('-filter_complex', filter, '-map', '0:v', '-map', '[a]'); }
    else a.push('-af', 'loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11', '-map', '0:v', '-map', '0:a');
    a.push('-c:v', 'copy', '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '192k', '-f', 'mpegts', out);
    await run(ffmpegBin(), a, { timeoutMs: 30 * 60 * 1000 }); raw = out; report.audio_processing = { music: !!music, loudnorm: normalizeLoudness };
  }
  const rawInfo = await frames.verifyDecodable(raw);
  const expected = infos.reduce((t, i) => t + i.duration, 0);
  report.raw = { duration: rawInfo.duration, expected_sum: expected, drift: rawInfo.duration - expected };
  // 5) MANDATORY branding -> final MP4
  const master = path.join(outDir, 'master.mp4');
  if (!brandCfg.enabled) throw new Error('BRAND_ENABLED=false: refusing to produce a master without StreamVerse branding');
  const b = await brandMasterFile({ inputPath: raw, outputPath: master, cfg: brandCfg });
  report.branding = { applied: b.applied, logoDiff: b.logoDiff, layout: b.layout, audioMode: b.audioMode, elapsedMs: b.elapsedMs };
  report.master = { ...b.output, sha256: sha256File(master) };
  return { raw, master, report };
}

module.exports = { assembleMaster, normalizeClip, fadeClip, sigOf };

'use strict';
/**
 * Continuity ledger — lightweight structured state, NOT a world simulation.
 * One immutable snapshot per shot; each beat may declare deliberate changes
 * (wardrobe, injuries, prop movement, known info...). Nothing else changes silently.
 */
const { deepClone } = require('./util');

function initialLedger(bible, ids) {
  const st = { characters: {}, environment: {}, props: {}, camera: { position: null, orientation: null, movement: 'static', framing: 'medium' },
    story: { scene_id: null, objective: null, known_info: [], recent_event: null, unresolved_conflict: bible.mystery && bible.mystery.question, threat_level: 0 },
    audio: { speaker: null, dialogue_state: 'none', ambient: null, music: 'none', sound_bridge: null }, lighting: { look: null } };
  for (const c of bible.characters) st.characters[c.key] = { character_id: ids.characters[c.key], wardrobe: c.canonical.wardrobe_default, injuries: [], position: null, facing: null, emotion: 'neutral', action: null, holding: [] };
  for (const p of bible.props || []) st.props[p.key] = { prop_id: ids.props[p.key], owner: null, location: null, held: false, open: false, damaged: false, present: false };
  return st;
}

/** state_before + a beat/shot -> state_after (pure). */
function applyShot(before, shot, scene) {
  const s = deepClone(before);
  if (scene && s.environment.location_id !== scene.location_id) {
    s.environment = { location_id: scene.location_id, time_of_day: scene.time_of_day, weather: scene.weather || 'clear', lighting: scene.lighting || `${scene.time_of_day} light`, condition: 'intact' };
  } else if (scene) { s.environment.time_of_day = scene.time_of_day; }
  s.story.scene_id = shot.scene_id;
  const ch = (shot.state_changes && shot.state_changes.characters) || {};
  for (const key of shot.characters) if (s.characters[key]) { s.characters[key].action = shot.action; s.characters[key].facing = shot.exit_dir ? `toward frame ${shot.exit_dir}` : s.characters[key].facing; }
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ch)) if (s.characters[k]) Object.assign(s.characters[k], v);
  const pr = (shot.state_changes && shot.state_changes.props) || {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(pr)) if (s.props[k]) Object.assign(s.props[k], v);
  for (const k of shot.props_in_shot || []) if (s.props[k]) s.props[k].present = true;
  for (const [k, p] of Object.entries(s.props)) { if (p.held && p.owner && s.characters[p.owner]) { const h = s.characters[p.owner].holding; if (!h.includes(k)) h.push(k); } }
  for (const c of Object.values(s.characters)) c.holding = c.holding.filter(k => s.props[k] && s.props[k].held && s.props[k].owner && s.characters[s.props[k].owner] === c);
  const env = (shot.state_changes && shot.state_changes.environment) || {}; Object.assign(s.environment, env);
  const story = (shot.state_changes && shot.state_changes.story) || {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(story)) { if (k === 'known_info_add') for (const i of v) { if (!s.story.known_info.includes(i)) s.story.known_info.push(i); } else s.story[k] = v; }
  for (const i of shot.reveals || []) if (!s.story.known_info.includes(i)) s.story.known_info.push(i);
  s.story.recent_event = shot.action;
  s.camera = { ...s.camera, movement: shot.camera || s.camera.movement };
  const spk = (shot.dialogue || [])[0];
  s.audio = { ...s.audio, speaker: spk ? spk.speaker : null, dialogue_state: spk ? 'speaking' : 'none' };
  return s;
}

/** What a correct rendering of the END of this shot looks like (schema shared with vision observations). */
function expectedObservation(after, shot) {
  const chars = {};
  for (const k of shot.characters) { const c = after.characters[k]; if (c) chars[k] = { identity_match: 1, wardrobe: c.wardrobe, injuries: c.injuries.slice(), facing: c.facing, holding: c.holding.slice() }; }
  const props = {};
  for (const [k, p] of Object.entries(after.props)) if ((shot.props_in_shot || []).includes(k) || p.held) props[k] = { present: p.present || p.held, held: p.held, owner: p.owner };
  return { characters: chars, props, location_id: after.environment.location_id, time_of_day: after.environment.time_of_day, lighting: after.environment.lighting, camera: { transition_intentional: true } };
}

module.exports = { initialLedger, applyShot, expectedObservation };

'use strict';
/**
 * Film Bible — the parent context for every scene and shot of ONE standalone film.
 *
 * HARD RULES (product requirement, enforced here and re-checked by film QC):
 *   1. STANDALONE. One film, beginning to end, in a single episode. No cliffhanger,
 *      no "next episode", no sequel bait. Recurring VANTA IP may appear but the film
 *      must be understandable and complete on its own.
 *   2. Every generation has a THEME and a CONCRETE THREAT (a perceivable thing/person/
 *      event with stakes and a clock — not an abstraction like "fear" or "loneliness").
 *   3. The MYSTERY is ANSWERED, not merely revealed. The reveal happens no later than
 *      the climax, and a real resolution act follows in which the threat's outcome is
 *      shown on screen and the answer is confirmed. A film that stops at the reveal
 *      is rejected.
 */
const ACTS = ['beginning', 'development', 'escalation', 'climax', 'resolution'];
const THREAT_TYPES = ['entity', 'person', 'phenomenon', 'device', 'disaster', 'hazard_place', 'organization'];
const THREAT_OUTCOMES = ['destroyed', 'contained', 'escaped', 'defeated', 'neutralised', 'paid_for'];
const ENDING_TYPES = ['twist', 'emotional', 'tragic', 'hopeful', 'ambiguous_tone', 'shocking'];
const ABSTRACT_ONLY = new Set(['fear', 'loneliness', 'grief', 'darkness', 'guilt', 'doubt', 'time', 'regret', 'sadness',
  'anxiety', 'evil', 'society', 'memory', 'death', 'the unknown', 'madness', 'hate', 'love', 'truth', 'silence', 'the past']);
const CLIFFHANGER_RE = /to be continued|next (episode|chapter|season|film|time)|sequel|part (two|2|ii)\b|cliffhanger|coming soon|will return|(is|was|it'?s?) (n('|o)t|far from) over|it['’]s only (just )?beginning|this (is|was) only the (beginning|start)|the (beginning|start) of something|tune in|stay tuned|\bfor now\b\.?\s*$/i;

const DEFAULT_RANGE = { min: 900, max: null };            // >= 15 minutes; no upper bound by default
const nonEmpty = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0;
const words = (s) => String(s || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;

/**
 * @returns {{valid:boolean, errors:string[], warnings:string[]}}
 */
function validateFilmBible(b, { runtimeRange = DEFAULT_RANGE } = {}) {
  const errors = [], warnings = [];
  const err = (m) => errors.push(m);
  if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return { valid: false, errors: ['bible is not an object'], warnings };

  if (!nonEmpty(b.film_id)) err('film_id missing');
  if (!nonEmpty(b.title)) err('title missing');
  if (!nonEmpty(b.genre)) err('genre missing');
  if (!nonEmpty(b.logline)) err('logline missing');
  if (b.standalone !== true) err('standalone must be true (single complete film, not an episode of a series)');
  const hasMax = runtimeRange.max != null;
  if (!(b.runtime_target >= runtimeRange.min && (!hasMax || b.runtime_target <= runtimeRange.max))) {
    err(`runtime_target ${b.runtime_target}s ${hasMax ? `outside ${runtimeRange.min}-${runtimeRange.max}s` : `must be >= ${runtimeRange.min}s`}`);
  }

  // Theme
  if (!nonEmpty(b.theme) || words(b.theme) < 2) err('theme missing (a stated idea the film explores, not one word)');

  // Concrete threat
  const t = b.concrete_threat;
  if (!t || typeof t !== 'object') err('concrete_threat missing');
  else {
    if (!nonEmpty(t.name)) err('concrete_threat.name missing');
    else if (ABSTRACT_ONLY.has(t.name.trim().toLowerCase())) err(`concrete_threat.name "${t.name}" is an abstraction, not a concrete threat`);
    if (!THREAT_TYPES.includes(t.type)) err(`concrete_threat.type must be one of ${THREAT_TYPES.join('|')}`);
    if (words(t.physical_form) < 6) err('concrete_threat.physical_form must describe something perceivable on screen (>= 6 words)');
    if (words(t.how_it_harms) < 4) err('concrete_threat.how_it_harms missing');
    if (words(t.stakes) < 4) err('concrete_threat.stakes missing');
    if (!nonEmpty(t.clock)) err('concrete_threat.clock missing (what makes it urgent)');
    if (!ACTS.includes(t.introduced_in)) err('concrete_threat.introduced_in must be an act id');
    else if (ACTS.indexOf(t.introduced_in) > 1) err('concrete_threat must be introduced by the development act at the latest');
    if (!Array.isArray(t.escalations) || t.escalations.length < 2) err('concrete_threat.escalations needs >= 2 steps');
    if (!nonEmpty(t.resolution_method)) err('concrete_threat.resolution_method missing');
  }

  // Mystery
  const m = b.mystery;
  if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') err('mystery missing');
  else {
    if (!nonEmpty(m.question)) err('mystery.question missing');
    if (!nonEmpty(m.answer)) err('mystery.answer missing');
    if (!Array.isArray(m.clues) || m.clues.length < 3) err('mystery.clues needs >= 3');
    else {
      const actsWithClues = new Set(m.clues.map(c => c.act));
      if (actsWithClues.size < 2) err('mystery.clues must be spread over >= 2 acts');
      for (const c of m.clues) if (!ACTS.includes(c.act) || !nonEmpty(c.clue)) err('every clue needs {act, clue}');
    }
    if (!ACTS.includes(m.reveal_act)) err('mystery.reveal_act must be an act id');
    else if (!['escalation', 'climax'].includes(m.reveal_act)) err('mystery.reveal_act must be escalation or climax — a reveal in the resolution act (or earlier than escalation) breaks the structure');
    if (!nonEmpty(m.reveal_summary)) err('mystery.reveal_summary missing');
  }

  // Acts
  if (!Array.isArray(b.acts) || b.acts.length !== 5 || b.acts.some((a, i) => a.id !== ACTS[i])) {
    err(`acts must be exactly ${ACTS.join(' > ')} in order`);
  } else {
    const sum = b.acts.reduce((s, a) => s + (Number(a.share) || 0), 0);
    if (sum < 0.98 || sum > 1.02) err(`act shares sum to ${sum.toFixed(2)}, expected 1.0`);
    const res = b.acts[4];
    if (!(res.share >= 0.10)) err('resolution act must have >= 10% of runtime (the ending has to actually resolve, not stop at the reveal)');
    if (b.acts.some(a => !nonEmpty(a.summary))) err('every act needs a summary');
  }

  // Ending
  const e = b.ending;
  if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') err('ending missing');
  else {
    if (!ENDING_TYPES.includes(e.type)) err(`ending.type must be one of ${ENDING_TYPES.join('|')}`);
    if (e.resolves_threat !== true) err('ending.resolves_threat must be true');
    if (e.resolves_mystery !== true) err('ending.resolves_mystery must be true');
    if (!THREAT_OUTCOMES.includes(e.threat_outcome)) err(`ending.threat_outcome must be one of ${THREAT_OUTCOMES.join('|')}`);
    if (!nonEmpty(e.mystery_answer_shown) ) err('ending.mystery_answer_shown missing (how the answer is confirmed on screen after the reveal)');
    if (words(e.aftermath) < 6) err('ending.aftermath missing (show the world after the threat)');
    if (!nonEmpty(e.final_image)) err('ending.final_image missing');
    for (const k of ['aftermath', 'final_image', 'mystery_answer_shown']) if (CLIFFHANGER_RE.test(e[k] || '')) err(`ending.${k} contains cliffhanger / sequel language`);
  }
  for (const k of ['logline', 'title']) if (CLIFFHANGER_RE.test(b[k] || '')) err(`${k} contains cliffhanger / sequel language`);
  if (b.next_episode || b.next_hook || b.season || b.episode_number) err('bible carries series fields (next_episode/next_hook/season/episode_number) — films are standalone');

  // Cast / places
  if (!Array.isArray(b.characters) || b.characters.length < 1) err('characters missing');
  else if (!b.characters.some(c => c.role === 'protagonist')) err('no protagonist');
  if (!Array.isArray(b.locations) || b.locations.length < 1) err('locations missing');
  if (!b.visual_style || typeof b.visual_style !== 'object') warnings.push('visual_style missing');
  if (!Array.isArray(b.continuity_rules) || !b.continuity_rules.length) warnings.push('continuity_rules empty');

  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, warnings };
}

/** Prevent accidental mutation of validated bibles downstream. */
function freezeBible(b) {
  const f = (o) => { if (o && typeof o === 'object' && !Object.isFrozen(o)) { Object.freeze(o); Object.values(o).forEach(f); } return o; };
  return f(b);
}

module.exports = { ACTS, THREAT_TYPES, THREAT_OUTCOMES, ENDING_TYPES, DEFAULT_RANGE, CLIFFHANGER_RE, validateFilmBible, freezeBible };

'use strict';
/**
 * Allocates a guaranteed-unique film_id, independent of whatever a story provider
 * (mock or real LLM) happens to put in its JSON output.
 *
 * This matters because identity/ordering is exactly the kind of thing the spec says
 * deterministic software must own, not generated content (see AUDIT.md / prompt
 * principle: "AI decides story/visuals; deterministic software controls IDs").
 * A story LLM can be prompted to produce a film_id, but nothing stops two responses
 * from reusing one (a mock provider's fixed default id is the trivial case; a real
 * LLM repeating a catchy title-derived slug is the realistic one). Orchestrator
 * refuses to let a second, different bible reuse an existing film_id — correct
 * tamper protection — so an ID collision would otherwise make every film after the
 * first fail with "bible changed since this film was started" (reproduced in testing).
 *
 * Counter file: <dataDir>/film_seq.json — single process/single disk, same assumption
 * as the rest of this engine (see AUDIT.md storage note).
 */
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { readJson, writeJson, pad, slug } = require('./util');

function nextFilmId(dataDir, title) {
  const file = path.join(dataDir, 'film_seq.json');
  const seq = readJson(file, { n: 0 });
  seq.n += 1; writeJson(file, seq);
  const parts = title ? slug(title).split('-').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3) : [];
  const base = parts.length ? parts.join('-') : 'FILM';
  const id = `VANTA_${base}_${pad(seq.n, 3)}`;
  // Guard against an on-disk collision from a previous manual run / restored backup.
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dataDir, 'films', id))) return nextFilmId(dataDir, `${title || ''}X`);
  return id;
}

module.exports = { nextFilmId };

/** assemble -> brand -> social -> QC. The film is COMPLETE only if QC passes. */
async function finalizeFilm(orch, { runtimeRange, brandCfg, music, normalizeLoudness, sceneFades = true } = {}) {
  const out = path.join(orch.filmDir, 'out');
  orch._save({ status: 'assembling', phase: 'assembly' }); orch._emit('assembly_started', {});
  const assembly = await assembleMaster(orch, { outDir: out, brandCfg, music, normalizeLoudness, sceneFades });
  const social = await exportSocial(orch, { master: assembly.master, raw: assembly.raw, outDir: path.join(out, 'social'), brandCfg });
  orch._save({ status: 'qc', phase: 'qc' });
  const qc = await runFilmQc(orch, assembly, { runtimeRange });
  writeJson(orch.f('qc.json'), qc); writeJson(orch.f('assembly.json'), assembly.report);
  orch._emit('qc_result', { passed: qc.passed, failed: Object.entries(qc.gates).filter(([, g]) => !g.passed).map(([k]) => k) });

  if (qc.passed) orch._emit('film_complete', { master: assembly.master });
  return { assembly, social, qc };

'use strict';
/**
 * Frame / media primitives on top of FFmpeg. These are the deterministic pieces of
 * the continuity handoff: verify a clip is decodable, measure its real duration,
 * extract the final USABLE frame (skipping a fade-to-black tail), and grab support
 * frames when motion context matters.
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { run, ffmpegBin, probe } = require('../branding');

async function verifyDecodable(file) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(file) || fs.statSync(file).size < 100) throw new Error(`video missing or empty: ${file}`);
  // Full decode to the null muxer: any corruption makes ffmpeg exit non-zero.
  await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-v', 'error', '-xerror', '-i', file, '-f', 'null', '-'], { timeoutMs: 5 * 60 * 1000 });
  const info = await probe(file);
  if (!(info.duration > 0)) throw new Error(`video has no duration: ${file}`);
  return info;
}

/** Tiny grey thumbnails of the last `tailSec` seconds: array of mean luma per frame. */
async function _tailLuma(file, tailSec) {
  // -vsync 0 (passthrough) in BOTH passes: without it ffmpeg's cfr logic can duplicate a frame in one pass
  // and not the other, so the frame index found here would not exist in the extraction pass.
  const buf = await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-v', 'error', '-sseof', String(-tailSec), '-i', file, '-an', '-vsync', '0',
    '-vf', 'scale=8:8,format=gray', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-'], { binary: true, timeoutMs: 120000 });
  const n = Math.floor(buf.length / 64), out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { let s = 0; for (let j = 0; j < 64; j++) s += buf[i * 64 + j]; out.push(s / 64); }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Final usable frame. "Usable" = not a fade-to-black/blank tail frame: if the very last frame is
 * near-black we step back to the last frame with real picture content. Returns metadata so callers
 * (and QC) can see whether a fallback was needed.
 */
async function extractEndFrame(video, outPng, { duration, tailSec = 1.5, minLuma = 4 } = {}) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPng), { recursive: true });
  const tail = Math.min(tailSec, Math.max(0.3, (duration || tailSec)));
  const luma = await _tailLuma(video, tail);
  if (!luma.length) throw new Error(`could not decode tail of ${video}`);
  let idx = luma.length - 1;
  while (idx > 0 && luma[idx] < minLuma) idx--;
  const ok = () => fs.existsSync(outPng) && fs.statSync(outPng).size >= 100;
  fs.rmSync(outPng, { force: true });
  await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-sseof', String(-tail), '-i', video, '-an', '-vsync', '0',
    '-vf', `select=eq(n\\,${idx})`, '-frames:v', '1', '-update', '1', outPng], { timeoutMs: 120000 });
  let method = 'select';
  if (!ok()) {
    // Safety net: keep overwriting one file with every tail frame; the last write is the final frame.
    method = 'last-frame-fallback';
    await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-sseof', String(-tail), '-i', video, '-an', '-vsync', '0', '-update', '1', outPng], { timeoutMs: 120000 });
  }
  if (!ok()) throw new Error(`end-frame extraction produced nothing for ${video}`);
  return { path: outPng, frameIndexInTail: idx, framesInTail: luma.length, usedFallback: idx !== luma.length - 1, method, lumaMean: luma[idx] };
}

/** Frame `secBeforeEnd` seconds before the end (support frame for motion context). */
async function extractFrameBeforeEnd(video, outPng, secBeforeEnd, duration) {
  if (!(duration > secBeforeEnd + 0.1)) return null;                     // clip too short: skip, do not fabricate
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPng), { recursive: true });
  await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-ss', String(Math.max(0, duration - secBeforeEnd)), '-i', video, '-an', '-frames:v', '1', outPng], { timeoutMs: 60000 });
  return fs.existsSync(outPng) ? outPng : null;
}

async function extractFirstFrame(video, outPng) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPng), { recursive: true });
  await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', video, '-an', '-frames:v', '1', outPng], { timeoutMs: 60000 });
  return outPng;
}

/** Mean absolute grey difference (0-255) between two images, 32px thumbnails. Cheap similarity probe. */
async function imageDiff(a, b) {
  const grab = (f) => run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-v', 'error', '-i', f, '-vf', 'scale=32:32,format=gray', '-frames:v', '1', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-'], { binary: true });
  const [x, y] = await Promise.all([grab(a), grab(b)]);
  let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) s += Math.abs(x[i] - y[i]);
  return s / x.length;
}

module.exports = { verifyDecodable, extractEndFrame, extractFrameBeforeEnd, extractFirstFrame, imageDiff, probe };

'use strict';
/**
 * Fresh brief selection: every generation gets a NEW theme and a NEW concrete threat.
 * Deterministic (seeded) and history-aware, so consecutive films never repeat a theme,
 * and threat *types* rotate. The brief is the input to story generation; the LLM
 * supplies the creative detail, this module guarantees variety and concreteness.
 */
const path = require('path');
const { rng, readJson, writeJson, slug } = require('./util');

const THEMES = [
  'trust is the first thing a crisis destroys', 'what we owe the people we abandon', 'progress that quietly erases someone',
  'the price of keeping a promise', 'inherited guilt and who pays for it', 'loyalty tested by survival',
  'the comfort of a lie versus the cost of the truth', 'grief that refuses to stay buried', 'ambition that consumes its own foundation',
  'community fractures under pressure', 'a second chance that demands a sacrifice', 'the harm done by well-meant secrets',
  'technology that keeps its promises too literally', 'reconciliation after an unforgivable act', 'courage measured by what you give up',
  'memory as evidence and as weapon', 'isolation that turns into solidarity', 'the debt a place holds over its people',
];
const THREATS = [
  { type: 'entity',       seeds: ['a thing in the flooded lower levels that mimics voices', 'a swarm-intelligence made of scrap drones'] , clock: 'it reaches the sealed doors at dawn' },
  { type: 'person',       seeds: ['a former safety inspector who has decided the building must not be saved', 'a courier carrying something he intends to release at midnight'], clock: 'the deadline he gave them expires at midnight' },
  { type: 'phenomenon',   seeds: ['a blackout front that moves street by street and kills anything electronic', 'a fog that erases anything it covers from memory'], clock: 'the front reaches the last shelter in one hour' },
  { type: 'device',       seeds: ['an automated dam release scheduled to run regardless of who is below', 'a sealed cargo unit counting down to a pressure failure'], clock: 'the countdown ends in ninety minutes' },
  { type: 'disaster',     seeds: ['a chain of failing structures collapsing towards the town centre', 'a wildfire driven towards the only evacuation road'], clock: 'the road closes when the fire crests the ridge' },
  { type: 'hazard_place', seeds: ['a sinking transit tunnel that fills a section at a time', 'an orbital habitat losing air ring by ring'], clock: 'the last airtight ring seals in two hours' },
  { type: 'organization', seeds: ['a private crew paid to erase every witness of an accident', 'a debt-collection syndicate that arrives in force at nightfall'], clock: 'they arrive at nightfall' },
];

function pickFreshBrief({ history = [], seed, avoidLast = 12 } = {}) {
  const r = rng(seed == null ? Date.now() : seed);
  const recent = history.slice(-avoidLast);
  const usedThemes = new Set(recent.map(h => h.theme));
  const recentTypes = history.slice(-3).map(h => h.threat_type);
  let themes = THEMES.filter(t => !usedThemes.has(t)); if (!themes.length) themes = THEMES.filter(t => t !== (history[history.length - 1] || {}).theme);
  let threats = THREATS.filter(t => !recentTypes.includes(t.type)); if (!threats.length) threats = THREATS;
  const theme = themes[Math.floor(r() * themes.length)];
  const th = threats[Math.floor(r() * threats.length)];
  const seedText = th.seeds[Math.floor(r() * th.seeds.length)];
  return { theme, threat_type: th.type, threat_seed: seedText, threat_clock: th.clock, seed: seed == null ? null : seed };
}

class BriefHistory {
  constructor(file) { this.file = file; }
  all() { return readJson(this.file, []); }
  record(brief, film_id) { const h = this.all(); h.push({ film_id, theme: brief.theme, threat_type: brief.threat_type, threat_seed: brief.threat_seed, at: new Date().toISOString() }); writeJson(this.file, h); return h; }
}

module.exports = { THEMES, THREATS, pickFreshBrief, BriefHistory };

'use strict';
/**
 * IP registry + canonical references.
 *
 *   ip/registry.json                                  id sequence + index
 *   ip/characters/VANTA-CHAR-KAI-001/character.json    CANONICAL data (never mutated by a film)
 *                                    master_reference.png front.png three_quarter.png side.png full_body.png
 *                                    expressions/ wardrobe/ poses/
 *   ip/locations/VANTA-LOC-...-NNN/{location.json,reference.png}
 *   ip/props/VANTA-PROP-...-NNN/{prop.json,reference.png}
 *
 * Canonical (must stay stable) vs film state (changes during a film) is enforced: films get a
 * frozen copy of canonical data; only `IpRegistry.updateCanonical` can change it, and it records
 * a revision. Reuse: ensureX with an existing key returns the SAME id and refs.
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { slug, pad, ensureDir, writeJson, readJson, sha256File, stableStringify, sha256, mapLimit } = require('./util');

const TYPES = { character: { code: 'CHAR', dir: 'characters', file: 'character.json' }, location: { code: 'LOC', dir: 'locations', file: 'location.json' }, prop: { code: 'PROP', dir: 'props', file: 'prop.json' } };
const CHAR_VIEWS = ['front', 'three_quarter', 'side', 'full_body'];

class IpRegistry {
  constructor(root) { this.root = ensureDir(root); this.indexFile = path.join(root, 'registry.json'); }
  _index() { return readJson(this.indexFile, { seq: {}, items: {} }); }
  _dir(type, id) { return path.join(this.root, TYPES[type].dir, id); }

  /** Get-or-create. Same (type,key) always yields the same id. */
  ensure(type, key, canonical) {
    const idx = this._index(); const k = `${type}:${slug(key)}`;
    if (idx.items[k]) return this.get(type, idx.items[k]);
    idx.seq[type] = (idx.seq[type] || 0) + 1;
    const id = `VANTA-${TYPES[type].code}-${slug(key)}-${pad(idx.seq[type])}`;
    idx.items[k] = id; writeJson(this.indexFile, idx);
    const dir = ensureDir(this._dir(type, id));
    const data = { [`${type}_id`]: id, key: slug(key), revision: 1, ...canonical, references: {} };
    writeJson(path.join(dir, TYPES[type].file), data);
    return { id, dir, data };
  }
  get(type, id) { const dir = this._dir(type, id); return { id, dir, data: readJson(path.join(dir, TYPES[type].file)) }; }
  find(type, key) { const id = this._index().items[`${type}:${slug(key)}`]; return id ? this.get(type, id) : null; }
  list(type) { const idx = this._index(); return Object.entries(idx.items).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith(type + ':')).map(([, id]) => this.get(type, id)); }

  /** The ONLY way canonical data changes. Bumps revision. */
  updateCanonical(type, id, patch) {
    const { dir, data } = this.get(type, id);
    const next = { ...data, ...patch, references: data.references, revision: data.revision + 1 };
    writeJson(path.join(dir, TYPES[type].file), next); return next;
  }
  _setRef(type, id, name, file) {
    const { dir, data } = this.get(type, id);
    data.references[name] = { path: path.relative(dir, file), sha256: sha256File(file) };
    writeJson(path.join(dir, TYPES[type].file), data);
  }
  /** Hash of the canonical fields only (excludes references + revision). */
  canonicalHash(type, id) { const { data } = this.get(type, id); const { references, revision, ...canon } = data; return sha256(stableStringify(canon)); }
  refPath(type, id, name) { const { dir, data } = this.get(type, id); const r = data.references[name]; if (!r) return null; const p = path.join(dir, r.path); return fs.existsSync(p) ? p : null; }
}

const characterPrompt = (c, view) => {
  const k = c.canonical || c;
  return `${view.replace('_', ' ')} view of ${c.name}: ${c.description || ''}. ${k.age_representation || ''}. Hair: ${k.hair}. Eyes: ${k.eyes}. Face: ${k.face}. Body: ${k.body}. Distinguishing marks: ${k.marks}. Wearing: ${k.wardrobe_default}. Neutral background, consistent identity.`;
};

class AssetPipeline {
  constructor({ registry, image, concurrency = 3, log = () => {} }) { Object.assign(this, { registry, image, concurrency, log }); }

  async _gen(kind, key, prompt, out, referenceImages = []) {
    if (fs.existsSync(out) && fs.statSync(out).size > 100) return { path: out, cached: true };   // cache reuse
    const r = await this.image.generate({ kind, key, prompt, referenceImages, out }); return { path: r.path, cached: false };
  }

  /** master first (identity anchor), then the other views conditioned on it, in parallel. */
  async ensureCharacter(ch) {
    const { id, dir } = this.registry.ensure('character', ch.key, { name: ch.name, role: ch.role, description: ch.description, canonical: ch.canonical });
    const master = await this._gen('character_master', ch.key, characterPrompt(ch, 'master portrait'), path.join(dir, 'master_reference.png'));
    this.registry._setRef('character', id, 'master_reference', master.path);
    const views = await mapLimit(CHAR_VIEWS, this.concurrency, (v) => this._gen(`character_${v}`, ch.key, characterPrompt(ch, v), path.join(dir, `${v}.png`), [master.path]));
    CHAR_VIEWS.forEach((v, i) => this.registry._setRef('character', id, v, views[i].path));
    return { id, generated: [master, ...views].filter(x => !x.cached).length };
  }
  async ensureExpression(charId, ch, expression) {
    const { dir } = this.registry.get('character', charId); const master = this.registry.refPath('character', charId, 'master_reference');
    const r = await this._gen('character_expression', ch.key, `${characterPrompt(ch, 'close')} Expression: ${expression}.`, path.join(dir, 'expressions', `${slug(expression)}.png`), [master]);
    this.registry._setRef('character', charId, `expression_${slug(expression)}`, r.path); return r.path;
  }
  async ensureWardrobe(charId, ch, wardrobeText) {
    const { dir } = this.registry.get('character', charId); const master = this.registry.refPath('character', charId, 'master_reference');
    const name = slug(wardrobeText).slice(0, 40);
    const r = await this._gen('character_wardrobe', ch.key, `${ch.name} full body wearing: ${wardrobeText}. Same face and body as reference.`, path.join(dir, 'wardrobe', `${name}.png`), [master]);
    this.registry._setRef('character', charId, `wardrobe_${name}`, r.path); return { name, path: r.path };
  }
  async ensureLocation(loc) {
    const { id, dir } = this.registry.ensure('location', loc.key, { name: loc.name, description: loc.description });
    const r = await this._gen('location', loc.key, `${loc.name}: ${loc.description}. Establishing reference, no people.`, path.join(dir, 'reference.png'));
    this.registry._setRef('location', id, 'reference', r.path); return { id, generated: r.cached ? 0 : 1 };
  }
  async ensureProp(prop) {
    const { id, dir } = this.registry.ensure('prop', prop.key, { name: prop.name, description: prop.description });
    const r = await this._gen('prop', prop.key, `${prop.name}: ${prop.description}. Isolated on neutral background.`, path.join(dir, 'reference.png'));
    this.registry._setRef('prop', id, 'reference', r.path); return { id, generated: r.cached ? 0 : 1 };
  }

  /** Characters/locations/props are independent of one another -> bounded parallelism is safe here. */
  async ensureAll(bible) {
    const map = { characters: {}, locations: {}, props: {} }; let generated = 0;
    const jobs = [
      ...bible.characters.map(c => ({ t: 'characters', k: c.key, f: () => this.ensureCharacter(c) })),
      ...bible.locations.map(l => ({ t: 'locations', k: l.key, f: () => this.ensureLocation(l) })),
      ...(bible.props || []).map(p => ({ t: 'props', k: p.key, f: () => this.ensureProp(p) })),
    ];
    const res = await mapLimit(jobs, this.concurrency, j => j.f());
    jobs.forEach((j, i) => { map[j.t][j.k] = res[i].id; generated += res[i].generated; });
    return { ids: map, generated };
  }
}

module.exports = { IpRegistry, AssetPipeline, CHAR_VIEWS, TYPES };

'use strict';
/**
 * FilmOrchestrator — deterministic production control. AI providers create content;
 * this class owns IDs, ordering, state files, frames, durations, validation, retries, resume.
 *
 *   prepareAssets -> plan -> for each shot IN ORDER:
 *      load previous end frame + refs + ledger -> compile -> generate -> verify decodable
 *      -> extract end frame -> observe -> validate -> (approve | targeted retry)
 *
 * Shots are strictly sequential (each depends on the previous end frame). Only independent
 * asset generation runs in parallel (bounded).
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { ensureDir, writeJson, readJson, sha256, stableStringify, EventLog, deepClone } = require('./util');
const { IpRegistry, AssetPipeline } = require('./ip');
const { planFilm } = require('./planner');
const { initialLedger, applyShot, expectedObservation } = require('./continuity');
const { compileShotRequest } = require('./promptCompiler');
const { validateShot, adjustmentsFor } = require('./validator');
const { ShotStore } = require('./shotStore');
const frames = require('./frames');
const { checkStory } = require('./storyQc');

class ShotFailedError extends Error { constructor(id, issues) { super(`shot ${id} failed after all attempts: ${issues.map(i => i.type).join(',')}`); this.shot_id = id; this.issues = issues; } }

class FilmOrchestrator {
  constructor({ dataDir, bible, providers, options = {}, log }) {
    this.bible = bible; this.providers = providers;
    // Strip undefined-valued keys from `options` first: a caller (routes.js does this) that
    // builds its options object conditionally can easily end up passing e.g. {minShot: undefined}
    // rather than omitting the key entirely, and `{...defaults, ...options}` lets an explicit
    // undefined silently overwrite a good default (see planner.js planFilm for the bug this
    // caused in production: NaN shot durations at real runtimes). `runtimeRange` is the one
    // legitimate exception -- undefined there means "no runtime-range check", not "use a default".
    const cleanOptions = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(options).filter(([k, v]) => v !== undefined || k === 'runtimeRange'));
    this.opt = { maxAttempts: 3, maxRefs: 6, extraDurationStep: 1.0, runtimeRange: undefined, assetConcurrency: 3, ...cleanOptions };
    this.filmDir = ensureDir(path.join(dataDir, 'films', bible.film_id));
    this.registry = new IpRegistry(path.join(dataDir, 'ip'));
    this.store = new ShotStore(this.filmDir);
    this.events = new EventLog(path.join(this.filmDir, 'events.jsonl'));
    this.log = log || (() => {});
    this.f = (n) => path.join(this.filmDir, n);
    this.state = readJson(this.f('state.json')) || { film_id: bible.film_id, status: 'created', phase: 'created', shots: {}, paused_reason: null };
    this.bibleSha = sha256(stableStringify({ ...bible, brief: undefined }));
    if (this.state.bible_sha && this.state.bible_sha !== this.bibleSha) throw new Error('bible changed since this film was started; refusing to continue (start a new film_id)');
    this.state.bible_sha = this.bibleSha;
    this.assets = readJson(this.f('assets.json'));
    this.planData = readJson(this.f('plan.json'));
    this.head = null;
    writeJson(this.f('bible.json'), bible);
  }
  _save(patch = {}) { Object.assign(this.state, patch, { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }); writeJson(this.f('state.json'), this.state); }
  _emit(type, data) { this.events.emit(type, { film_id: this.bible.film_id, ...data }); }

  // ── stage 1: story gate + canonical assets ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  async prepareAssets() {
    const q = checkStory(this.bible, { runtimeRange: this.opt.runtimeRange });
    if (!q.valid) { this._save({ status: 'failed', phase: 'story', paused_reason: q.errors.join('; ') }); this._emit('story_rejected', { errors: q.errors }); throw new Error(`story rejected: ${q.errors.join('; ')}`); }
    const pipe = new AssetPipeline({ registry: this.registry, image: this.providers.image, concurrency: this.opt.assetConcurrency, log: this.log });
    const { ids, generated } = await pipe.ensureAll(this.bible);
    // film-specific wardrobe references for deliberate wardrobe changes (independent -> parallel)
    const wardrobeJobs = [];
    for (const sc of this.bible.scenes) for (const bt of sc.beats) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries((bt.state_changes || {}).characters || {})) if (v.wardrobe) wardrobeJobs.push({ k, w: v.wardrobe });
    const uniq = [...new Map(wardrobeJobs.map(j => [`${j.k}|${j.w}`, j])).values()];
    const { mapLimit } = require('./util');
    await mapLimit(uniq, this.opt.assetConcurrency, (j) => pipe.ensureWardrobe(ids.characters[j.k], this.bible.characters.find(c => c.key === j.k), j.w));
    const canonicalHashes = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ids.characters).map(([k, id]) => [id, this.registry.canonicalHash('character', id)]));
    this.assets = { ids, canonicalHashes, generated };
    writeJson(this.f('assets.json'), this.assets);
    this._save({ phase: 'assets', status: 'assets_ready' }); this._emit('assets_ready', { generated, ids });
    return this.assets;
  }

  // ── stage 2: plan ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  plan() {
    if (!this.assets) throw new Error('prepareAssets() first');
    if (this.planData) return this.planData;                                     // idempotent / resume-safe
    const p = planFilm(this.bible, this.assets.ids, { minShot: this.opt.minShot, maxShot: this.opt.maxShot });
    this.planData = p; writeJson(this.f('plan.json'), p);
    for (const s of p.shots) this.state.shots[s.shot_id] = this.state.shots[s.shot_id] || { status: 'pending', attempts: 0, approved_attempt: null, retry_reasons: [] };
    this._save({ phase: 'planned', status: 'planned' }); this._emit('plan_ready', { shots: p.shots.length, planned_runtime: p.planned_runtime, warnings: p.warnings });
    return p;
  }

  _ledgerBefore(index) {
    if (index === 0) return initialLedger(this.bible, this.assets.ids);
    const prevId = this.planData.shots[index - 1].shot_id;
    const rec = readJson(this.f(`continuity/${prevId}.json`));
    if (!rec) throw new Error(`no continuity record for ${prevId}: previous shot is not approved`);
    return rec.state_after;
  }
  _previousHandoff(index) {
    if (index === 0) return null;
    const a = this.store.getApproved(this.planData.shots[index - 1].shot_id);
    if (!a) throw new Error(`previous shot ${this.planData.shots[index - 1].shot_id} has no valid approved output`);
    return { shot_id: a.shot_id, end_frame: a.end_frame, support_frames: a.support_frames };
  }

  // ── stage 3: the shot loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async run() {
    this.plan();
    this._save({ status: 'generating', phase: 'generating', paused_reason: null });
    for (const shot of this.planData.shots) {
      const st = this.state.shots[shot.shot_id];
      if (st.status === 'approved') {
        if (this.store.getApproved(shot.shot_id) && readJson(this.f(`continuity/${shot.shot_id}.json`))) { this._emit('shot_skipped_resume', { shot_id: shot.shot_id }); continue; }
        this._emit('approved_invalid', { shot_id: shot.shot_id }); st.status = 'pending';
      }
      try { await this.generateShot(shot); }
      catch (e) { this._save({ status: 'paused', paused_reason: e.message }); this._emit('film_paused', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, reason: e.message }); throw e; }
    }
    this._save({ status: 'shots_complete', phase: 'shots_complete' }); this._emit('all_shots_approved', {});
    return this.summary();
  }

  async generateShot(shot, { supersede = false } = {}) {
    const st = this.state.shots[shot.shot_id]; const idx = shot.index;
    const scene = this.planData.scenes.find(s => s.scene_id === shot.scene_id);
    const before = this._ledgerBefore(idx), after = applyShot(before, shot, scene);
    const previous = this._previousHandoff(idx);
    const expected = expectedObservation(after, shot);
    st.status = 'generating'; this._save({ current_shot: shot.shot_id }); this._emit('shot_started', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, scene_id: shot.scene_id, previous_frame: previous && previous.end_frame });

    let adjustments = [], issues = [], lastAttemptNo = 0;
    for (let k = 1; k <= this.opt.maxAttempts; k++) {
      const { n, dir } = this.store.nextAttempt(shot.shot_id); lastAttemptNo = n;
      const genDur = adjustments.includes('extend_duration') ? Math.min(this.planData.limits.maxShot, shot.duration_target + this.opt.extraDurationStep * k) : shot.duration_target;
      const req = compileShotRequest({ shot, before, after, bible: this.bible, assets: { registry: this.registry, ids: this.assets.ids }, previous, adjustments, attempt: n, outDir: dir, generationDuration: genDur, maxRefs: this.opt.maxRefs });
      req.expected_state = expected;
      st.attempts++; this._save();
      this._emit('attempt_started', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, duration: genDur, adjustments, previous_frame: req.references.previous_end_frame, refs: [...req.references.characters.flatMap(c => c.files.map(f => `${c.key}:${f.role}`)), req.references.location ? 'location' : null, ...req.references.props.map(p => `prop:${p.key}`)].filter(Boolean), refs_dropped: req.references_dropped });
      const T = {}; const t = () => Date.now(); let t0 = t();
      let gen; try { gen = await this.providers.video.generate(req); } catch (e) { gen = null; this._emit('provider_error', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, error: e.message }); }
      T.generate = t() - t0; t0 = t();
      let clip = null, endInfo = null, obs = null;
      if (gen) {
        try {
          clip = await frames.verifyDecodable(gen.video_path);
          [endInfo] = await Promise.all([frames.extractEndFrame(gen.video_path, path.join(dir, 'end_frame.png'), { duration: clip.duration })]);
          T.verify_extract = t() - t0; t0 = t();
          if (shot.motion_critical || adjustments.includes('motion_context')) {
            await Promise.all([[1, 'end_m1.png'], [3, 'end_m3.png']].map(([s, f]) => frames.extractFrameBeforeEnd(gen.video_path, path.join(dir, f), s, clip.duration)));
          }
          obs = await this.providers.vision.observe({ clip_dir: dir, frames: { end: endInfo.path }, previous_end_frame: previous && previous.end_frame, expected });
          T.vision = t() - t0;
        } catch (e) { clip = null; this._emit('media_error', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, error: e.message }); }
      }
      const result = validateShot({ shot, before, request: req, clip, observation: obs, expected });
      issues = result.issues;
      writeJson(path.join(dir, 'validation.json'), result);
      writeJson(path.join(dir, 'generation.json'), { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, duration_target: shot.duration_target, dialogue_duration: shot.dialogue_duration, generation_duration: genDur, actual_duration: clip && clip.duration, adjustments, previous_end_frame: req.references.previous_end_frame, refs_dropped: req.references_dropped, references: { characters: req.references.characters.map(c => ({ key: c.key, character_id: c.character_id, roles: c.files.map(f => f.role) })), location: req.references.location && req.references.location.location_id, props: req.references.props.map(p => p.key), previous_end_frame: req.references.previous_end_frame, support_frames: req.references.support_frames.length, start_image: req.start_image }, end_frame: endInfo, timings_ms: T, prompt_sha256: sha256(req.prompt) });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'prompt.txt'), req.prompt);
      this._emit('attempt_result', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, passed: result.passed, issues: result.issues.map(i => ({ type: i.type, severity: i.severity, message: i.message })), actual_duration: clip && clip.duration, timings_ms: T });
      if (result.passed) {
        const rec = this.store.approve(shot.shot_id, n, { supersede });
        const A = this.store.getApproved(shot.shot_id);
        writeJson(this.f(`continuity/${shot.shot_id}.json`), {
          shot_id: shot.shot_id, previous_shot_id: shot.previous_shot_id, duration_target: shot.duration_target, actual_duration: clip.duration,
          character_state: after.characters, environment_state: after.environment, prop_state: after.props, camera_state: after.camera, lighting_state: after.lighting, story_state: after.story, audio_state: after.audio,
          state_before: before, state_after: after, previous_end_frame: previous && previous.end_frame, end_frame: A.end_frame, support_frames: A.support_frames, validation: result,
        });
        Object.assign(st, { status: 'approved', approved_attempt: n, last_issues: [], actual_duration: clip.duration });
        this._save(); this._emit('shot_approved', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempt: n, end_frame: A.end_frame });
        return rec;
      }
      const hard = issues.find(i => !i.retryable);
      st.retry_reasons.push({ attempt: n, issues: issues.map(i => i.type) }); st.last_issues = issues;
      if (hard) break;                                                          // plan defect: retrying video cannot fix it
      adjustments = adjustmentsFor(issues, adjustments);                        // TARGETED change to the inputs
      this._emit('retry_planned', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, after_attempt: n, reasons: issues.map(i => i.type), adjustments });
    }
    st.status = 'failed'; this._save({ paused_reason: `shot ${shot.shot_id} failed` });
    this._emit('shot_failed', { shot_id: shot.shot_id, attempts: lastAttemptNo, issues: issues.map(i => ({ type: i.type, message: i.message })) });
    throw new ShotFailedError(shot.shot_id, issues);
  }

  /** Targeted regeneration of ONE shot. Neighbours untouched; previous approved end frame + state reused. */
  async regenerateShot(shotId) {
    this.plan(); const shot = this.planData.shots.find(s => s.shot_id === shotId); if (!shot) throw new Error(`unknown shot ${shotId}`);
    const old = this.store.getApproved(shotId); const oldEnd = old && old.end_frame ? path.join(this.filmDir, 'tmp_old_end.png') : null;
    if (oldEnd) fs.copyFileSync(old.end_frame, oldEnd);
    this._emit('regenerate_requested', { shot_id: shotId });
    await this.generateShot(shot, { supersede: !!old });
    const next = this.planData.shots[shot.index + 1];
    if (oldEnd && next && this.state.shots[next.shot_id].status === 'approved') {
      const d = await frames.imageDiff(oldEnd, this.store.getApproved(shotId).end_frame);
      if (d > 6) { this.state.shots[next.shot_id].status = 'needs_review'; this._save(); this._emit('next_shot_needs_review', { shot_id: next.shot_id, end_frame_diff: d }); }
    }
    if (oldEnd) fs.rmSync(oldEnd, { force: true });
  }

  summary() {
    const shots = (this.planData ? this.planData.shots : []).map(s => {
      const st = this.state.shots[s.shot_id] || {}; const c = readJson(this.f(`continuity/${s.shot_id}.json`)); const a = this.store.approvedRecord(s.shot_id);
      return { shot_id: s.shot_id, scene_id: s.scene_id, index: s.index, status: st.status, attempts: st.attempts, duration_target: s.duration_target, actual_duration: st.actual_duration || null, previous_frame: c && c.previous_end_frame, end_frame: c && c.end_frame, continuity_passed: c ? c.validation.passed : null, retry_reasons: st.retry_reasons || [], last_issues: (st.last_issues || []).map(i => ({ type: i.type, message: i.message })), approved_attempt: a && a.attempt };
    });
    const done = shots.filter(s => s.status === 'approved').length;
    return { film_id: this.bible.film_id, title: this.bible.title, status: this.state.status, phase: this.state.phase, paused_reason: this.state.paused_reason, shots_total: shots.length, shots_approved: done, progress: shots.length ? done / shots.length : 0, shots };
  }
}

module.exports = { FilmOrchestrator, ShotFailedError };
