'use strict';
/**
 * Scene + shot planner (continuity-first). Deterministic: same bible + ids => same plan.
 *
 * Every shot answers: where are we / who / what do they look like / what just happened /
 * what happens now / what must stay consistent / what changes / where does it end /
 * what must the next shot inherit — and states HOW it opens relative to the previous shot.
 *
 * Duration management: duration_target is clamped to the provider window (default = the
 * existing LTX limits, 2-10 s). Dialogue is NEVER truncated: if a beat's speech does not fit
 * one shot it is split across consecutive shots (existing StreamVerse rule: adapt duration
 * within limits rather than cut speech). Speech length uses the existing
 * ttsGen.estimateSpokenDuration.
 */
const { pad, sha256, stableStringify } = require('./util');

function spokenSeconds(lines) {
  const { estimateSpokenDuration } = require('../ttsGen');
  return lines.reduce((s, l) => s + estimateSpokenDuration(l.text), 0);
}
const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;

function limitsFromEnv() {
  return { minShot: Number(process.env.LTX_MIN_DURATION) || 2, maxShot: Math.min(10, Number(process.env.LTX_MAX_DURATION) || 10) };
}

/** Opening transition derived from what the previous shot actually ended on. */
function openingTransition({ prev, shot, sceneChanged, first, scene }) {
  if (first) return { type: 'fade_in', instruction: `Open on an establishing view of ${scene.location_key} (${scene.time_of_day}) before the characters.`, inherits: [] };
  if (sceneChanged) return { type: 'scene_boundary', instruction: `Cut to ${scene.location_key}, ${scene.time_of_day}. Establish the new location and lighting before the characters; do not carry over the previous composition.`, inherits: ['story state', 'character wardrobe', 'injuries', 'held props'] };
  const dir = prev.exit_dir;
  const who = prev.characters.join(' and ');
  const move = dir ? `${who} was moving toward frame ${dir}; begin with that movement continuing toward frame ${dir}` : `begin from the previous end frame's exact composition and continue the action`;
  return { type: 'continuous', instruction: `Previous shot: ${prev.action} Now: ${move}. Keep camera momentum (${prev.camera || 'unchanged'}), same eyelines and prop positions.`, inherits: ['position', 'facing', 'camera momentum', 'held props', 'lighting'] };
}

function endFrameTransition({ shot, next }) {
  if (!next) return { type: 'hold', instruction: 'Hold on the final composition; this is the last shot of the film.' };
  if (shot.exit_dir) return { type: 'exit_frame', instruction: `End with ${shot.characters.join(' and ')} still moving toward frame ${shot.exit_dir} so the next shot can continue the movement.` };
  return { type: 'settle', instruction: 'End on a stable, readable composition with characters, props and lighting clearly visible.' };
}

function shotQuestions(shot, scene, prev) {
  return {
    where: `${scene.location_key}, ${scene.time_of_day}`,
    who: shot.characters.join(', '),
    look: 'see continuity_requirements (canonical + current wardrobe/injuries)',
    just_happened: prev ? prev.action : 'nothing yet (film opening)',
    now: shot.action,
    must_remain: shot.continuity_requirements.filter(x => x.kind !== 'change').map(x => x.text),
    changes: shot.continuity_requirements.filter(x => x.kind === 'change').map(x => x.text),
    ends: shot.end_frame_transition.instruction,
    next_inherits: ['final frame', 'character positions', 'held props', 'wardrobe', 'injuries', 'lighting'],
  };
}

function planFilm(bible, ids, opts = {}) {
  // NOT `{ ...limitsFromEnv(), ...opts }`: if a caller passes {minShot: undefined} (e.g. because
  // it forwards an options object that simply never set minShot), object spread makes that
  // explicit `undefined` OVERWRITE the env default, silently producing NaN shot durations across
  // the whole plan. Reproduced in testing at a real ~960s runtime (short test runtimes happened
  // to mask it because they weren't clamp-sensitive in the same way). Per-key `??` fallback can't
  // have that failure mode.
  const envLimits = limitsFromEnv();
  const minShot = opts.minShot ?? envLimits.minShot;
  const maxShot = opts.maxShot ?? envLimits.maxShot;
  const dialoguePad = opts.dialoguePad != null ? opts.dialoguePad : 1.0;
  const filmKey = bible.film_id.toLowerCase();
  const warnings = [];

  // beats per act -> per-beat time budget
  const beatsInAct = {}; for (const sc of bible.scenes) beatsInAct[sc.act] = (beatsInAct[sc.act] || 0) + sc.beats.length;
  const actShare = Object.fromEntries(bible.acts.map(a => [a.id, a.share]));

  const scenes = [], shots = [];
  let prev = null, sceneNo = 0;
  const locId = (key) => ids.locations[key];
  for (const sc of bible.scenes) {
    sceneNo++;
    const scene = { scene_id: `${filmKey}_scene_${pad(sceneNo)}`, source_scene_id: sc.scene_id, scene_no: sceneNo, act: sc.act, location_key: sc.location_key, location_id: locId(sc.location_key), time_of_day: sc.time_of_day, summary: sc.summary, characters: sc.characters, shot_ids: [] };
    scenes.push(scene);
    let shotNo = 0;
    for (const bt of sc.beats) {
      const target = (bible.runtime_target * actShare[sc.act]) / beatsInAct[sc.act];
      const lines = bt.dialogue || [];
      // Split dialogue across shots so nothing is ever truncated
      const groups = []; let cur = [], curDur = 0;
      for (const l of lines) {
        const d = spokenSeconds([l]);
        if (cur.length && curDur + d + dialoguePad > maxShot) { groups.push(cur); cur = []; curDur = 0; }
        cur.push(l); curDur += d;
      }
      if (cur.length || !groups.length) groups.push(cur);
      const perShotTarget = target / groups.length;
      groups.forEach((g, gi) => {
        shotNo++;
        const last = gi === groups.length - 1;
        const dd = spokenSeconds(g);
        const need = Math.max(perShotTarget, g.length ? dd + dialoguePad : 0);
        if (g.length && dd + dialoguePad > maxShot) warnings.push(`${bt.id}: dialogue needs ${r1(dd + dialoguePad)}s > max ${maxShot}s; kept whole (never truncated)`);
        const duration_target = r1(clamp(need, minShot, maxShot));
        const shot = {
          shot_id: `${filmKey}_scene_${pad(sceneNo)}_shot_${pad(shotNo)}`,
          film_id: bible.film_id, scene_id: scene.scene_id, beat_id: bt.id, part: groups.length > 1 ? `${gi + 1}/${groups.length}` : null,
          index: shots.length, previous_shot_id: prev ? prev.shot_id : null,
          purpose: (bt.marks || []).join(',') || (last ? 'story beat' : 'continuation'),
          characters: bt.characters_in_shot && bt.characters_in_shot.length ? bt.characters_in_shot : sc.characters,
          location_key: sc.location_key, location_id: locId(sc.location_key), time_of_day: sc.time_of_day, act: sc.act,
          action: gi === 0 ? bt.action : `(continues) ${bt.action}`,
          dialogue: g, dialogue_sha256: sha256(stableStringify(g)),
          camera: bt.camera || 'medium', exit_dir: last ? (bt.exit_dir || '') : '',
          props_in_shot: bt.props_in_shot || [], uses_info: bt.uses_info || [], reveals: last ? (bt.reveals || []) : [],
          marks: last ? (bt.marks || []) : [], state_changes: last ? (bt.state_changes || {}) : {},
          duration_target, dialogue_duration: r1(dd), generation_duration: duration_target, actual_duration: null,
          visual_style: bible.visual_style,
        };
        const sceneChanged = !prev || prev.scene_id !== shot.scene_id;
        shot.opening_transition = openingTransition({ prev, shot, sceneChanged: sceneChanged && !!prev, first: !prev, scene });
        shot.motion_critical = shot.opening_transition.type === 'continuous' && !!(prev && (prev.exit_dir || /track|pan|follow|dolly|handheld/i.test(prev.camera || '')));
        shot.continuity_requirements = [
          ...shot.characters.map(k => ({ kind: 'keep', text: `${k}: canonical face/hair/body from reference; current wardrobe & injuries from state` })),
          ...(shot.props_in_shot || []).map(k => ({ kind: 'keep', text: `prop ${k}: use current state (holder/location)` })),
          { kind: 'keep', text: `location ${sc.location_key}, ${sc.time_of_day} lighting stays consistent` },
          ...Object.entries((shot.state_changes.characters) || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({ kind: 'change', text: `${k} changes: ${JSON.stringify(v)}` })),
          ...Object.entries((shot.state_changes.props) || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({ kind: 'change', text: `prop ${k} changes: ${JSON.stringify(v)}` })),
        ];
        scene.shot_ids.push(shot.shot_id); shots.push(shot); prev = shot;
      });
    }
  }
  // second pass: end-frame transitions need the next shot; questions need both neighbours
  shots.forEach((s, i) => {
    s.next_shot_id = shots[i + 1] ? shots[i + 1].shot_id : null;
    s.end_frame_transition = endFrameTransition({ shot: s, next: shots[i + 1] });
    s.questions = shotQuestions(s, scenes.find(x => x.scene_id === s.scene_id), i ? shots[i - 1] : null);
  });
  const planned_runtime = r1(shots.reduce((t, s) => t + s.duration_target, 0));
  if (Math.abs(planned_runtime - bible.runtime_target) / bible.runtime_target > 0.2) warnings.push(`planned runtime ${planned_runtime}s is >20% off target ${bible.runtime_target}s`);
  return { scenes, shots, planned_runtime, warnings, limits: { minShot, maxShot } };
}

module.exports = { planFilm, openingTransition, endFrameTransition };

'use strict';
/**
 * Shot request compiler: turns (shot spec + continuity state + assets + previous end frame)
 * into ONE provider request. Only references relevant to this shot are attached (capped),
 * the previous shot's ACTUAL end frame is the primary visual handoff (also used as the start
 * image), and dialogue is carried verbatim — compaction never touches it.
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { slug, sha256, stableStringify } = require('./util');

const DIALOGUE_HEAD = 'DIALOGUE (verbatim; speak exactly these words, do not paraphrase, add or remove words):';
const dialogueBlock = (lines) => lines.length ? `${DIALOGUE_HEAD}\n${lines.map(l => `[${l.speaker}] "${l.text}"`).join('\n')}` : '';

/** Parse the dialogue back out of a compiled prompt (used to prove nothing was altered in transit). */
function extractDialogueFromPrompt(prompt) {
  const i = prompt.indexOf(DIALOGUE_HEAD); if (i < 0) return [];
  return prompt.slice(i + DIALOGUE_HEAD.length).split('\n').map(l => /^\[([^\]]+)\] "([\s\S]*)"$/.exec(l.trim())).filter(Boolean).map(m => ({ speaker: m[1], text: m[2] }));
}

function compileShotRequest({ shot, before, after, bible, assets, previous, adjustments = [], attempt, outDir, generationDuration, maxRefs = 6, maxPromptChars = 3800 }) {
  const { registry, ids } = assets;
  const adj = new Set(adjustments);
  const boosted = adjustments.some(a => a.endsWith('_boost') || a === 'motion_context');
  const cap = boosted ? maxRefs + 3 : maxRefs;
  const chars = shot.characters.map(k => bible.characters.find(c => c.key === k)).filter(Boolean);

  // ---- references in priority order ---------------------------------------------------------------
  const tiers = [];
  const prevEnd = previous && previous.end_frame;
  if (prevEnd) tiers.push({ p: 0, kind: 'previous_end_frame', file: prevEnd });
  const characters = chars.map(c => ({ key: c.key, character_id: ids.characters[c.key], files: [] }));
  chars.forEach((c, i) => {
    const id = ids.characters[c.key];
    const m = registry.refPath('character', id, 'master_reference'); if (m) { tiers.push({ p: 1, kind: 'character', ci: i, role: 'master_reference', file: m }); }
  });
  const loc = registry.refPath('location', shot.location_id, 'reference'); if (loc) tiers.push({ p: 2, kind: 'location', file: loc });
  chars.forEach((c, i) => {
    const id = ids.characters[c.key]; const w = after.characters[c.key] && after.characters[c.key].wardrobe;
    const changed = w && w !== c.canonical.wardrobe_default;
    if (changed || adj.has('wardrobe_ref_boost')) { const wr = registry.refPath('character', id, `wardrobe_${slug(w).slice(0, 40)}`); if (wr) tiers.push({ p: adj.has('wardrobe_ref_boost') ? 1.5 : 3, kind: 'character', ci: i, role: 'wardrobe', file: wr }); }
  });
  const props = [];
  for (const k of shot.props_in_shot || []) { const f = registry.refPath('prop', ids.props[k], 'reference'); if (f) { props.push({ prop_id: ids.props[k], key: k, path: f }); tiers.push({ p: adj.has('prop_ref_boost') ? 1.6 : 4, kind: 'prop', pi: props.length - 1, file: f }); } }
  if (adj.has('identity_boost')) chars.forEach((c, i) => { for (const role of ['front', 'three_quarter']) { const f = registry.refPath('character', ids.characters[c.key], role); if (f) tiers.push({ p: 1.4, kind: 'character', ci: i, role, file: f }); } });
  if (adj.has('location_ref_boost') && loc) tiers.push({ p: 1.7, kind: 'location_dup', file: loc });   // (kept: same file, flagged for weight by the provider adapter)
  const supportFrames = [];
  if ((shot.motion_critical || adj.has('motion_context')) && previous && previous.support_frames) for (const f of previous.support_frames) if (f) tiers.push({ p: 5, kind: 'support', file: f });
  tiers.sort((a, b) => a.p - b.p);
  const kept = tiers.slice(0, cap), dropped = tiers.slice(cap).map(t => `${t.kind}:${path.basename(t.file)}`);
  let location = null;
  for (const t of kept) {
    if (t.kind === 'character') characters[t.ci].files.push({ role: t.role, path: t.file });
    else if (t.kind === 'location' || t.kind === 'location_dup') location = { location_id: shot.location_id, path: t.file, weight: t.kind === 'location_dup' ? 'high' : 'normal' };
    else if (t.kind === 'support') supportFrames.push(t.file);
  }
  const keptProps = kept.filter(t => t.kind === 'prop').map(t => props[t.pi]);

  // ---- prompt text -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const sec = {};
  sec.STYLE = `STYLE: ${typeof shot.visual_style === 'object' ? Object.values(shot.visual_style).join('; ') : shot.visual_style}. Cinematic, photorealistic.`;
  sec.LOCATION = `LOCATION: ${shot.location_key}, ${after.environment.time_of_day}, ${after.environment.lighting}.`;
  sec.CHARACTERS = 'CHARACTERS (match reference images; current state below):\n' + chars.map(c => {
    const st = after.characters[c.key]; const k = c.canonical;
    return `- ${c.name}: ${k.hair}, ${k.eyes}, ${k.face}${k.marks && k.marks !== 'none' ? `, ${k.marks}` : ''}. Wearing: ${st.wardrobe}.${st.injuries.length ? ` Injuries: ${st.injuries.join(', ')}.` : ''}${st.holding.length ? ` Holding: ${st.holding.join(', ')}.` : ''}`;
  }).join('\n');
  const pr = Object.entries(after.props).filter(([k]) => (shot.props_in_shot || []).includes(k)).map(([k, p]) => `${k}: ${p.held ? `held by ${p.owner}` : p.location ? `at ${p.location}` : 'in scene'}`);
  if (pr.length) sec.PROPS = `PROPS: ${pr.join('; ')}.`;
  sec.OPENING = `OPENING (${shot.opening_transition.type}): ${shot.opening_transition.instruction}${previous && previous.end_frame ? ' The first frame must continue from the provided previous end frame.' : ''}`;
  sec.ACTION = `ACTION: ${shot.action}`;
  sec.CAMERA = `CAMERA: ${shot.camera}.`;
  sec.END = `END STATE: ${shot.end_frame_transition.instruction}`;
  sec.CONTINUITY = 'CONTINUITY: ' + shot.continuity_requirements.filter(r => r.kind === 'keep').map(r => r.text).join(' | ');
  const lines = [];
  const first = chars[0] && after.characters[chars[0].key];
  if (adj.has('identity_boost')) lines.push('IDENTITY LOCK: ' + chars.map(c => `${c.name} must match the reference portraits exactly (${c.canonical.hair}; ${c.canonical.eyes}; ${c.canonical.face}).`).join(' '));
  if (adj.has('wardrobe_explicit')) lines.push('WARDROBE LOCK: ' + chars.map(c => `${c.name} wears ${after.characters[c.key].wardrobe}, unchanged from the previous shot.`).join(' '));
  if (adj.has('injury_explicit')) lines.push('INJURIES: ' + chars.map(c => `${c.name} ${after.characters[c.key].injuries.length ? 'still shows ' + after.characters[c.key].injuries.join(', ') : 'has no injuries'}.`).join(' '));
  if (adj.has('prop_state_explicit')) lines.push('PROP STATE: ' + (pr.join('; ') || 'no props'));
  if (adj.has('lighting_explicit')) lines.push(`LIGHTING LOCK: ${after.environment.lighting}; no change in time of day.`);
  if (adj.has('transition_explicit')) lines.push(`TRANSITION LOCK: ${shot.opening_transition.instruction} The first frame must match the previous end frame; keep screen direction.`);
  if (lines.length) sec.RETRY = 'CORRECTIONS FOR THIS ATTEMPT:\n' + lines.join('\n');
  const dlg = dialogueBlock(shot.dialogue);

  const order = ['STYLE', 'LOCATION', 'CHARACTERS', 'PROPS', 'OPENING', 'ACTION', 'CAMERA', 'END', 'CONTINUITY', 'RETRY'];
  const droppable = ['CONTINUITY', 'STYLE', 'CAMERA'];   // compaction order; dialogue + action + retry lines never dropped
  const render = () => order.filter(k => sec[k]).map(k => sec[k]).concat(dlg ? [dlg] : []).join('\n\n');
  let prompt = render(), compacted = [];
  for (const k of droppable) { if (prompt.length <= maxPromptChars) break; delete sec[k]; compacted.push(k); prompt = render(); }

  const req = {
    shot_id: shot.shot_id, previous_shot_id: shot.previous_shot_id, attempt, duration: generationDuration,
    prompt, prompt_compacted: compacted, dialogue_lines: shot.dialogue, dialogue_sha256: sha256(stableStringify(shot.dialogue)),
    references: { characters, location, props: keptProps, previous_end_frame: prevEnd || null, support_frames: supportFrames },
    references_dropped: dropped, start_image: prevEnd || null,
    expected_state: null, adjustments, out_dir: outDir,
  };
  return req;
}

module.exports = { compileShotRequest, extractDialogueFromPrompt, dialogueBlock, DIALOGUE_HEAD };

/**
 * Provider interfaces + MOCK implementations. Production video generation is LTX-2.3
 * (existing StreamVerse integration); the orchestrator only ever talks to these
 * interfaces, so the whole pipeline is testable without spending generation credits.
 *
 *  VideoGenerationProvider.generate(req) -> { video_path, meta }

 *  VisionProvider.observe(req)           -> observation (same schema the validator compares)

class VideoGenerationProvider { async generate() { throw new Error('not implemented'); } }

class MockImageGenerationProvider extends ImageGenerationProvider {

    this.calls.push({ kind, key, out, prompt, referenceImages: referenceImages.slice() });

  }

/**
 * Mock video provider. Renders a real, decodable MP4 (colour field + moving box + tone).
 * If `start_image` is supplied (the previous shot's end frame) the first 0.5 s shows THAT image,
 * so shot N genuinely begins on shot N-1's last frame — the handoff is observable in pixels.
 * It also writes a sidecar `.meta.json` recording (a) exactly which reference files it received,
 * and (b) the state it "drew". `faults(req)` may return overrides to simulate bad generations.
 */
class MockVideoGenerationProvider extends VideoGenerationProvider {
  constructor({ faults = () => null, width = 320, height = 568, fps = 24, withAudio = true, failDecode = () => false } = {}) {
    super(); Object.assign(this, { faults, width, height, fps, withAudio, failDecode }); this.calls = [];
  }
  async generate(req) {
    const { shot_id, attempt, duration, out_dir } = req;
    ensureDir(out_dir);
    const video = path.join(out_dir, 'video.mp4');
    const { width: W, height: H, fps } = this;
    const dur = Math.max(0.6, Number(duration));
    const head = req.start_image ? 0.5 : 0;
    const color = hex6(`${shot_id}:${attempt}`);
    const inputs = [], graph = [];
    let n = 0;
    if (head) { inputs.push('-loop', '1', '-t', String(head), '-i', req.start_image); graph.push(`[${n}:v]scale=${W}:${H},setsar=1,fps=${fps},format=yuv420p[a]`); n++; }
    graph.push(`color=c=0x${color}:s=${W}x${H}:r=${fps}:d=${(dur - head).toFixed(3)},drawbox=x='mod(t*60\\,${W - 50})':y=${Math.round(H / 2)}:w=50:h=50:color=white:t=fill,format=yuv420p[b]`);
    graph.push(head ? '[a][b]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[v]' : '[b]null[v]');
    const args = ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', ...inputs, '-filter_complex', graph.join(';')];
    if (this.withAudio) { args.push('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `sine=frequency=${300 + (parseInt(color.slice(0, 2), 16) % 300)}:sample_rate=44100:duration=${dur.toFixed(3)}`); }
    args.push('-map', '[v]'); if (this.withAudio) args.push('-map', `${n + 0}:a`.replace(`${n}:a`, `${inputs.length ? 1 : 0}:a`));
    args.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'ultrafast', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-r', String(fps), '-t', dur.toFixed(3));
    if (this.withAudio) args.push('-c:a', 'aac', '-shortest');
    args.push(video);
    await run(ffmpegBin(), args, { timeoutMs: 120000 });
    if (this.failDecode(req)) fs.truncateSync(video, Math.floor(fs.statSync(video).size / 3));   // simulate corruption

    const refs = [];
    const add = (kind, key, p) => { if (p && fs.existsSync(p)) refs.push({ kind, key, path: p, sha256: sha256File(p) }); };
    for (const c of req.references.characters || []) for (const f of c.files) add(`character:${f.role}`, c.character_id, f.path);
    if (req.references.location) add('location', req.references.location.location_id, req.references.location.path);
    for (const p of req.references.props || []) add('prop', p.prop_id, p.path);
    add('previous_end_frame', req.previous_shot_id, req.references.previous_end_frame);
    for (const f of req.references.support_frames || []) add('support_frame', req.previous_shot_id, f);
    add('start_image', shot_id, req.start_image);

    const expected = req.expected_state;
    const rendered = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(expected));
    const fault = this.faults(req, { refs });
    if (fault) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fault)) rendered[k] = v;
    const meta = { shot_id, attempt, duration: dur, refs_received: refs, prompt_sha256: sha256(req.prompt), dialogue_in_prompt: req.dialogue_lines, adjustments: req.adjustments || [], rendered, fault: fault ? Object.keys(fault) : [] };
    writeJson(path.join(out_dir, 'provider.meta.json'), meta);
    this.calls.push({ shot_id, attempt, refs: refs.map(r => `${r.kind}:${r.key}`), adjustments: req.adjustments || [] });
    return { video_path: video, meta };
  }
}

/** Mock vision: "looks" at the clip by reading what the mock renderer recorded. */

'use strict';
/**
 * Film-level QC. A film is only COMPLETE if every gate passes. Every check evaluates real
 * artefacts on disk (plan, approved clips, continuity records, generation records, master),
 * not flags set by the code that produced them.
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { readJson, sha256File } = require('./util');
const { checkStory, flattenBeats } = require('./storyQc');
const { extractDialogueFromPrompt } = require('./promptCompiler');
const { probe } = require('../branding');
const { sha256, stableStringify } = require('./util');

const gate = () => { const checks = []; return { checks, add: (name, passed, detail = '') => checks.push({ name, passed: !!passed, detail }), get passed() { return checks.every(c => c.passed); } }; };

async function runFilmQc(orch, assembly, { runtimeRange, minPostRevealShare = 0.15 } = {}) {
  const { shots } = orch.plan(); const bible = orch.bible;
  const recs = shots.map(s => ({ shot: s, cont: readJson(orch.f(`continuity/${s.shot_id}.json`)), appr: orch.store.getApproved(s.shot_id) }));
  const attemptDir = (r) => r.appr ? orch.store.attemptDir(r.shot.shot_id, r.appr.attempt) : null;
  const gen = (r) => readJson(path.join(attemptDir(r), 'generation.json'));
  const G = { story: gate(), character: gate(), visual: gate(), dialogue: gate(), media: gate(), assembly: gate() };

  // ── STORY ──
  const sq = checkStory(bible, { runtimeRange, minPostRevealShare });
  G.story.add('bible + screenplay rules (standalone, concrete threat, mystery answered)', sq.valid, sq.errors.join('; '));
  const beatIds = flattenBeats(bible).map(b => b.beat.id), shotBeatIds = [...new Set(shots.map(s => s.beat_id))];
  G.story.add('every beat is covered by a shot, in order', JSON.stringify(beatIds) === JSON.stringify(shotBeatIds));
  const iRev = shots.findIndex(s => s.marks.includes('reveal')), iRes = shots.findIndex(s => s.marks.includes('threat_resolved')), iAns = shots.findIndex(s => s.marks.includes('mystery_answered'));
  G.story.add('reveal precedes threat resolution and mystery answer in the shot order', iRev >= 0 && iRes > iRev && iAns > iRev);
  const total = recs.reduce((t, r) => t + (r.cont ? r.cont.actual_duration : 0), 0), post = recs.slice(iRev + 1).reduce((t, r) => t + (r.cont ? r.cont.actual_duration : 0), 0);
  G.story.add(`>= ${minPostRevealShare * 100}% of actual runtime follows the reveal`, total > 0 && post / total >= minPostRevealShare, `${((post / total) * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);

  G.dialogue.add('all screenplay dialogue lines present once, in order', JSON.stringify(planned) === JSON.stringify(storyLines));
  const infos = await Promise.all(recs.map(r => r.appr ? probe(r.appr.video) : null));
  G.dialogue.add('dialogue shots have audio and enough time for the speech', recs.every((r, i) => !r.shot.dialogue.length || (infos[i] && infos[i].hasAudio && infos[i].duration + 0.05 >= r.shot.dialogue_duration)));

  G.assembly.add('master is playable', !!mInfo && mInfo.duration > 0);

  G.assembly.add('master duration matches the sum of approved shots', !!mInfo && Math.abs(mInfo.duration - sum) <= Math.max(1, sum * 0.02 + 0.1 * shots.length), mInfo ? `${mInfo.duration.toFixed(1)}s vs ${sum.toFixed(1)}s` : 'no master');
  G.assembly.add('master has an audio track', !!mInfo && mInfo.hasAudio);
  G.assembly.add('StreamVerse Studio logo + name burned into the master', !!rp && rp.branding && rp.branding.applied && rp.branding.logoDiff > 3, rp && rp.branding ? `logoDiff=${rp.branding.logoDiff && rp.branding.logoDiff.toFixed(1)}` : 'no branding');
  if (runtimeRange) {
    const hasMax = runtimeRange.max != null;
    const label = hasMax ? `runtime within ${runtimeRange.min}-${runtimeRange.max}s` : `runtime >= ${runtimeRange.min}s`;
    G.assembly.add(label, !!mInfo && mInfo.duration >= runtimeRange.min && (!hasMax || mInfo.duration <= runtimeRange.max), mInfo ? `${mInfo.duration.toFixed(0)}s` : '');
  }

  const gates = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(G).map(([k, g]) => [k, { passed: g.passed, checks: g.checks }]));
  return { passed: Object.values(G).every(g => g.passed), gates };
}

'use strict';
/**
 * VANTA AI Film Studio — HTTP surface, mounted under /api/films.
 *
 * Every generation-triggering endpoint follows the existing StreamVerse convention
 * (see /api/generate-shot in index.js): validate, kick off the work in the
 * background, return immediately. All real state lives in FilmOrchestrator's on-disk
 * state (films/<id>/state.json + events.jsonl), so the dashboard polls GET /api/films/:id
 * rather than holding a request open, and a server restart loses no progress.
 *
 * Production video/image/vision providers are injected via `getProviders()` (a function,
 * not a static object) so this module never hard-codes a vendor; until real LTX-2.3 image
 * and vision providers are wired in (see AUDIT.md "not done"), it defaults to the mocks
 * so the endpoints are usable end-to-end for wiring/dashboard work today.
 */
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { FilmOrchestrator } = require('./orchestrator');
const { LlmStoryProvider, MockStoryProvider } = require('./storyProvider');
const { pickFreshBrief, BriefHistory } = require('./freshBrief');
const { finalizeFilm } = require('./finalize');
const { readJson } = require('./util');
const { nextFilmId } = require('./filmRegistry');

function buildRouter({ express, dataDir, getProviders, runtimeRange = { min: 900, max: null }, callLLM }) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const briefHistory = new BriefHistory(path.join(dataDir, 'brief_history.json'));
  const filmsDir = path.join(dataDir, 'films');
  const running = new Map();                                   // film_id -> { orch, promise } (in THIS process only; state on disk is the source of truth)

  const storyProvider = () => (callLLM ? new LlmStoryProvider({ callLLM }) : new MockStoryProvider());
  const loadOrch = (filmId) => {
    const bible = readJson(path.join(filmsDir, filmId, 'bible.json'));
    if (!bible) return null;
    return new FilmOrchestrator({ dataDir, bible, providers: getProviders(), options: { runtimeRange } });
  };

  router.get('/', (req, res) => {
    if (!fs.existsSync(filmsDir)) return res.json({ films: [] });
    const films = fs.readdirSync(filmsDir).map(id => { try { return loadOrch(id).summary(); } catch (e) { return { film_id: id, status: 'error', error: e.message }; } });
    res.json({ films });
  });

  router.post('/', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { theme, threatType, threatSeed, threatClock, runtime, seed } = req.body || {};
      const brief = (theme && threatSeed)
        ? { theme, threat_type: threatType || 'entity', threat_seed: threatSeed, threat_clock: threatClock || 'time is short' }
        : pickFreshBrief({ history: briefHistory.all(), seed });
      const bible = await storyProvider().generate(brief, { runtime: runtime || 1080, runtimeRange });
      bible.film_id = nextFilmId(dataDir, bible.title);       // never trust the story provider's own id (mock's is a constant; an LLM's could collide too)
      briefHistory.record(brief, bible.film_id);
      const orch = new FilmOrchestrator({ dataDir, bible, providers: getProviders(), options: { runtimeRange } });
      await orch.prepareAssets(); const plan = orch.plan();
      res.status(201).json({ ok: true, film_id: bible.film_id, brief, shots: plan.shots.length, planned_runtime: plan.planned_runtime, warnings: plan.warnings });
    } catch (err) { console.error('[Films] create failed:', err.message); res.status(422).json({ ok: false, error: err.message, errors: err.errors }); }
  });

  router.get('/:id', (req, res) => {
    const orch = loadOrch(req.params.id); if (!orch) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'not found' });
    res.json(orch.summary());
  });

  router.get('/:id/events', (req, res) => {
    const orch = loadOrch(req.params.id); if (!orch) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'not found' });
    const since = Number(req.query.since) || 0;
    res.json({ events: orch.events.read().slice(since) });
  });

  router.post('/:id/generate', (req, res) => {
    const orch = loadOrch(req.params.id); if (!orch) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'not found' });
    if (running.has(orch.bible.film_id)) return res.status(409).json({ ok: false, error: 'already generating', status: orch.summary().status });
    const p = orch.run()
      .then(() => finalizeFilm(orch, { runtimeRange }))
      .catch(err => console.error(`[Films] ${orch.bible.film_id} generation stopped:`, err.message))
      .finally(() => running.delete(orch.bible.film_id));
    running.set(orch.bible.film_id, { orch, promise: p });
    res.status(202).json({ ok: true, status: 'started', film_id: orch.bible.film_id });
  });

  router.post('/:id/shots/:shotId/regenerate', async (req, res) => {
    const orch = loadOrch(req.params.id); if (!orch) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'not found' });
    if (running.has(orch.bible.film_id)) return res.status(409).json({ ok: false, error: 'film is currently generating' });
    try { await orch.regenerateShot(req.params.shotId); res.json({ ok: true, summary: orch.summary() }); }
    catch (err) { res.status(422).json({ ok: false, error: err.message }); }
  });

  router.post('/:id/finalize', (req, res) => {
    const orch = loadOrch(req.params.id); if (!orch) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'not found' });
    finalizeFilm(orch, { runtimeRange }).catch(err => console.error(`[Films] ${orch.bible.film_id} finalize failed:`, err.message));
    res.status(202).json({ ok: true, status: 'finalizing' });
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = { buildRouter };

'use strict';
/**
 * Shot store with attempt quarantine. An approved shot is NEVER silently overwritten:
 *
 *   shots/<shot_id>/attempt_001/ attempt_002/ ...   every try, kept for debugging
 *   shots/<shot_id>/approved/                        hard links to the canonical attempt's files
 *   shots/<shot_id>/approved.json                    pointer: which attempt is canonical + sha256s
 *   shots/<shot_id>/superseded/<n>/                  previous canonical versions (explicit regenerate only)
 */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { ensureDir, writeJson, readJson, sha256File, pad } = require('./util');

const CANON_FILES = ['video.mp4', 'end_frame.png', 'end_m1.png', 'end_m3.png', 'validation.json', 'generation.json', 'provider.meta.json'];

class ShotStore {
  constructor(filmDir) { this.root = ensureDir(path.join(filmDir, 'shots')); }
  dir(id) { return ensureDir(path.join(this.root, id)); }
  attemptNumbers(id) { const d = this.dir(id); return fs.readdirSync(d).filter(n => /^attempt_\d+$/.test(n)).map(n => Number(n.slice(8))).sort((a, b) => a - b); }
  nextAttempt(id) { const n = (this.attemptNumbers(id).pop() || 0) + 1; const dir = ensureDir(path.join(this.dir(id), `attempt_${pad(n)}`)); return { n, dir }; }
  attemptDir(id, n) { return path.join(this.dir(id), `attempt_${pad(n)}`); }

  approve(id, n, { supersede = false } = {}) {
    const base = this.dir(id), ptr = path.join(base, 'approved.json'), cur = readJson(ptr);
    if (cur) {
      if (!supersede) throw new Error(`refusing to overwrite approved shot ${id} (attempt ${cur.attempt}); use supersede`);
      const k = fs.existsSync(path.join(base, 'superseded')) ? fs.readdirSync(path.join(base, 'superseded')).length + 1 : 1;
      const dest = ensureDir(path.join(base, 'superseded', String(k)));
      fs.renameSync(path.join(base, 'approved'), path.join(dest, 'approved')); fs.renameSync(ptr, path.join(dest, 'approved.json'));
    }
    const src = this.attemptDir(id, n), dst = ensureDir(path.join(base, 'approved')), files = {};
    for (const f of CANON_FILES) {
      const s = path.join(src, f); if (!fs.existsSync(s)) continue;
      const d = path.join(dst, f); try { fs.linkSync(s, d); } catch { fs.copyFileSync(s, d); }
      files[f] = sha256File(d);
    }
    if (!files['video.mp4']) throw new Error(`attempt ${n} of ${id} has no video.mp4`);
    const rec = { shot_id: id, attempt: n, approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), files };
    writeJson(ptr, rec); return rec;
  }
  approvedRecord(id) { return readJson(path.join(this.dir(id), 'approved.json')); }

  /** Cheap integrity check (exists + sha256). Full decode is done at generation time, not on every resume. */
  getApproved(id) {
    const rec = this.approvedRecord(id); if (!rec) return null;
    const d = path.join(this.dir(id), 'approved');
    for (const [f, h] of Object.entries(rec.files)) { const p = path.join(d, f); if (!fs.existsSync(p) || sha256File(p) !== h) return null; }
    const p = (f) => rec.files[f] ? path.join(d, f) : null;
    return { ...rec, video: p('video.mp4'), end_frame: p('end_frame.png'), support_frames: [p('end_m1.png'), p('end_m3.png')].filter(Boolean), dir: d };
  }
}
module.exports = { ShotStore };

async function exportSocial(orch, { master, raw, outDir, brandCfg = settings() }) {
  ensureDir(outDir);
  const info = await probe(master); const portrait = info.height / info.width >= 1.7;
  const video = path.join(outDir, 'social_vertical.mp4'); let method;
  if (portrait) { await run(ffmpegBin(), ['-nostdin', '-y', '-v', 'error', '-i', master, '-c', 'copy', '-movflags', '+faststart', video]); method = 'remux (already 9:16, already branded)'; }

    await brandMasterFile({ inputPath: tmp, outputPath: video, cfg: brandCfg }); fs.rmSync(tmp, { force: true }); method = 'crop 9:16 + brand';
  }

  const b = orch.bible; const shots = orch.plan().shots;
  const pick = shots.find(s => (s.marks || []).includes('climax')) || shots[Math.floor(shots.length / 2)];

  const meta = { film_id: b.film_id, title: b.title, description: `${b.logline} A complete standalone film.`, theme: b.theme, hashtags: tags, duration: (await probe(video)).duration, aspect: '9:16', files: { video, cover }, cover_source_shot: pick.shot_id, method };
  writeJson(path.join(outDir, 'social.json'), meta); return meta;

'use strict';
/**
 * Story providers. The LLM invents the film; deterministic code validates it.
 *
 *   LlmStoryProvider  - generates the film ACT BY ACT, not as one giant JSON blob.
 *                        A single-call "write the whole film" design cannot scale:
 *                        every real LLM API caps a single response's output size,
 *                        so once a film is long enough (more scenes/beats than one
 *                        response can hold) the JSON comes back truncated, fails
 *                        validation, and retries the exact same oversized request —
 *                        an unwinnable loop that gets WORSE the longer the film is,
 *                        i.e. exactly backwards for "no cap on runtime". Generating
 *                        one act at a time keeps every individual call small and
 *                        bounded regardless of total film length, and a bad act can
 *                        be retried on its own instead of regenerating everything.
 *                        Continuity across acts is carried by a state digest built
 *                        from the ACTUAL beats generated so far (src/film/continuity.js
 *                        replayed over the real scenes), not a separate summary the
 *                        LLM could drift from.
 *   MockStoryProvider - deterministic valid film for tests / dry runs.
 */
const { checkStory, checkActScenes } = require('./storyQc');
const { ACTS } = require('./filmBible');
const { initialLedger, applyShot } = require('./continuity');
const { pad } = require('./util');

// Scene density: ~1 scene per minute of runtime, matching the ratio already used
// elsewhere in this codebase (configCore.js computeExpectedSceneCount) for the same
// kind of movie-length content — kept consistent rather than inventing a new ratio.
// No ceiling: a 45-minute film simply asks for ~45 scenes, split across 5 act-calls.
function totalSceneTarget(runtimeSeconds) {
  return Math.max(7, Math.round(runtimeSeconds / 60));
}
function sceneCountForAct(bible, actId, total) {
  const act = bible.acts.find(a => a.id === actId);
  const share = act ? act.share : 1 / ACTS.length;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(total * share));
}

/** What must / must not appear in a given act, derived from the skeleton the LLM already committed to. */
function actRequirements(bible, actId) {
  const required = [], forbidden = [], counts = {};
  const introducedAt = ACTS.indexOf(bible.concrete_threat?.introduced_in || 'beginning');
  if (ACTS.indexOf(actId) === introducedAt) required.push('threat_introduced');
  if (actId === bible.mystery?.reveal_act) required.push('reveal'); else forbidden.push('reveal');
  if (actId === 'resolution') counts.threat_escalation = 2;   // checked cumulatively via priorMarkCounts once the whole film's beats are known
  if (actId === 'resolution') required.push('threat_resolved', 'mystery_answered', 'final_image');
  else forbidden.push('threat_resolved', 'mystery_answered', 'final_image');
  return { required, forbidden, counts };
}

/** Compact, human-readable snapshot of where the story actually stands, built from the real generated beats (never a separately-written, driftable summary). */
function stateDigest(bible, scenesSoFar) {
  if (!scenesSoFar.length) return 'Nothing has happened yet — this is the opening of the film.';
  const stubIds = { characters: {}, locations: {}, props: {} };
  let state = initialLedger(bible, stubIds);
  for (const sc of scenesSoFar) for (const bt of sc.beats) state = applyShot(state, { ...bt, characters: bt.characters_in_shot || [], scene_id: sc.scene_id }, sc);
  const chars = Object.entries(state.characters).map(([k, c]) => `${k}: wearing ${c.wardrobe}${c.injuries.length ? `, injuries: ${c.injuries.join(', ')}` : ''}${c.holding.length ? `, holding: ${c.holding.join(', ')}` : ''}`).join('; ');
  const props = Object.entries(state.props).filter(([, p]) => p.present || p.held).map(([k, p]) => `${k}: ${p.held ? `held by ${p.owner}` : `at ${p.location || 'last seen location'}`}`).join('; ') || 'none notable';
  const last = scenesSoFar[scenesSoFar.length - 1];
  return [
    `Last location: ${state.environment.location_id || last.location_key}, ${state.environment.time_of_day}.`,
    `Characters: ${chars}.`,
    `Props in play: ${props}.`,
    `Known to characters so far: ${state.story.known_info.join(', ') || 'nothing established yet'}.`,
    `Threat level so far: ${state.story.threat_level}.`,
    `Most recent event: ${state.story.recent_event}`,
  ].join('\n');
}

function buildSkeletonPrompt(brief, { runtime = 1080, revealAct = 'escalation' } = {}) {
  const system = [
    'You are the head writer of VANTA / StreamVerse Studios. You write ONE complete standalone short film.',
    'It is NOT an episode. There is no series, no season, no sequel. The film must be understandable and finished on its own.',
    'Return ONLY JSON.',
  ].join(' ');
  const user = `Plan a standalone film (~${Math.round(runtime / 60)} minutes) — the FILM BIBLE ONLY. Do not write scenes yet; that comes next, act by act.

THEME (must be explored, not just mentioned): ${brief.theme}
CONCRETE THREAT (type: ${brief.threat_type}): ${brief.threat_seed}. Clock: ${brief.threat_clock}.
The threat must be a perceivable thing, person or event with a physical form on screen, real stakes, and rising escalations.
Never use an abstraction (fear, grief, loneliness...) as the threat.

STRUCTURE (mandatory): five acts in order: beginning, development, escalation, climax, resolution, with "share" fractions of total runtime summing to 1.0 (resolution >= 0.10).
The MYSTERY must be revealed in the "${revealAct}" act and then ANSWERED in the ending — plan clues spread across at least two different acts, and be specific about how the ending confirms the answer on screen. No cliffhanger, no "to be continued", no hook for another film anywhere, including in the ending fields.
Be genuinely inventive: give this film a distinct voice, a specific world, and characters with concrete, unusual detail rather than generic archetypes. Avoid reusing common tropes verbatim — surprise within the required structure.

JSON schema (exactly this shape, no scenes field):
{ "film_id":"", "title":"", "genre":"", "runtime_target":${runtime}, "logline":"", "theme":"", "standalone":true,
  "concrete_threat":{"name":"","type":"${brief.threat_type}","physical_form":"","how_it_harms":"","stakes":"","clock":"","introduced_in":"beginning|development","escalations":["",""],"resolution_method":""},
  "mystery":{"question":"","answer":"","clues":[{"act":"","clue":""}],"reveal_act":"${revealAct}","reveal_summary":""},
  "acts":[{"id":"beginning","share":0.2,"summary":""},{"id":"development","share":0.25,"summary":""},{"id":"escalation","share":0.25,"summary":""},{"id":"climax","share":0.15,"summary":""},{"id":"resolution","share":0.15,"summary":""}],
  "characters":[{"key":"","name":"","role":"protagonist|antagonist|ally|supporting","description":"","canonical":{"hair":"","eyes":"","face":"","body":"","marks":"","age_representation":"","wardrobe_default":"","voice_identity":"","personality":""}}],
  "locations":[{"key":"","name":"","description":""}],
  "props":[{"key":"","name":"","description":""}],
  "visual_style":{}, "continuity_rules":[""],
  "ending":{"type":"twist|emotional|tragic|hopeful|ambiguous_tone|shocking","resolves_threat":true,"resolves_mystery":true,"threat_outcome":"destroyed|contained|escaped|defeated|neutralised|paid_for","mystery_answer_shown":"","aftermath":"","final_image":""}
}`;
  return { system, user };
}

function buildActPrompt(bible, actId, { sceneCount, startSceneNumber, isLastAct, requirements }) {
  const filmKey = bible.film_id;
  const act = bible.acts.find(a => a.id === actId);
  const priorScenes = (bible.scenes || []).filter(s => ACTS.indexOf(s.act) < ACTS.indexOf(actId));
  const system = 'You are the head writer of VANTA / StreamVerse Studios, continuing a film you already planned. Return ONLY JSON: a single array of scene objects for the requested act.';
  const clues = (bible.mystery.clues || []).filter(c => c.act === actId);
  const user = `FILM: "${bible.title}" — ${bible.logline}
THEME: ${bible.theme}
THREAT: ${bible.concrete_threat.name} (${bible.concrete_threat.physical_form}). Clock: ${bible.concrete_threat.clock}.
MYSTERY: ${bible.mystery.question}
CHARACTERS: ${bible.characters.map(c => `${c.key} (${c.name}, ${c.role}): ${c.canonical.hair}, ${c.canonical.eyes}, wears ${c.canonical.wardrobe_default} by default, voice: ${c.canonical.voice_identity}, personality: ${c.canonical.personality}`).join(' | ')}
LOCATIONS: ${bible.locations.map(l => `${l.key} (${l.name}): ${l.description}`).join(' | ')}
PROPS: ${bible.props.map(p => `${p.key} (${p.name}): ${p.description}`).join(' | ') || 'none defined'}

STORY SO FAR:
${stateDigest(bible, priorScenes)}

NOW WRITE ACT "${actId}" — ${act.summary}
This act should have about ${sceneCount} scene(s), numbered starting at S${pad(startSceneNumber)}, each with 1-3 beats.
${clues.length ? `Weave in these clues as something a character notices or finds: ${clues.map(c => c.clue).join('; ')}.` : ''}
${requirements.required.length ? `At least one beat in THIS act must carry the mark: ${requirements.required.join(', ')}.` : ''}
${requirements.counts.threat_escalation ? `Across the WHOLE film so far (all acts up to and including this one), there must be at least ${requirements.counts.threat_escalation} beats marked "threat_escalation" in total -- add one now if the running total is still short.` : ''}
${requirements.forbidden.length ? `Do NOT use these marks in this act: ${requirements.forbidden.join(', ')}.` : ''}
${isLastAct ? 'This is the FINAL act. The very last beat of the very last scene must be marked "final_image" and must show the world after the threat, with no cliffhanger or sequel language. Confirm the mystery\'s answer on screen (mark a beat "mystery_answered") and show the threat dealt with (mark a beat "threat_resolved").' : ''}
Keep continuity with the state above: characters keep their established wardrobe/injuries/held props unless a beat explicitly changes them; nobody acts on information they have not yet learned (use "uses_info" only for entries already known, from state_changes.story.known_info_add in a prior beat or this act's own earlier beats).
Give this act a genuinely creative, specific texture — concrete sensory detail, distinct character voice in dialogue, and inventive staging — while keeping the plot mechanics exactly as planned above.

Return ONLY a JSON array (no wrapper object) of scenes in this exact shape:
[{"scene_id":"S${pad(startSceneNumber)}","act":"${actId}","location_key":"","time_of_day":"","characters":[""],"summary":"","beats":[{"id":"S${pad(startSceneNumber)}B01","action":"","dialogue":[{"speaker":"","text":""}],"camera":"","exit_dir":"","marks":[],"characters_in_shot":[""],"props_in_shot":[""],"uses_info":[],"reveals":[],"state_changes":{"characters":{},"props":{},"environment":{},"story":{}}}]}]`;
  return { system, user };
}

class LlmStoryProvider {
  constructor({ callLLM, maxAttempts = 3, maxTokens = 6000, log = () => {} }) { Object.assign(this, { callLLM, maxAttempts, maxTokens, log }); }

  async _generateSkeleton(brief, opts) {
    let { system, user } = buildSkeletonPrompt(brief, opts);
    let lastErrors;
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= this.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      const bible = await this.callLLM(system, user, this.maxTokens, { useStream: false });
      bible.scenes = [];                                    // not written yet; keeps validateFilmBible's shape expectations happy
      const { validateFilmBible } = require('./filmBible');
      const q = validateFilmBible(bible, opts);
      if (q.valid) return bible;
      lastErrors = q.errors;
      this.log(`[Story] skeleton attempt ${attempt} rejected: ${q.errors.slice(0, 5).join(' | ')}`);
      user = `${user}\n\nYOUR PREVIOUS DRAFT WAS REJECTED. Fix every problem and return the complete JSON again:\n- ${q.errors.join('\n- ')}`;
    }
    const e = new Error(`Film Bible (skeleton) failed validation after ${this.maxAttempts} attempts: ${lastErrors.slice(0, 6).join('; ')}`); e.errors = lastErrors; throw e;
  }

  async _generateAct(bible, actId, ctx) {
    const requirements = actRequirements(bible, actId);
    let { system, user } = buildActPrompt(bible, actId, { ...ctx, requirements });
    let lastErrors;
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= this.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      const scenes = await this.callLLM(system, user, this.maxTokens, { useStream: false });
      const arr = Array.isArray(scenes) ? scenes : Array.isArray(scenes?.scenes) ? scenes.scenes : null;
      const q = arr ? checkActScenes(actId, arr, bible, { isLastAct: ctx.isLastAct, requiredMarks: requirements.required, requiredCounts: requirements.counts, forbiddenMarks: requirements.forbidden, globalBeatIds: ctx.globalBeatIds, globalSceneIds: ctx.globalSceneIds, priorMarkCounts: ctx.globalMarkCounts })
                    : { valid: false, errors: [`act "${actId}": response was not a JSON array of scenes`] };
      if (q.valid) return arr;
      lastErrors = q.errors;
      this.log(`[Story] act "${actId}" attempt ${attempt} rejected: ${q.errors.slice(0, 5).join(' | ')}`);
      user = `${user}\n\nYOUR PREVIOUS DRAFT WAS REJECTED. Fix every problem and return the complete JSON array again:\n- ${q.errors.join('\n- ')}`;
    }
    const e = new Error(`Act "${actId}" failed validation after ${this.maxAttempts} attempts: ${lastErrors.slice(0, 6).join('; ')}`); e.errors = lastErrors; throw e;
  }

  async generate(brief, { runtime = 1080, revealAct = 'escalation', runtimeRange } = {}) {
    const bible = await this._generateSkeleton(brief, { runtime, revealAct, runtimeRange });
    const total = totalSceneTarget(runtime);
    bible.scenes = [];
    const globalBeatIds = new Set(), globalSceneIds = new Set();
    const globalMarkCounts = {};
    let sceneNumber = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < ACTS.length; i++) {
      const actId = ACTS[i];
      const sceneCount = sceneCountForAct(bible, actId, total);
      const scenes = await this._generateAct(bible, actId, { sceneCount, startSceneNumber: sceneNumber, isLastAct: i === ACTS.length - 1, globalBeatIds, globalSceneIds, globalMarkCounts });
      for (const sc of scenes) { globalSceneIds.add(sc.scene_id); for (const bt of sc.beats) { globalBeatIds.add(bt.id); for (const m of bt.marks || []) globalMarkCounts[m] = (globalMarkCounts[m] || 0) + 1; } }
      bible.scenes.push(...scenes);
      sceneNumber += scenes.length;
      this.log(`[Story] act "${actId}" complete: ${scenes.length} scene(s), ${bible.scenes.length} total so far`);
    }
    // Final whole-film safety net: catches cross-act invariants (post-reveal share,
    // resolution runtime share) that only make sense once the full timeline exists.
    const q = checkStory(bible, { runtimeRange });
    if (!q.valid) {
      const e = new Error(`Assembled film failed final validation: ${q.errors.slice(0, 8).join('; ')}`); e.errors = q.errors; throw e;
    }
    bible.brief = brief;
    return bible;
  }
}

'use strict';
/**
 * Story QC — evaluates the SCREENPLAY (bible.scenes / beats) against the standalone,
 * concrete-threat, mystery-answered requirements. Pure function over data; used
 * (a) by the story provider to reject/repair a draft, and (b) by film QC as the
 * story gate.
 */
const { ACTS, CLIFFHANGER_RE, validateFilmBible } = require('./filmBible');

const REQUIRED_MARKS = ['threat_introduced', 'reveal', 'threat_resolved', 'mystery_answered', 'final_image'];

function flattenBeats(bible) {
  const out = [];
  for (const sc of bible.scenes || []) for (const bt of sc.beats || []) out.push({ scene: sc, beat: bt, act: sc.act, i: out.length });
  return out;
}

function checkScreenplay(bible, { minPostRevealShare = 0.15 } = {}) {
  const errors = [];
  const scenes = bible.scenes || [];
  if (!scenes.length) return { valid: false, errors: ['no scenes'] };

  // Acts present, in order
  const actIdx = scenes.map(s => ACTS.indexOf(s.act));
  if (actIdx.some(i => i < 0)) errors.push('scene with unknown act');
  for (let i = 1; i < actIdx.length; i++) if (actIdx[i] < actIdx[i - 1]) errors.push(`scene ${scenes[i].scene_id} is out of act order`);
  for (const a of ACTS) if (!scenes.some(s => s.act === a)) errors.push(`no scene in act "${a}"`);
  if (scenes[scenes.length - 1].act !== 'resolution') errors.push('final scene must be in the resolution act');

  const beats = flattenBeats(bible);
  if (!beats.length) return { valid: false, errors: [...errors, 'no beats'] };
  const first = (mark) => beats.find(b => (b.beat.marks || []).includes(mark));
  const all = (mark) => beats.filter(b => (b.beat.marks || []).includes(mark));
  for (const m of REQUIRED_MARKS) if (!first(m)) errors.push(`no beat marked "${m}"`);
  if (all('reveal').length !== 1) errors.push(`exactly one beat must be marked "reveal" (found ${all('reveal').length})`);
  if (all('threat_escalation').length < 2) errors.push('need >= 2 beats marked "threat_escalation"');

  const reveal = first('reveal'), resolved = first('threat_resolved'), answered = first('mystery_answered'), intro = first('threat_introduced');
  const finalImg = first('final_image');
  if (reveal && bible.mystery && reveal.act !== bible.mystery.reveal_act) errors.push(`reveal beat is in act "${reveal.act}" but mystery.reveal_act is "${bible.mystery.reveal_act}"`);
  if (reveal && ACTS.indexOf(reveal.act) > 3) errors.push('reveal must not occur in the resolution act');
  if (intro && ACTS.indexOf(intro.act) > 1) errors.push('threat must be introduced in beginning/development');

  if (reveal && resolved && answered) {
    if (!(resolved.i > reveal.i)) errors.push('threat_resolved must come AFTER the reveal');
    if (!(answered.i > reveal.i)) errors.push('mystery_answered must come AFTER the reveal (the ending answers it; the reveal alone is not an ending)');
    const post = (beats.length - 1 - reveal.i) / beats.length;
    if (post < minPostRevealShare) errors.push(`only ${(post * 100).toFixed(0)}% of the film follows the reveal (need >= ${minPostRevealShare * 100}%) — it would stop at the reveal`);
    if (resolved.act !== 'resolution' && resolved.act !== 'climax') errors.push('threat_resolved must be in climax or resolution');
    if (answered.act !== 'resolution' && answered.act !== 'climax') errors.push('mystery_answered must be in climax or resolution');
  }
  // Escalations must precede the resolution
  for (const e of all('threat_escalation')) if (resolved && e.i > resolved.i) errors.push('threat_escalation after threat_resolved');
  // Last beat is the final image and carries no hook language
  const last = beats[beats.length - 1];
  if (finalImg && finalImg.i !== last.i) errors.push('the final beat of the film must be the beat marked "final_image"');
  const finalText = `${last.beat.action || ''} ${(last.beat.dialogue || []).map(d => d.text).join(' ')}`;
  if (CLIFFHANGER_RE.test(finalText)) errors.push('final beat contains cliffhanger / sequel language');
  for (const b of beats) if (CLIFFHANGER_RE.test(`${b.beat.action || ''} ${(b.beat.dialogue || []).map(d => d.text).join(' ')}`)) { errors.push(`beat ${b.beat.id} contains cliffhanger / sequel language`); break; }

  // Beat ids unique
  const ids = beats.map(b => b.beat.id); if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) errors.push('beat ids not unique');
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}

/**
 * Structural checks on ONE act's freshly-generated scenes, usable the moment that
 * act comes back from the LLM (before the rest of the film exists). Lets a
 * chunked/act-by-act generator retry a single bad act instead of the whole film.
 * `globalBeatIds` is a Set the caller carries across acts to catch id collisions
 * introduced by a later act reusing an earlier act's beat/scene ids.
 */
function checkActScenes(actId, scenes, bible, { isLastAct = false, requiredMarks = [], requiredCounts = {}, forbiddenMarks = [], globalBeatIds = new Set(), globalSceneIds = new Set(), priorMarkCounts = {} } = {}) {
  const errors = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(scenes) || !scenes.length) return { valid: false, errors: [`act "${actId}": no scenes returned`] };
  for (const sc of scenes) {
    if (sc.act !== actId) errors.push(`scene ${sc.scene_id}: act field is "${sc.act}", expected "${actId}"`);
    if (globalSceneIds.has(sc.scene_id)) errors.push(`scene_id "${sc.scene_id}" collides with an earlier act`);
    if (!Array.isArray(sc.beats) || !sc.beats.length) { errors.push(`scene ${sc.scene_id}: no beats`); continue; }
    for (const bt of sc.beats) {
      if (globalBeatIds.has(bt.id)) errors.push(`beat id "${bt.id}" collides with an earlier act`);
      const text = `${bt.action || ''} ${(bt.dialogue || []).map(d => d.text).join(' ')}`;
      if (CLIFFHANGER_RE.test(text)) errors.push(`beat ${bt.id}: cliffhanger / sequel language`);
      for (const m of forbiddenMarks) if ((bt.marks || []).includes(m)) errors.push(`beat ${bt.id}: mark "${m}" is not allowed in act "${actId}"`);
    }
  }
  const markCounts = {};
  for (const bt of scenes.flatMap(sc => sc.beats || [])) for (const m of bt.marks || []) markCounts[m] = (markCounts[m] || 0) + 1;
  for (const m of requiredMarks) if (!markCounts[m]) errors.push(`act "${actId}": no beat marked "${m}" (required in this act)`);
  for (const [m, min] of Object.entries(requiredCounts)) {
    const totalSoFar = (priorMarkCounts[m] || 0) + (markCounts[m] || 0);
    if (totalSoFar < min) errors.push(`need >= ${min} beat(s) marked "${m}" across the film so far (have ${totalSoFar}); add more in act "${actId}" or a later act`);
  }
  if (isLastAct) {
    const last = scenes[scenes.length - 1].beats.slice(-1)[0];
    if (!(last.marks || []).includes('final_image')) errors.push('the final beat of the whole film must be marked "final_image"');
  }
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}


function checkStory(bible, opts = {}) {
  const b = validateFilmBible(bible, opts);
  const s = checkScreenplay(bible, opts);
  return { valid: b.valid && s.valid, errors: [...b.errors, ...s.errors], warnings: b.warnings };
}

module.exports = { checkScreenplay, checkStory, checkActScenes, flattenBeats };

'use strict';
/** Small deterministic helpers shared by the film engine. No external deps. */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const sha256 = (bufOrStr) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bufOrStr).digest('hex');
const sha256File = (file) => sha256(fs.readFileSync(file));
const slug = (s) => String(s).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
const pad = (n, w = 3) => String(n).padStart(w, '0');

function ensureDir(d) { fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true }); return d; }

/** Atomic JSON write: never leaves a half-written state file after a crash. */
function writeJson(file, obj) {
  ensureDir(path.dirname(file));
  const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`;
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2));
  fs.renameSync(tmp, file);
}
function readJson(file, dflt = null) {
  try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch (e) { if (e.code === 'ENOENT') return dflt; throw e; }
}

/** Stable JSON (sorted keys) so hashes of canonical data are reproducible. */
function stableStringify(v) {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return '[' + v.map(stableStringify).join(',') + ']';
  if (v && typeof v === 'object') return '{' + Object.keys(v).sort().map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + stableStringify(v[k])).join(',') + '}';
  return JSON.stringify(v);
}
const deepClone = (o) => (o === undefined ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o)));

/** mulberry32 — seedable RNG so "random" production choices are reproducible. */
function rng(seed) {
  let a = (typeof seed === 'number' ? seed : parseInt(sha256(String(seed)).slice(0, 8), 16)) >>> 0;
  return () => { a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
}

/** Bounded concurrency for INDEPENDENT work only (assets). Order of results preserved. */
async function mapLimit(items, limit, fn) {
  const out = new Array(items.length); let next = 0;
  const worker = async () => { while (true) { const i = next++; if (i >= items.length) return; out[i] = await fn(items[i], i); } };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, items.length)) }, worker));
  return out;
}

/** Append-only structured event log (one JSON object per line). */
class EventLog {
  constructor(file) { this.file = file; ensureDir(path.dirname(file)); }
  emit(type, data = {}) {
    const rec = { t: new Date().toISOString(), type, ...data };
    fs.appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(rec) + '\n');
    return rec;
  }
  read() { try { return fs.readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l)); } catch { return []; } }
}

module.exports = { sha256, sha256File, slug, pad, ensureDir, writeJson, readJson, stableStringify, deepClone, rng, mapLimit, EventLog };

'use strict';
/**
 * Continuity validator. Deterministic comparison of (a) what the shot SHOULD show at its end
 * (continuity ledger) against (b) an OBSERVATION of what was generated (VisionProvider), plus
 * cheap metadata checks. Returns structured issues; each issue type maps to a targeted retry.
 * Deliberately NOT a world simulation: practical checks for obvious cinematic failures only.
 */
const { extractDialogueFromPrompt } = require('./promptCompiler');
const { sha256, stableStringify } = require('./util');

const tokens = (s) => new Set(String(s || '').toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(w => w.length > 2));
function overlap(expected, observed) { const e = tokens(expected); if (!e.size) return 1; const o = tokens(observed); let n = 0; for (const t of e) if (o.has(t)) n++; return n / e.size; }

/** issue type -> cumulative targeted retry adjustments (never a blind retry) */
const STRATEGIES = {
  identity: ['identity_boost'], wardrobe: ['wardrobe_ref_boost', 'wardrobe_explicit'], physical_state: ['injury_explicit'],
  prop: ['prop_ref_boost', 'prop_state_explicit'], environment: ['location_ref_boost'], lighting: ['lighting_explicit', 'location_ref_boost'],
  spatial: ['motion_context', 'transition_explicit'], camera: ['motion_context', 'transition_explicit'],
  dialogue_timing: ['extend_duration'], media: ['regenerate_plain'],
};
const NON_RETRYABLE = new Set(['dialogue_integrity', 'narrative']);          // plan/prompt defects: regenerating video cannot fix them

function adjustmentsFor(issues, existing = []) {
  const out = new Set(existing);
  for (const i of issues) for (const a of (STRATEGIES[i.type] || [])) out.add(a);
  return [...out];
}

function validateShot({ shot, before, request, clip, observation, expected, plannedTolerance = 0.25 }) {
  const issues = [];
  const add = (type, severity, message, extra = {}) => issues.push({ type, severity, message, retryable: !NON_RETRYABLE.has(type), ...extra });

  // --- dialogue integrity (what was actually SENT must equal the plan, word for word) --------------------
  const sent = extractDialogueFromPrompt(request.prompt);
  if (stableStringify(sent) !== stableStringify(shot.dialogue) || request.dialogue_sha256 !== shot.dialogue_sha256) {
    add('dialogue_integrity', 'high', 'dialogue in the compiled request differs from the approved plan');
  }
  // --- narrative: nobody acts on information they have not learned yet -----------------------------------
  for (const info of shot.uses_info || []) if (!before.story.known_info.includes(info)) add('narrative', 'high', `shot uses "${info}" before it has been learned`);
  // --- media / timing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (!clip || !(clip.duration > 0)) add('media', 'high', 'clip not decodable');
  else {
    const need = (shot.dialogue_duration || 0);
    if (shot.dialogue.length && clip.duration + 0.05 < need) add('dialogue_timing', 'high', `clip ${clip.duration.toFixed(1)}s is shorter than the speech (${need}s)`);
    if (Math.abs(clip.duration - request.duration) > Math.max(0.75, request.duration * plannedTolerance)) add('media', 'medium', `duration ${clip.duration.toFixed(1)}s vs requested ${request.duration}s`);
    if (shot.dialogue.length && !clip.hasAudio) add('media', 'high', 'dialogue shot has no audio track');
  }
  if (!observation) return finish(issues);

  // --- identity / appearance / wardrobe / physical state ------------------------------------------------
  for (const [k, exp] of Object.entries(expected.characters)) {
    const obs = observation.characters && observation.characters[k];
    if (!obs) { add('identity', 'high', `${k} not found in the generated shot`, { character: k }); continue; }
    if ((obs.identity_match ?? 1) < 0.8) add('identity', 'high', `${k} does not match the canonical reference (score ${obs.identity_match})`, { character: k });
    if (overlap(exp.wardrobe, obs.wardrobe) < 0.6) add('wardrobe', 'high', `${k} wardrobe differs: expected "${exp.wardrobe}", saw "${obs.wardrobe}"`, { character: k });
    for (const inj of exp.injuries) if (!(obs.injuries || []).some(o => overlap(inj, o) >= 0.6)) add('physical_state', 'high', `${k} lost injury "${inj}"`, { character: k });
    if (exp.facing && obs.facing && overlap(exp.facing, obs.facing) < 0.5) add('spatial', 'medium', `${k} facing/heading differs: expected "${exp.facing}", saw "${obs.facing}"`, { character: k });
  }
  // --- props ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (const [k, exp] of Object.entries(expected.props)) {
    const obs = observation.props && observation.props[k];
    if (exp.present && !(obs && obs.present)) add('prop', 'high', `prop ${k} is missing`, { prop: k });
    else if (exp.present && obs && exp.held !== obs.held) add('prop', 'medium', `prop ${k} held-state differs (expected ${exp.held}, saw ${obs.held})`, { prop: k });
    else if (!exp.present && obs && obs.present) add('prop', 'medium', `prop ${k} appeared unexpectedly`, { prop: k });
  }
  // --- environment / lighting / camera --------------------------------------------------------------
  if (observation.location_id && observation.location_id !== expected.location_id) add('environment', 'high', `location changed: expected ${expected.location_id}, saw ${observation.location_id}`);
  if (observation.lighting && overlap(expected.lighting, observation.lighting) < 0.5) add('lighting', 'medium', `lighting jumped: expected "${expected.lighting}", saw "${observation.lighting}"`);
  if (observation.camera && observation.camera.transition_intentional === false) add('camera', 'medium', 'camera transition looks unintentional (composition restarted)');
  return finish(issues);
}
function finish(issues) { return { passed: !issues.some(i => i.severity === 'high' || i.severity === 'medium'), issues }; }

module.exports = { validateShot, adjustmentsFor, STRATEGIES, overlap };

'use strict';

/**
 * Global Continuity Engine
 *
 * Maintains a lightweight episode-wide continuity ledger in addition to the
 * per-scene Scene State engine. It is intentionally deterministic: no extra
 * LLM call is required. The ledger is derived from the director's existing
 * scene/shot semantics and is injected into downstream prompts as descriptive
 * story-world context, never as model instructions.
 */

function _clean(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function buildGlobalContinuityState(script) {
  const scenes = script?.scenes || [];
  const state = {
    timeOfDay: null,
    location: null,
    lighting: null,
    weather: null,
    environment: null,
    activeProps: [],
    characterStates: {},
    knowledgeState: {},
    vehicleStates: {},
    narrativeState: {
      unresolvedThreads: [],
    },
    unresolvedThreads: [],
    lastEndState: '',
    lastSceneNumber: null,
  };

  for (const scene of scenes) {
    const location = _clean(scene.location);
    const lighting = _clean(scene.lighting_design);
    const description = _clean(scene.scene_description);
    const beat = _clean(scene.emotional_beat);

    if (location) state.location = location;
    if (lighting) state.lighting = lighting;

    const sceneShots = scene.shots || [];
    for (const shot of sceneShots) {
      const ds = shot._director_state;
      const world = ds?.world || {};
      if (_clean(world.location)) state.location = _clean(world.location);
      if (_clean(world.time_of_day)) state.timeOfDay = _clean(world.time_of_day);
      if (_clean(world.lighting)) state.lighting = _clean(world.lighting);
      if (_clean(world.weather)) state.weather = _clean(world.weather);
      if (_clean(world.environment)) state.environment = _clean(world.environment);

      for (const c of shot.characters_in_shot || Object.keys(ds?.characters || {})) {
        const name = _clean(c);
        if (!name) continue;
        const canonical = ds?.characters?.[name] || {};
        state.characterStates[name] = {
          location: _clean(canonical.location || shot.current_location || scene.location),
          screenPosition: _clean(canonical.screen_position),
          depth: _clean(canonical.depth),
          emotionalState: _clean(canonical.emotional_state || shot.emotional_subtext),
          physicalState: _clean(canonical.physical_state || shot.pose_state),
          pose: _clean(canonical.pose),
          action: _clean(canonical.action),
          eyeline: _clean(canonical.gaze || shot.character_positions),
          wardrobe: _clean(shot._hard_wardrobe_state?.after_characters?.[name] || shot._hard_wardrobe_state?.characters?.[name] || canonical.wardrobe),
          injuries: _clean(canonical.injuries),
          carriedProps: Array.isArray(canonical.carried_props) ? canonical.carried_props.slice() : [],
          knowledgeDelta: Array.isArray(canonical.knowledge_delta) ? canonical.knowledge_delta.slice() : [],
          lastBeat: _clean(shot.temporal_arc),
        };
      }

      const props = ds?.world?.active_props || [];
      if (Array.isArray(props)) {
        for (const prop of props.map(_clean).filter(Boolean)) {
          if (!state.activeProps.includes(prop)) state.activeProps.push(prop);
        }
      }

      const end = _clean(
        ds?.terminal?.end_state ||
        shot.end_frame_state ||
        shot.end_frame_transition ||
        shot.next_shot_continuity
      );
      if (end) state.lastEndState = end;

      if (ds?.world?.travel_mode && ds.world.travel_mode !== 'none') {
        state.vehicleStates[ds.world.travel_mode] = {
          mode: ds.world.travel_mode,
          stage: ds.world.travel_stage,
          origin: _clean(ds.world.origin_location),
          destination: _clean(ds.world.destination_location),
        };
      }
    }
    state.activeProps = state.activeProps.slice(-12);

    const finalShot = sceneShots[sceneShots.length - 1];
    if (finalShot) {
      const inherit = _clean(finalShot.next_shot_continuity);
      if (inherit) state.lastEndState = inherit;
    }

    if (scene.location) state.lastSceneNumber = scene.scene_number;
    if (beat && sceneShots.length === 0) state.unresolvedThreads.push(beat);
    if (description && sceneShots.length === 0) state.unresolvedThreads.push(description);
  }

  state.unresolvedThreads = state.unresolvedThreads.slice(-5);
  return state;
}

function _stateSentence(state) {
  const parts = [];
  if (state.location) parts.push(`The story remains in ${state.location}.`);
  if (state.lighting) parts.push(`The lighting remains ${state.lighting}.`);
  if (state.weather) parts.push(`Weather remains ${state.weather}.`);
  if (state.environment) parts.push(`The surrounding environment retains ${state.environment}.`);
  if (state.lastEndState) parts.push(`${state.lastEndState}.`);

  const chars = Object.entries(state.characterStates || {}).slice(-6);
  if (chars.length) {
    parts.push(chars.map(([name, v]) => {
      const bits = [v.emotionalState, v.physicalState, v.eyeline].filter(Boolean);
      return bits.length ? `${name} remains in a state of ${bits.join(', ')}.` : `${name} remains present and visually continuous.`;
    }).join(' '));
  }

  return parts.join(' ').trim();
}

function applyGlobalContinuity(script) {
  if (!script || !Array.isArray(script.scenes)) return script;

  const state = {
    location: null,
    timeOfDay: null,
    lighting: null,
    weather: null,
    environment: null,
    activeProps: [],
    characterStates: {},
    unresolvedThreads: [],
    lastEndState: '',
    lastSceneNumber: null,
    activeScene: null,
  };

  for (const scene of script.scenes) {
    const priorState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
    const inherited = _stateSentence(priorState);

    scene._global_continuity_state = priorState;

    for (const shot of (scene.shots || [])) {
      shot._global_continuity_directive = inherited
        ? `${inherited} The moment continues naturally from this established state.`
        : 'The current moment establishes the episode continuity from its opening state.';
    }

    if (scene.location) state.location = _clean(scene.location);
    if (scene.time_of_day) state.timeOfDay = _clean(scene.time_of_day);
    if (scene.lighting_design) state.lighting = _clean(scene.lighting_design);
    if (scene.weather) state.weather = _clean(scene.weather);
    if (scene.scene_number != null) state.lastSceneNumber = scene.scene_number;

    for (const thread of (scene.unresolved_threads || scene.unresolvedThreads || [])) {
      const cleanThread = _clean(thread);
      if (cleanThread) state.unresolvedThreads.push(cleanThread);
    }

    for (const shot of (scene.shots || [])) {
      const ds = shot._director_state;
      const world = ds?.world || {};
      if (_clean(world.environment || shot.scene_environment || shot.environmental_story_beat)) {
        state.environment = _clean(world.environment || shot.scene_environment || shot.environmental_story_beat);
      }
      if (_clean(world.weather)) state.weather = _clean(world.weather);
      if (_clean(world.lighting)) state.lighting = _clean(world.lighting);

      const directProps = Array.isArray(world.active_props)
        ? world.active_props
        : [_clean(shot.active_prop || shot.prop_continuity || shot.scene_prop)];
      for (const prop of directProps.map(_clean).filter(Boolean)) {
        if (!state.activeProps.includes(prop)) state.activeProps.push(prop);
      }

      for (const c of shot.characters_in_shot || Object.keys(ds?.characters || {})) {
        const name = _clean(c);
        if (!name) continue;
        const canonical = ds?.characters?.[name] || {};
        state.characterStates[name] = {
          location: _clean(canonical.location),
          screenPosition: _clean(canonical.screen_position),
          depth: _clean(canonical.depth),
          emotionalState: _clean(canonical.emotional_state || shot.emotional_subtext),
          physicalState: _clean(canonical.physical_state || shot.pose_state),
          pose: _clean(canonical.pose),
          action: _clean(canonical.action),
          eyeline: _clean(canonical.gaze || shot.character_positions),
          wardrobe: _clean(shot._hard_wardrobe_state?.after_characters?.[name] || shot._hard_wardrobe_state?.characters?.[name] || canonical.wardrobe),
          injuries: _clean(canonical.injuries),
          carriedProps: Array.isArray(canonical.carried_props) ? canonical.carried_props.slice() : [],
        };
      }

      const end = _clean(
        ds?.terminal?.end_state ||
        shot.end_frame_state ||
        shot.end_frame_transition ||
        shot.next_shot_continuity
      );
      if (end) state.lastEndState = end;
    }
    state.activeProps = state.activeProps.slice(-12);

    state.activeScene = scene.scene_number;
    scene._global_continuity_after = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
  }

  const derived = buildGlobalContinuityState(script);
  script.global_continuity_state = {
    ...derived,
    ...state,
    activeProps: [...new Set([...(derived.activeProps || []), ...(state.activeProps || [])])].slice(-6),
    unresolvedThreads: [...new Set([...(derived.unresolvedThreads || []), ...(state.unresolvedThreads || [])])].slice(-5),
    characterStates: { ...(derived.characterStates || {}), ...(state.characterStates || {}) },
    knowledgeState: { ...(derived.knowledgeState || {}), ...(state.knowledgeState || {}) },
    vehicleStates: { ...(derived.vehicleStates || {}), ...(state.vehicleStates || {}) },
    narrativeState: {
      ...(derived.narrativeState || {}),
      ...(state.narrativeState || {}),
      unresolvedThreads: [...new Set([
        ...((derived.narrativeState || {}).unresolvedThreads || []),
        ...((state.narrativeState || {}).unresolvedThreads || []),
      ])].slice(-8),
    },
    lastSceneNumber: state.lastSceneNumber ?? derived.lastSceneNumber ?? null,
  };
  return script;
}

module.exports = { applyGlobalContinuity, buildGlobalContinuityState };
