'use strict';

/**
 * VANTA renderer client.
 *
 * The renderer is a self-describing ComfyUI control plane. We deliberately do
 * not hard-code ComfyUI node IDs, workflow filenames, image field names, or
 * transport encodings. The client discovers:
 *   1. /discovery      -> supported transport conventions
 *   2. /workflows      -> current workflow IDs
 *   3. /workflows/:id  -> the selected workflow's exact input contract
 * and only then constructs { inputs: ... } for the job endpoint.
 */
const axios = require('axios');
const cloudinary = require('./cloudinary');
const config = require('./config');

function normalizeBaseUrl(raw) {
  let value = String(raw || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (!value) return '';
  value = value.replace(/\/health$/i, '');
  value = value.replace(/\/capabilities$/i, '');
  value = value.replace(/\/openapi\.json$/i, '');
  value = value.replace(/\/workflows$/i, '');
  value = value.replace(/\/discovery$/i, '');
  return value;
}

const BASE_URL = normalizeBaseUrl(process.env.RENDERER_BASE_URL || '');
const API_KEY = String(process.env.RENDERER_API_KEY || '').trim();
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT = Number(process.env.RENDERER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS || 30000);
const POLL_INTERVAL = Number(process.env.RENDERER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS || 5000);
const MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS || 240);
const DISCOVERY_TTL_MS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_DISCOVERY_TTL_MS || 60000);

// Replit instances (like the one RENDERER_BASE_URL points at) spin down after
// a period of inactivity. The FIRST request that reaches a sleeping instance
// typically comes back 404/502/503 -- or just hangs -- while the container
// wakes up; that is not a real error about the API contract, but it looks
// exactly like one if we don't check for it first.
const HEALTH_TTL_MS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_HEALTH_TTL_MS || 30000);           // how long a confirmed-awake result is trusted before re-checking
const HEALTH_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_HEALTH_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS || 90000); // total budget to wait for a cold instance to wake up
const HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL_MS || 3000);
const HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.RENDERER_HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS || 10000); // short per-attempt timeout so one slow probe can't eat the whole wait budget

const client = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  timeout: REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
  headers: API_KEY ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}` } : {},
});

let contractCache = null;
let contractCacheAt = 0;
let lastHealthyAt = 0;

/**
 * Confirms the renderer is actually awake and answering, retrying through
 * whatever transient failure a waking instance produces, BEFORE any
 * discovery/workflow/job call is made. Cached for HEALTH_TTL_MS so a burst of
 * calls doesn't repeat the full wait for each one -- but every real
 * request-making function below calls this first regardless, so no call path
 * (current or future) can accidentally skip the check.
 *
 * Deliberately tolerant during the wait: a 404, a 5xx, a timeout, or a
 * connection error are all treated the same way (keep retrying) since a
 * sleeping instance can produce any of them depending on exactly which layer
 * of Replit's proxy answers before the container is back up. Only exhausting
 * the full wait budget is treated as a real, reportable failure.
 */
async function ensureRendererAwake({ force = false } = {}) {
  if (!BASE_URL) throw new Error('[VANTA] RENDERER_BASE_URL is not configured.');
  if (!force && lastHealthyAt && Date.now() - lastHealthyAt < HEALTH_TTL_MS) return;

  const deadline = Date.now() + HEALTH_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  let attempt = 0;
  let lastErr = null;
  for (;;) {
    attempt += 1;
    try {
      const resp = await client.get('/health', { timeout: HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS });
      if (resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300) {
        if (attempt > 1) {
          console.log(`[VANTA] Renderer is awake (confirmed after ${attempt} health check attempt(s)).`);
        }
        lastHealthyAt = Date.now();
        return;
      }
      lastErr = new Error(`unexpected health status ${resp.status}`);
    } catch (err) {
      lastErr = err;
    }
    if (attempt === 1) {
      console.log(
        '[VANTA] Renderer did not answer /health on the first try -- it may be asleep ' +
        '(Replit instances spin down when idle). Waiting for it to wake up...'
      );
    }
    const remaining = deadline - Date.now();
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `[VANTA] Renderer did not become healthy within ${HEALTH_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS}ms ` +
        `(${attempt} attempt(s)). Last error: ${lastErr?.message || 'unknown'}`
      );
    }
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, remaining)));
  }
}

function assertConfigured() {
  if (!BASE_URL) throw new Error('[VANTA] RENDERER_BASE_URL is not configured.');
  if (!API_KEY) throw new Error('[VANTA] RENDERER_API_KEY is not configured.');
}

function responseError(prefix, err) {
  const status = err?.response?.status;
  const data = err?.response?.data;
  let detail = err?.message || 'request failed';
  if (data !== undefined) {
    try { detail = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data); } catch (_) { detail = String(data); }
  }
  return new Error(`${prefix}${status ? ` HTTP ${status}` : ''}: ${detail}`);
}

async function getDiscovery() {
  assertConfigured();
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.get('/discovery');
    return resp.data || {};
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError('[VANTA] Discovery request failed', err);
  }
}

async function listWorkflows({ refresh = false } = {}) {
  assertConfigured();
  if (!refresh && contractCache && Date.now() - contractCacheAt < DISCOVERY_TTL_MS) {
    return contractCache.workflows.slice();
  }
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.get('/workflows');
    const workflows = Array.isArray(resp.data?.workflows) ? resp.data.workflows : [];
    if (!workflows.length) throw new Error('Renderer returned an empty workflow registry.');
    contractCache = { workflows };
    contractCacheAt = Date.now();
    return workflows.slice();
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError('[VANTA] Workflow discovery failed', err);
  }
}

async function getWorkflowContract(workflowId) {
  assertConfigured();
  const id = encodeURIComponent(String(workflowId || '').trim());
  if (!id) throw new Error('[VANTA] workflowId is required.');
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.get(`/workflows/${id}`);
    return resp.data?.workflow || resp.data || {};
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError(`[VANTA] Workflow contract lookup failed for ${workflowId}`, err);
  }
}

async function inspectContracts({ refresh = false } = {}) {
  const [discovery, workflows] = await Promise.all([
    getDiscovery(),
    listWorkflows({ refresh }),
  ]);
  const contracts = [];
  for (const workflow of workflows) {
    const id = workflow?.id;
    if (!id) continue;
    contracts.push({ registry: workflow, contract: await getWorkflowContract(id) });
  }
  return { discovery, workflows, contracts };
}

function flattenStrings(value, out = []) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') out.push(value.toLowerCase());
  else if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const item of value) flattenStrings(item, out);
  else if (value && typeof value === 'object') for (const item of Object.values(value)) flattenStrings(item, out);
  return out;
}

function findPathValues(root, wantedKeys) {
  const found = [];
  const wanted = new Set(wantedKeys.map(k => k.toLowerCase()));
  function walk(node, path) {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
      node.forEach((v, i) => walk(v, `${path}[${i}]`));
      return;
    }
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
      const nextPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;
      if (wanted.has(key.toLowerCase())) found.push({ path: nextPath, key, value });
      walk(value, nextPath);
    }
  }
  walk(root, '');
  return found;
}

function extractInputSchema(contract) {
  return contract?.contract?.input || contract?.input || contract?.schema?.input || null;
}

function schemaProperties(contract) {
  const schema = extractInputSchema(contract);
  return schema?.properties && typeof schema.properties === 'object' ? schema.properties : {};
}

function collectTransportHints(discovery) {
  const hints = flattenStrings(discovery);
  const names = new Set();
  for (const hint of hints) {
    if (/data[_-]?url|data url/.test(hint)) names.add('data_url');
    if (/base64|inline[_ -]?base64|encoded/.test(hint)) names.add('base64');
    if (/url|uri|remote/.test(hint)) names.add('url');
    if (/multipart|binary|upload/.test(hint)) names.add('binary');
    if (/cloudinary/.test(hint)) names.add('cloudinary_url');
  }
  return [...names];
}

function semanticScore(workflow, purpose, requirements = {}) {
  const text = [
    workflow?.id,
    workflow?.name,
    workflow?.type,
    workflow?.provider,
    workflow?.comfy_workflow,
    ...(workflow?.capabilities || []),
    ...(workflow?.selection_rules?.use_when || []),
    ...(workflow?.selection_rules?.do_not_use_when || []),
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();

  let score = 0;
  const positive = {
    character: ['character', 'identity', 'canonical', 'portrait', 'reference'],
    environment: ['background', 'environment', 'location', 'empty set', 'plate'],
    scene: ['scene', 'shot', 'composition', 'still', 'image'],
    video: ['video', 'temporal', 'motion', 'first last', 'keyframe', 'i2v'],
    continuity_video: ['first last', 'keyframe', 'continuity', 'temporal'],
  }[purpose] || [purpose];
  for (const token of positive || []) if (text.includes(token)) score += 5;

  const type = String(workflow?.type || '').toLowerCase();
  if (purpose === 'video') score += type === 'video' ? 25 : -20;
  else score += type === 'image' ? 20 : -10;

  if (requirements.referenceCount > 0 && /reference|image/.test(text)) score += 4;
  if (requirements.requiresPrompt && text.includes('prompt')) score += 2;
  return score;
}

function selectWorkflow(workflows, purpose, requirements = {}) {
  const isVideoPurpose = purpose === 'video' || purpose === 'continuity_video';
  const candidates = workflows
    .filter(Boolean)
    .filter(w => isVideoPurpose
      ? String(w.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'video'
      : String(w.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'image')
    .map(w => ({ workflow: w, score: semanticScore(w, purpose, requirements) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  if (!candidates.length) {
    throw new Error(`[VANTA] No ${purpose} workflow exists in the discovered registry.`);
  }
  return candidates[0].workflow;
}

function findProperty(properties, aliases, { required = false } = {}) {
  const entries = Object.entries(properties || {});
  for (const alias of aliases) {
    const exact = entries.find(([key]) => key.toLowerCase() === alias.toLowerCase());
    if (exact) return exact[0];
  }
  for (const alias of aliases) {
    const partial = entries.find(([key]) => key.toLowerCase().includes(alias.toLowerCase()));
    if (partial) return partial[0];
  }
  if (required) throw new Error(`[VANTA] Workflow contract has no compatible input field for: ${aliases.join(', ')}`);
  return null;
}

function schemaAcceptsString(schema) {
  return schema?.type === 'string' || !schema?.type;
}

function isUrlLikeProperty(name, schema) {
  const n = String(name || '').toLowerCase();
  return /url|uri|path|file/.test(n) || schema?.format === 'uri' || schema?.format === 'uri-reference';
}

function toDataUrl(buffer, mime = 'image/jpeg') {
  return `data:${mime};base64,${Buffer.from(buffer).toString('base64')}`;
}

async function uploadImageBuffer(buffer, jobId, suffix) {
  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(buffer) || !buffer.length) throw new Error('[VANTA] Cannot upload an empty image buffer.');
  const mime = detectMime(buffer);
  const publicId = `${config.shotsFolderRoot}/tmp/vanta_input_${jobId}_${suffix}`;
  return cloudinary.uploadImageFromUrl(toDataUrl(buffer, mime), publicId);
}

function detectMime(buf) {
  if (!buf || buf.length < 12) return 'image/png';
  if (buf[0] === 0x89 && buf[1] === 0x50 && buf[2] === 0x4E && buf[3] === 0x47) return 'image/png';
  if (buf[0] === 0xFF && buf[1] === 0xD8 && buf[2] === 0xFF) return 'image/jpeg';
  if (buf[0] === 0x52 && buf[1] === 0x49 && buf[2] === 0x46 && buf[3] === 0x46 && buf[8] === 0x57 && buf[9] === 0x45 && buf[10] === 0x42 && buf[11] === 0x50) return 'image/webp';
  return 'image/png';
}

function requiredInputNames(contract) {
  return new Set(extractInputSchema(contract)?.required || []);
}

/**
 * Encode one image according to the discovered property schema and transport
 * hints. URL transport is preferred because the VANTA API is JSON-based; data
 * URLs/base64 are used only when the discovered contract calls for them.
 */
async function encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName, schema, buffer, uploadedUrl, discovery }) {
  const hints = collectTransportHints(discovery);
  const schemaType = schema?.type;
  if (schemaType === 'array') {
    return [await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName, schema: schema.items || {}, buffer, uploadedUrl, discovery })];
  }
  if (schemaType === 'object') {
    const properties = schema.properties || {};
    const urlKey = Object.keys(properties).find(k => /url|uri|path/i.test(k));
    const dataKey = Object.keys(properties).find(k => /data|base64|content/i.test(k));
    const typeKey = Object.keys(properties).find(k => /mime|content[_-]?type/i.test(k));
    const out = {};
    if (urlKey && uploadedUrl) out[urlKey] = uploadedUrl;
    else if (dataKey) out[dataKey] = toDataUrl(buffer, detectMime(buffer));
    if (typeKey) out[typeKey] = detectMime(buffer);
    return out;
  }

  if (isUrlLikeProperty(propertyName, schema) && uploadedUrl) return uploadedUrl;
  if (hints.includes('url') || hints.includes('cloudinary_url')) return uploadedUrl || toDataUrl(buffer, detectMime(buffer));
  if (hints.includes('data_url')) return toDataUrl(buffer, detectMime(buffer));
  if (hints.includes('base64')) return Buffer.from(buffer).toString('base64');
  if (schemaAcceptsString(schema)) return uploadedUrl || toDataUrl(buffer, detectMime(buffer));
  throw new Error(`[VANTA] Cannot encode image input ${propertyName}: contract/discovery exposes no compatible JSON transport.`);
}

/** Reduces width/height to a simplified "W:H" ratio string, e.g. 1024x1536 -> "2:3". */
function reduceAspectRatio(width, height) {
  const w = Math.round(Number(width));
  const h = Math.round(Number(height));
  if (!w || !h || !Number.isFinite(w) || !Number.isFinite(h)) return null;
  const gcd = (a, b) => (b === 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b));
  const g = gcd(w, h) || 1;
  return { ratio: `${w / g}:${h / g}`, value: w / h };
}

/** Picks the closest allowed value from a workflow's aspect_ratio enum by numeric distance, e.g. for a 0.667 target against ["16:9","9:16","1:1","4:3","3:4","21:9"] this correctly picks "3:4" (0.75), not "9:16" (0.5625). */
function closestEnumAspect(enumValues, targetValue) {
  const parse = (s) => {
    const [a, b] = String(s).split(':').map(Number);
    return a && b ? a / b : null;
  };
  let best = null, bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const opt of enumValues || []) {
    const v = parse(opt);
    if (v == null) continue;
    const d = Math.abs(v - targetValue);
    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = opt; }
  }
  return best;
}

function setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required, aliases, value) {
  const key = findProperty(properties, aliases, { required: required && value != null });
  if (key && value != null) inputs[key] = value;
  return key;
}

async function buildInputs({ contract, discovery, purpose, prompt, negativePrompt, seed, width, height, referenceImages = [], firstImageBuffer = null, lastImageBuffer = null, duration = null, extra = {} }) {
  const properties = schemaProperties(contract);
  const required = requiredInputNames(contract);
  const inputs = {};

  setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('prompt'), ['prompt', 'positive_prompt', 'text'], prompt);
  if (negativePrompt) setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('negative_prompt'), ['negative_prompt', 'negativePrompt', 'negative'], negativePrompt);
  if (seed != null) setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('seed'), ['seed', 'random_seed', 'randomSeed'], seed);
  if (width != null) setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('width'), ['width', 'output_width', 'image_width'], width);
  if (height != null) setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('height'), ['height', 'output_height', 'image_height'], height);
  if (duration != null) setScalarInput(inputs, properties, required.has('duration'), ['duration', 'seconds', 'end_seconds', 'video_duration'], duration);
  if (width != null && height != null) {
    const key = findProperty(properties, ['aspect_ratio', 'aspectRatio'], { required: required.has('aspect_ratio') });
    if (key) {
      const reduced = reduceAspectRatio(width, height);
      if (reduced) {
        const schema = properties[key];
        const value = Array.isArray(schema?.enum) ? (closestEnumAspect(schema.enum, reduced.value) || schema.enum[0]) : reduced.ratio;
        if (value) inputs[key] = value;
      }
    }
  }

  if (purpose !== 'environment' && referenceImages.length) {
    const refKey = findProperty(properties, ['reference_images', 'reference_image_urls', 'references', 'input_images', 'images', 'reference_image', 'image'], { required: false });
    if (refKey) {
      const schema = properties[refKey];
      const cloudinaryUrls = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < referenceImages.length; i++) {
        const upload = await uploadImageBuffer(referenceImages[i], `${Date.now()}`, `ref_${i}`);
        cloudinaryUrls.push(upload);
      }
      if (schema?.type === 'array') {
        const maxItems = Number.isFinite(Number(schema.maxItems)) ? Number(schema.maxItems) : referenceImages.length;
        const minItems = Number.isFinite(Number(schema.minItems)) ? Number(schema.minItems) : 0;
        if (referenceImages.length < minItems) {
          throw new Error(`[VANTA] Workflow requires at least ${minItems} reference image(s) for ${refKey}, but only ${referenceImages.length} were supplied.`);
        }
        const useCount = Math.min(referenceImages.length, maxItems);
        inputs[refKey] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < useCount; i++) {
          inputs[refKey].push(await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: refKey, schema: schema.items || {}, buffer: referenceImages[i], uploadedUrl: cloudinaryUrls[i], discovery }));
        }
      } else {
        inputs[refKey] = await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: refKey, schema, buffer: referenceImages[referenceImages.length - 1], uploadedUrl: cloudinaryUrls[cloudinaryUrls.length - 1], discovery });
      }

      // ComfyUI-oriented contracts may expose fixed slots such as
      // input_image_0/input_image_1 rather than an array. Populate those slots
      // from the same discovered transport rules, in stable input order.
      const numberedImageKeys = Object.keys(properties)
        .filter(key => /^(?:input_)?image[_-]?\d+$|^reference[_-]?image[_-]?\d+$/i.test(key))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(a.match(/\d+$/)?.[0] || 0) - Number(b.match(/\d+$/)?.[0] || 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(numberedImageKeys.length, referenceImages.length); i++) {
        const key = numberedImageKeys[i];
        if (inputs[key] !== undefined) continue;
        inputs[key] = await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: key, schema: properties[key], buffer: referenceImages[i], uploadedUrl: cloudinaryUrls[i], discovery });
      }
    }
  }

  if (firstImageBuffer) {
    const key = findProperty(properties, ['first_image', 'first_frame', 'start_image', 'start_frame', 'image_a', 'keyframe_a'], { required: false });
    if (key) {
      const upload = await uploadImageBuffer(firstImageBuffer, `${Date.now()}`, 'first');
      inputs[key] = await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: key, schema: properties[key], buffer: firstImageBuffer, uploadedUrl: upload, discovery });
    }
  }

  if (lastImageBuffer) {
    const key = findProperty(properties, ['last_image', 'last_frame', 'end_image', 'end_frame', 'image_b', 'keyframe_b'], { required: false });
    if (key) {
      const upload = await uploadImageBuffer(lastImageBuffer, `${Date.now()}`, 'last');
      inputs[key] = await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: key, schema: properties[key], buffer: lastImageBuffer, uploadedUrl: upload, discovery });
    }
    const slot1 = Object.keys(properties).find(key => /^(?:input_)?image[_-]?1$|^reference[_-]?image[_-]?1$/i.test(key));
    if (slot1 && inputs[slot1] === undefined) {
      const upload = await uploadImageBuffer(lastImageBuffer, `${Date.now()}`, 'last_slot');
      inputs[slot1] = await encodeImageForProperty({ propertyName: slot1, schema: properties[slot1], buffer: lastImageBuffer, uploadedUrl: upload, discovery });
    }
  }

  // Supply contract defaults where they exist. This is not model-specific
  // guessing: the workflow itself owns the declared default.
  for (const [key, schema] of Object.entries(properties)) {
    if (inputs[key] !== undefined || schema?.default === undefined) continue;
    inputs[key] = schema.default;
  }

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extra || {})) {
    const exact = findProperty(properties, [key], { required: false });
    if (exact) inputs[exact] = value;
  }

  // A strict final required-field check catches mismatches before a paid render
  // job is created. This is the important contract guardrail.
  const missing = [...required].filter(key => inputs[key] === undefined || inputs[key] === null || inputs[key] === '');
  if (missing.length) {
    throw new Error(`[VANTA] Contract validation would fail before submission. Missing inputs: ${missing.join(', ')}. Workflow=${contract.id || contract.workflow_id || purpose}`);
  }
  return inputs;
}

async function createJob(workflowId, inputs) {
  assertConfigured();
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.post(`/workflows/${encodeURIComponent(workflowId)}/jobs`, { inputs });
    const job = resp.data || {};
    const jobId = job.job_id || job.id;
    if (!jobId) throw new Error(`Renderer accepted no job id: ${JSON.stringify(job)}`);
    return job;
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError(`[VANTA] Job submission failed for workflow ${workflowId}`, err);
  }
}

async function getJob(jobId) {
  assertConfigured();
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.get(`/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`);
    return resp.data || {};
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError(`[VANTA] Job status lookup failed for ${jobId}`, err);
  }
}

async function getResult(jobId) {
  assertConfigured();
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  try {
    const resp = await client.get(`/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/result`);
    return resp.data || {};
  } catch (err) {
    throw responseError(`[VANTA] Job result lookup failed for ${jobId}`, err);
  }
}

async function cancelJob(jobId) {
  assertConfigured();
  await ensureRendererAwake();
  const resp = await client.post(`/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/cancel`);
  return resp.data || {};
}

function extractArtifactUrl(value, seen = new Set()) {
  if (!value || seen.has(value)) return null;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value !== 'object') return null;
  seen.add(value);
  const directKeys = ['video_url', 'videoUrl', 'image_url', 'imageUrl', 'url', 'download_url', 'downloadUrl', 'output_url', 'outputUrl', 'file_url', 'fileUrl'];
  for (const key of directKeys) {
    if (typeof value[key] === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(value[key])) return value[key];
  }
  for (const nestedValue of Object.values(value)) {
    if (Array.isArray(nestedValue)) {
      for (const item of nestedValue) {
        const url = extractArtifactUrl(item, seen);
        if (url) return url;
      }
    } else if (nestedValue && typeof nestedValue === 'object') {
      const url = extractArtifactUrl(nestedValue, seen);
      if (url) return url;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function poll(jobId, { intervalMs = POLL_INTERVAL, maxAttempts = MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS } = {}) {
  let last = null;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    last = await getJob(jobId);
    const status = String(last.status || last.state || '').toLowerCase();
    if (['completed', 'complete', 'done', 'succeeded', 'success'].includes(status)) {
      const result = await getResult(jobId);
      return { job: last, result, url: extractArtifactUrl(result) || extractArtifactUrl(last) };
    }
    if (['failed', 'error', 'cancelled', 'canceled'].includes(status)) {
      throw new Error(`[VANTA] Job ${jobId} failed: ${JSON.stringify(last.error || last)}`);
    }
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error(`[VANTA] Job ${jobId} did not complete after ${maxAttempts} polling attempts. Last state: ${JSON.stringify(last)}`);
}

async function renderImage({ prompt, referenceImageBuffers = [], negativePrompt = null, seed = null, width = 1024, height = 1536, generationMode = 'shot', extra = {} } = {}) {
  const [discovery, workflows] = await Promise.all([getDiscovery(), listWorkflows()]);
  const purpose = generationMode === 'environment' ? 'environment' : generationMode === 'character' ? 'character' : 'scene';
  const workflow = selectWorkflow(workflows, purpose, { referenceCount: referenceImageBuffers.length, requiresPrompt: true });
  const contract = await getWorkflowContract(workflow.id);
  const inputs = await buildInputs({
    contract,
    discovery,
    purpose,
    prompt,
    negativePrompt,
    seed,
    width,
    height,
    referenceImages: referenceImageBuffers,
    extra,
  });
  const submitted = await createJob(workflow.id, inputs);
  const jobId = submitted.job_id || submitted.id;
  const completed = await poll(jobId);
  if (!completed.url) throw new Error(`[VANTA] Image workflow ${workflow.id} completed without a usable image URL.`);
  const imageResp = await axios.get(completed.url, { responseType: 'arraybuffer', timeout: 60000 });
  return Buffer.from(imageResp.data);
}

async function renderVideo({ imageBuffer, referenceImageBuffers = [], prompt, negativePrompt = null, seed = null, duration, width, height, extra = {} } = {}) {
  const [discovery, workflows] = await Promise.all([getDiscovery(), listWorkflows()]);
  const videoPurpose = refsCount(referenceImageBuffers, imageBuffer) > 1 ? 'continuity_video' : 'video';
  const workflow = selectWorkflow(workflows, videoPurpose, { referenceCount: referenceImageBuffers.length, requiresPrompt: true });
  const contract = await getWorkflowContract(workflow.id);
  const refs = referenceImageBuffers.length ? referenceImageBuffers : (imageBuffer ? [imageBuffer] : []);
  const inputs = await buildInputs({
    contract,
    discovery,
    purpose: 'video',
    prompt,
    negativePrompt,
    seed,
    width,
    height,
    referenceImages: refs,
    firstImageBuffer: refs[0] || null,
    lastImageBuffer: refs.length > 1 ? refs[refs.length - 1] : null,
    duration,
    extra,
  });
  const submitted = await createJob(workflow.id, inputs);
  return { jobId: submitted.job_id || submitted.id, workflowId: workflow.id };
}

function resetCache() { contractCache = null; contractCacheAt = 0; lastHealthyAt = 0; }

'use strict';
const axios = require('axios');
const vanta = require('./vantaRendererClient');

async function submitVideoJob(imageBuffer, shotMeta = {}) {
  const refs = Array.isArray(shotMeta.referenceImageBuffers)
    ? shotMeta.referenceImageBuffers.filter(Buffer.isBuffer)
    : [];
  if (!refs.length && Buffer.isBuffer(imageBuffer)) refs.push(imageBuffer);

  const prompt = String(
    shotMeta?.motionParams?.videoPrompt ||
    shotMeta?.videoPrompt ||
    shotMeta?.imagePrompt ||
    shotMeta?.prompt ||
    ''
  ).trim();
  if (!prompt) throw new Error('[VANTA Video] No video prompt supplied.');

  const result = await vanta.renderVideo({
    imageBuffer,
    referenceImageBuffers: refs,
    prompt,
    negativePrompt: shotMeta.negativePrompt || shotMeta.vantaNegativePrompt || null,
    seed: Number.isFinite(Number(shotMeta.seed)) ? Math.floor(Number(shotMeta.seed)) : null,
    duration: Number(shotMeta.duration) || undefined,
    width: Number(shotMeta.width) || undefined,
    height: Number(shotMeta.height) || undefined,
    extra: {
      motion_level: shotMeta.motionLevel,
      shot_pacing_type: shotMeta.shotPacingType,
      lip_sync: !!shotMeta?.motionParams?.lipSync,
    },
  });
  return { jobId: result.jobId, apiKey: 'vanta', workflowId: result.workflowId };
}

async function pollVideoJob(jobId) {
  const result = await vanta.poll(jobId);
  if (!result.url) throw new Error(`[VANTA Video] Job ${jobId} completed without a usable video URL.`);
  return result.url;
}

async function retrieveContinuityFrames(videoUrl) {
  // Continuity extraction remains the FFmpeg service responsibility.
  const config = require('./config');
  const key = process.env.FFMPEG_SERVICE_API_KEY || process.env.FFMPEG_API_KEY || config.ffmpegApiKey;
  const serviceUrl = String(process.env.FFMPEG_SERVICE_URL || config.ffmpegServiceUrl || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (!serviceUrl || !key) throw new Error('[VANTA Video] FFmpeg continuity service credentials are missing.');
  const response = await axios.post(`${serviceUrl}/frames`, { videoUrl }, {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': key },
    timeout: 60000,
  });
  return response.data;
}

'use strict';
const axios = require('axios');
const config = require('./config');

/**
 * Submit an image-to-video job to Magic Hour.
 * imageBuffer: Buffer of the source image.
 * Returns { jobId, apiKey } on success, or throws.
 *
 * Rotates through magicHourKeys if submission fails.
 *
 * shotMeta fields:
 *   motionLevel  — 'low'|'medium'|'high'
 *   duration     — raw generation seconds (4 or 5)
 *   talkingPhoto — { audioUrl, durationSeconds } | null
 *   imagePrompt  — the shot's image_prompt, passed to MH for expressive animation
 *   shotPacingType    — used to choose safe motion defaults (dialogue shots = low motion)
 *   motionParams      — structured motion control from the Motion System Upgrade:
 *                       { motionIntensity, motionType, motionDirection, motionSpeed,
 *                         motionEasing, subjectMotion, ambientMotion, lipSync, videoPrompt }
 *                       When present, motionParams.mhMotionLevel overrides motionLevel and
 *                       motionParams.videoPrompt overrides imagePrompt.
 *
 * ── Magic Hour artifact reduction ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Artifacts arise when MH over-animates a subtle moment. We suppress them by:
 *   1. Forcing motionLevel to 'low' for ALL talking-photo (dialogue close-up) shots.
 *      The person is already animated by lip-sync — extra body motion fights it.
 *   2. Capping the prompt sent to MH at 300 chars for talking-photo (shorter = more faithful).
 *   3. For image-to-video, keeping motionLevel at the script's value ('low'/'medium')
 *      but clamping 'high' down to 'medium' on dialogue pacing types to avoid jitter.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */
async function submitVideoJob(imageBuffer, shotMeta) {
  const keyCount = config.magicHourKeys.length;
  if (keyCount === 0) throw new Error('[VideoGen] No Magic Hour keys configured');

  // Upload image to Cloudinary first (Magic Hour needs a URL, not a buffer)
  const cloudinary = require('./cloudinary');
  const tmpPublicId = `${config.shotsFolderRoot}/tmp/img_${Date.now()}`;

  function _detectMime(buf) {
    if (!buf || buf.length < 12) return 'image/png';
    if (buf[0] === 0x89 && buf[1] === 0x50 && buf[2] === 0x4E && buf[3] === 0x47) return 'image/png';
    if (buf[0] === 0xFF && buf[1] === 0xD8 && buf[2] === 0xFF)                      return 'image/jpeg';
    if (buf[0] === 0x52 && buf[1] === 0x49 && buf[2] === 0x46 && buf[3] === 0x46 &&
        buf[8] === 0x57 && buf[9] === 0x45 && buf[10]=== 0x42 && buf[11]=== 0x50)  return 'image/webp';
    return 'image/png';
  }
  const mime = _detectMime(imageBuffer);
  const imageUrl = await cloudinary.uploadImageFromUrl(
    `data:${mime};base64,${imageBuffer.toString('base64')}`,
    tmpPublicId
  );

  let lastError;
  let hadCreditError = false;

  // ── Determine effective motion level based on shot type ──────────────────────
  // Dialogue / close-up pacing types → force 'low' to minimise facial artifacts.
  // Action / hook shots → honour the script's level (default 'medium').
  const DIALOGUE_PACING = new Set(['dialogue_mid', 'dialogue_full', 'slow_dramatic']);
  const mp = shotMeta.motionParams || null; // structured motion params from Motion System Upgrade
  const rawMotion = (mp?.mhMotionLevel || shotMeta.motionLevel || 'medium').toLowerCase();
  const isDialoguePacing = DIALOGUE_PACING.has(shotMeta.shotPacingType || '');
  const talkingPhoto = shotMeta.talkingPhoto; // { audioUrl, durationSeconds } | null

  let effectiveMotion = rawMotion;
  if (talkingPhoto?.audioUrl) {
    // Talking-photo: lip-sync drives animation — lock body motion to 'low'
    effectiveMotion = 'low';
  } else if (isDialoguePacing && rawMotion === 'high') {
    // Non-talking dialogue shot — clamp 'high' to 'medium' to reduce jitter
    effectiveMotion = 'medium';
  }

  // Prompt selection: structured videoPrompt from Motion System takes priority.
  // Prompt length: shorter for talking-photo (more faithful to source image),
  // full prompt for image-to-video (MH uses it to guide ambient motion + audio).
  const MAX_PROMPT_TALKING = 300;
  const MAX_PROMPT_VIDEO   = 500;
  const rawPrompt = (mp?.videoPrompt || shotMeta.imagePrompt || '').trim();

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < keyCount; attempt++) {
    const key = config.getNextMagicHourKey();
    try {
      let endpoint, body;

      if (talkingPhoto?.audioUrl) {
        // ── AI Talking Photo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // Uses 'prompted' generation mode (formerly 'expressive').
        // aspect_ratio: "9:16" forces vertical portrait output for Facebook Reels.
        // motionLevel is locked to 'low' above to prevent over-animation artifacts.
        // Prompt is capped shorter so MH doesn't drift away from the source face.
        endpoint = 'https://api.magichour.ai/v1/ai-talking-photo';
        body = {
          start_seconds: 0,
          end_seconds:   talkingPhoto.durationSeconds,
          assets: {
            image_file_path: imageUrl,
            audio_file_path: talkingPhoto.audioUrl,
          },
          style: {
            aspect_ratio:   '9:16',
            generationMode: 'prompted',
            ...(rawPrompt
              ? { prompt: rawPrompt.slice(0, MAX_PROMPT_TALKING) }
              : {}),
          },
        };
      } else {
        // ── Image-to-Video ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // audio: true enables Magic Hour's AI-generated ambient audio.
        // motion_level is respected from the shot script but dialled back for
        // dialogue pacing types to reduce unwanted artefacts.
        endpoint = 'https://api.magichour.ai/v1/image-to-video';
        body = {
          end_seconds:  shotMeta.duration || 5,
          audio:        true,
          assets: { image_file_path: imageUrl },
          style: {
            aspect_ratio:  '9:16',
            motion_level:  effectiveMotion,
            ...(rawPrompt
              ? { prompt: rawPrompt.slice(0, MAX_PROMPT_VIDEO) }
              : {}),
          },
        };
      }

      const resp = await axios.post(endpoint, body, {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`,
          'Content-Type':  'application/json',
        },
        timeout: 30000,
      });
      if (resp.data?.id) {
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', key, 'active');
        return { jobId: resp.data.id, apiKey: key, imageTmpPublicId: tmpPublicId };
      }
      throw new Error(`Unexpected response: ${JSON.stringify(resp.data)}`);
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;
      const status = err.response?.status;
      if (status === 402) {
        hadCreditError = true;
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', key, 'exhausted');
        console.warn(`[VideoGen] Magic Hour key credits depleted (402), advancing to next key...`);
        config.advanceMagicHourKey();
        continue;
      }
      if (status === 401) {
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', key, 'exhausted');
        console.warn(`[VideoGen] Magic Hour key unauthorized (401), advancing to next key...`);
        config.advanceMagicHourKey();
        continue;
      }
      if (status === 429) {
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', key, 'rate-limited');
        console.warn(`[VideoGen] Magic Hour key rate-limited (429), advancing to next key for this attempt...`);
        config.advanceMagicHourKey();
        continue;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  const finalErr = new Error(`[VideoGen] All Magic Hour keys exhausted. Last: ${lastError?.message}`);
  if (hadCreditError) finalErr.mhExhausted = true;
  throw finalErr;
}

/**
 * Poll a Magic Hour job until completion or exhaustion.
 * Returns the video download URL on success, throws on failure.
 */
async function pollVideoJob(jobId, apiKey) {
  const maxAttempts = config.magicHourMaxPollAttempts;
  const intervalMs  = config.magicHourPollIntervalMs;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    await sleep(intervalMs);
    try {
      const resp = await axios.get(
        `https://api.magichour.ai/v1/video-projects/${jobId}`,
        {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
          timeout: 20000,
        }
      );
      const proj = resp.data;
      if (proj.status === 'complete') {
        const videoUrl = proj?.downloads?.[0]?.url;
        if (!videoUrl) throw new Error('Magic Hour: complete but no video URL in response');
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', apiKey, 'active');
        return videoUrl;
      }
      if (['error', 'canceled'].includes(proj.status)) {
        throw new Error(`Magic Hour job ${jobId} failed: ${proj?.error?.message || proj.status}`);
      }
      console.log(`[VideoGen] Job ${jobId} still pending (attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts})`);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.response?.status === 429) {
        config.markKeyStatus('magicHour', apiKey, 'rate-limited');
        console.warn('[VideoGen] Rate-limited during poll, will retry...');
        continue;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`[VideoGen] Job ${jobId} did not complete after ${maxAttempts} attempts`);
}

function sleep(ms) {
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

module.exports = { submitVideoJob, pollVideoJob };

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# StreamVerse Studio — combined startup
# ============================================================================
# Starts the Python Video Engine, waits for health, validates provider/service
# configuration, reconciles stale persisted shot rows, then starts Node in the
# FOREGROUND.
#
# IMPORTANT: application source is authoritative. This script does NOT rewrite
# pipeline.js or any provider source file at startup.
# ============================================================================
set -e

export PATH="${HOME:-/opt/render}/.local/bin:${PATH}"

VIDEO_ENGINE_HOST="${VIDEO_ENGINE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
VIDEO_ENGINE_PORT="${VIDEO_ENGINE_PORT:-8000}"

EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER="$(printf '%s' "${VIDEO_PROVIDER:-ltx}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | xargs)"
echo "[start.sh] VIDEO_PROVIDER=${VIDEO_PROVIDER:-<unset>}"
echo "[start.sh] Effective video provider=${EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER}"
echo "[start.sh] Python user scripts PATH=${HOME:-/opt/render}/.local/bin"

case "$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER" in
  ltx|agnes|magichour|vanta) ;;
  *)
    echo "[start.sh] ERROR: Unsupported VIDEO_PROVIDER='$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER'. Expected ltx, agnes, magichour, or vanta."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if [ "$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER" = "agnes" ]; then
  if [ -z "${AGNES_API_KEYS:-}" ]; then
    echo "[start.sh] ERROR: VIDEO_PROVIDER=agnes but AGNES_API_KEYS is empty."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "${FFMPEG_SERVICE_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "[start.sh] ERROR: VIDEO_PROVIDER=agnes requires FFMPEG_SERVICE_URL for mandatory continuity-frame extraction."
    exit 1
  fi

  AGNES_FFMPEG_API_KEY="${FFMPEG_SERVICE_API_KEY:-${FFMPEG_API_KEY:-}}"
  if [ -z "$AGNES_FFMPEG_API_KEY" ]; then
    echo "[start.sh] ERROR: VIDEO_PROVIDER=agnes requires FFMPEG_API_KEY (preferred) or FFMPEG_SERVICE_API_KEY for mandatory continuity-frame extraction."
    exit 1
  fi
  export FFMPEG_SERVICE_API_KEY="$AGNES_FFMPEG_API_KEY"
  echo "[start.sh] Agnes continuity FFmpeg credential resolved from configured secret."
fi

echo "[start.sh] Installing Python video engine dependencies..."
bash video_engine/install.sh

echo "[start.sh] Starting Python Video Engine on ${VIDEO_ENGINE_HOST}:${VIDEO_ENGINE_PORT}..."
bash video_engine/run.sh &
VIDEO_ENGINE_PID=$!

cleanup() {
  echo "[start.sh] Shutting down video engine (pid $VIDEO_ENGINE_PID)..."
  kill "$VIDEO_ENGINE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "[start.sh] Waiting for video engine health check..."
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf "http://${VIDEO_ENGINE_HOST}:${VIDEO_ENGINE_PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$VIDEO_ENGINE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[start.sh] ERROR: video engine process exited during startup."
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
  if [ "$i" -eq 30 ]; then
    echo "[start.sh] WARNING: video engine did not report healthy after 30s — starting Node anyway."
  fi
done

echo "[start.sh] Video engine is healthy."
echo "[start.sh] Source-authoritative startup: no runtime source patchers will run."
echo "[start.sh] Video provider = ${EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER}"
if [ "$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER" = "agnes" ]; then
  echo "[start.sh] Agnes backend = src/agnesVideoGen.js"
  echo "[start.sh] Agnes continuity = current-shot still re-anchored from previous-shot end frame + needed character references"
  echo "[start.sh] Agnes temporal ceiling = 18s"
elif [ "$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER" = "ltx" ]; then
  echo "[start.sh] LTX backend = src/ltxVideoGen.js"
elif [ "$EFFECTIVE_VIDEO_PROVIDER" = "vanta" ]; then
  echo "[start.sh] VANTA/ComfyUI backend = src/vantaVideoGen.js"
  echo "[start.sh] VANTA renderer = ${RENDERER_BASE_URL:-<unset>}"
else
  echo "[start.sh] Magic Hour backend = src/videoGen.js"
fi

echo "[start.sh] Reconciling stale persisted shot rows before backend resume..."
node src/reconcileShotState.js || true

echo "[start.sh] Starting StreamVerse Node backend on port ${PORT:-5000}..."
exec node index.js

'use strict';
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const crypto = require('crypto');
const { tmp } = require('./helpers');

/** Minimal multipart parser: returns {fields, file(Buffer)} */
function parseMultipart(body, contentType) {
  const boundary = '--' + /boundary=([^;]+)/.exec(contentType)[1];
  const fields = {}; let file = null; let pos = body.indexOf(boundary);
  while (pos !== -1) {
    const next = body.indexOf(boundary, pos + boundary.length); if (next === -1) break;
    const part = body.subarray(pos + boundary.length + 2, next - 2);
    const hEnd = part.indexOf('\r\n\r\n'); const head = part.subarray(0, hEnd).toString(); const data = part.subarray(hEnd + 4);
    const name = /name="([^"]+)"/.exec(head)[1];
    if (name === 'file') file = Buffer.from(data); else fields[name] = data.toString();
    pos = next;
  }
  return { fields, file };
}

function startServer(handler) {
  const reqs = [];
  const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    const chunks = []; req.on('data', c => chunks.push(c));
    req.on('end', () => {
      const body = Buffer.concat(chunks); const parsed = parseMultipart(body, req.headers['content-type']);
      const rec = { headers: req.headers, ...parsed, url: req.url }; reqs.push(rec);
      handler(rec, reqs.length, res);
    });
  });
  return new Promise(r => srv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => r({ srv, reqs, base: `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.address().port}` })));
}

function loadCloudinary(base, env = {}) {
  Object.assign(process.env, { CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME: 'demo', CLOUDINARY_API_KEY: 'k', CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET: 'secret', CLOUDINARY_API_BASE: base, ...env });
  for (const k of Object.keys(require.cache)) if (/src[\\/](cloudinary|config|configCore)\.js$/.test(k)) delete require.cache[k];
  return require('../src/cloudinary');
}

test('single-request upload for small files; signature is valid', async () => {
  const d = tmp(); const f = path.join(d, 'a.mp4'); fs.writeFileSync(f, crypto.randomBytes(300000));
  const { srv, reqs, base } = await startServer((r, n, res) => res.end(JSON.stringify({ secure_url: 'https://cdn/x.mp4' })));
  const c = loadCloudinary(base);
  assert.equal(await c.uploadVideoFile(f, 'streamverse/ep0001'), 'https://cdn/x.mp4');
  srv.close();
  assert.equal(reqs.length, 1); assert.ok(!reqs[0].headers['content-range']);
  assert.ok(reqs[0].file.equals(fs.readFileSync(f)));
  const { fields } = reqs[0];
  const toSign = `overwrite=true&public_id=streamverse/ep0001&timestamp=${fields.timestamp}`;
  assert.equal(fields.signature, crypto.createHash('sha1').update(toSign + process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET).digest('hex'));
});

test('chunked upload: contiguous Content-Range, same upload id, bytes reassemble exactly, transient 503 retried', async () => {
  const d = tmp(); const f = path.join(d, 'big.mp4'); const data = crypto.randomBytes(12 * 1024 * 1024 + 123); fs.writeFileSync(f, data);
  let failedOnce = false;
  const { srv, reqs, base } = await startServer((r, n, res) => {
    if (n === 2 && !failedOnce) { failedOnce = true; res.statusCode = 503; return res.end('{}'); }
    const last = /-(\d+)\/(\d+)$/.exec(r.headers['content-range']); const done = Number(last[1]) + 1 === Number(last[2]);
    res.end(JSON.stringify(done ? { secure_url: 'https://cdn/big.mp4' } : { done: false }));
  });
  const c = loadCloudinary(base, { CLOUDINARY_SINGLE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES: String(1024 * 1024), CLOUDINARY_CHUNK_BYTES: String(5 * 1024 * 1024) });
  const t0 = Date.now(); const url = await c.uploadVideoFile(f, 'streamverse/ep0002'); srv.close();
  assert.equal(url, 'https://cdn/big.mp4');
  const ok = reqs.filter(r => r.file && r.headers['content-range']);
  const ids = new Set(ok.map(r => r.headers['x-unique-upload-id'])); assert.equal(ids.size, 1);
  const good = reqs.filter((r, i) => !(i === 1)); // drop the 503'd attempt
  let expectStart = 0; const parts = [];
  for (const r of good) {
    const [, s, e, tot] = /bytes (\d+)-(\d+)\/(\d+)/.exec(r.headers['content-range']).map(Number);
    assert.equal(s, expectStart); assert.equal(tot, data.length); assert.equal(r.file.length, e - s + 1);
    parts.push(r.file); expectStart = e + 1;
  }
  assert.equal(expectStart, data.length); assert.ok(Buffer.concat(parts).equals(data));
  assert.equal(good.length, 3); assert.ok(Date.now() - t0 >= 900, 'backoff applied');
});

test('empty file is refused before any request', async () => {
  const d = tmp(); const f = path.join(d, 'e.mp4'); fs.writeFileSync(f, '');
  const c = loadCloudinary('http://127.0.0.1:1');
  await assert.rejects(c.uploadVideoFile(f, 'x'), /empty file/);
});

  };

'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const axios = require('axios');
const config = require('../src/config');
const compiler = require('../src/compiler');

function httpError(status, data, extra = {}) {
  const error = new Error(`Request failed with status code ${status}`);
  error.response = { status, data };
  error.config = { headers: { 'x-api-key': 'must-not-appear-in-errors' }, ...extra };
  return error;
}

test('pollFFmpegJob retries transient server errors and reports persistent errors safely', async () => {
  const originalGet = axios.get;
  const originalInterval = config.ffmpegPollIntervalMs;
  const originalMaxAttempts = config.ffmpegMaxPollAttempts;
  const originalApiKey = config.ffmpegApiKey;

  config.ffmpegPollIntervalMs = 0;
  config.ffmpegMaxPollAttempts = 10;
  config.ffmpegApiKey = 'test-ffmpeg-key'; // _ffmpegHeaders() throws before any request if this is empty -- without it, every case below fails on "authentication key is missing" instead of exercising retry behavior

  try {
    let calls = 0;
    axios.get = async () => {
      calls += 1;
      if (calls === 1) throw httpError(500, { detail: 'temporary status failure' });
      return { data: { status: 'complete', url: 'https://example.test/final.mp4' } };
    };

    assert.equal(
      await compiler.pollFFmpegJob('transient-job'),
      'https://example.test/final.mp4'
    );
    assert.equal(calls, 2, 'one transient 500 should be retried');

    calls = 0;
    axios.get = async () => {
      calls += 1;
      throw httpError(500, { detail: 'persistent status failure' });
    };
    await assert.rejects(
      compiler.pollFFmpegJob('persistent-job'),
      error => {
        assert.match(error.message, /HTTP 500:.*persistent status failure/);
        assert.match(error.message, /3 consecutive times/);
        assert.doesNotMatch(error.message, /must-not-appear-in-errors/);
        return true;
      }
    );
    assert.equal(calls, 3, 'persistent server failures must stop after three consecutive polls');

    calls = 0;
    axios.get = async () => {
      calls += 1;
      throw httpError(404, { detail: 'job not found' });
    };
    await assert.rejects(
      compiler.pollFFmpegJob('missing-job'),
      /HTTP 404.*job not found/
    );
    assert.equal(calls, 1, 'client errors should fail fast instead of being retried');
  } finally {
    axios.get = originalGet;
    config.ffmpegPollIntervalMs = originalInterval;
    config.ffmpegMaxPollAttempts = originalMaxAttempts;
    config.ffmpegApiKey = originalApiKey;
  }
});

  const scene1 = {
    scene_number: 1, location: 'Apartment',
    shots: [{ scene_number: 1, shot_index: 1, characters_in_shot: ['Mara'], start_state: 'Mara stands in the apartment with the keys.', end_state: 'Mara reaches the car door outside.' }],

      { scene_number: 2, shot_index: 3, characters_in_shot: ['Mara'] },
    ],
  };
  const simulation = orchestrator.applyToShotSimulation({ shots: [...scene1.shots, ...scene2.shots] }, [scene1, scene2], { season: 1, episode: 1 });

  assert.ok(violations.some(v => v.type === 'directorial_state' && v.severity === 'high'), 'expected contradictory travel state to be rejected');
});

'use strict';
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('http');

function bootApp(dbMock) {
  Object.assign(process.env, { SESSION_SECRET: 'test-secret-123' });
  for (const k of Object.keys(require.cache)) if (/proj[\\/](index\.js|src)/.test(k) || /theirs[\\/](index\.js|src)/.test(k)) delete require.cache[k];
  const db = require('../src/db');
  Object.assign(db, dbMock);
  const { app } = require('../index.js');
  return http.createServer(app);
}
function get(server, path) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const port = server.address().port;
      require('http').get(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${path}`, res => {
        let body = ''; res.on('data', c => body += c);
        res.on('end', () => { server.close(); resolve(JSON.parse(body)); });
      }).on('error', err => { server.close(); reject(err); });
    });
  });
}

test('/api/drafts: no query that includes scene_state also has an ORDER BY (the exact pattern that caused "Out of sort memory")', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const server = bootApp({
    query: async (sql, params) => {
      calls.push(sql);
      if (/FROM episodes e WHERE e\.status = 'draft' ORDER BY/.test(sql)) return [{ id: 'ep-2' }, { id: 'ep-1' }];
      if (/scene_state/.test(sql)) {
        assert.doesNotMatch(sql, /ORDER BY/, 'a query selecting scene_state must never also ORDER BY');
        // returned deliberately OUT of order, to prove the JS re-sort (not SQL) establishes the final order
        return [
          { id: 'ep-1', episode_number: 1, season_number: 1, paused_reason: null, created_at: new Date('2026-01-01'), scene_state: '{}', scene_count: 2, shot_count: 4, show_title: 'Show', genre: 'drama' },
          { id: 'ep-2', episode_number: 2, season_number: 1, paused_reason: 'x', created_at: new Date('2026-01-02'), scene_state: '{"1":true}', scene_count: 2, shot_count: 4, show_title: 'Show', genre: 'drama' },
        ];
      }
      if (/FROM shots WHERE episode_id IN/.test(sql)) return [];
      throw new Error('unexpected query: ' + sql);
    },
  });
  const body = await get(server, '/api/drafts');
  assert.equal(body.ok, true);
  assert.deepEqual(body.drafts.map(d => d.id), ['ep-2', 'ep-1'], 'output order must match the narrow id-query order, not the hydration query\'s row order');
  assert.match(calls.find(c => /FROM episodes e WHERE e\.status = 'draft' ORDER BY/.test(c)), /LIMIT 100/, 'the previously-missing LIMIT must now be present');
});

test('/api/drafts: no draft episodes returns an empty list without attempting a hydration query at all', async () => {
  let hydrationCalled = false;
  const server = bootApp({ query: async (sql) => { if (/scene_state/.test(sql)) hydrationCalled = true; return []; } });
  const body = await get(server, '/api/drafts');
  assert.deepEqual(body.drafts, []);
  assert.equal(hydrationCalled, false);
});

test('/api/drafts/shots: no query selects last_prompt with an ORDER BY, and final shot ordering matches (scene_number, shot_index) even when the DB returns rows scrambled', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const server = bootApp({
    queryOne: async (sql, params) => {
      calls.push(sql);
      if (/FROM episodes e WHERE e\.status = 'draft' ORDER BY/.test(sql)) { assert.doesNotMatch(sql, /scene_state/); return { id: 'ep-1' }; }
      if (/WHERE e\.id = \?/.test(sql)) return { id: 'ep-1', episode_number: 1, season_number: 1, scene_state: '{"2":"url-a"}', show_title: 'Show', genre: 'drama' };
      throw new Error('unexpected queryOne: ' + sql);
    },
    query: async (sql, params) => {
      calls.push(sql);
      assert.doesNotMatch(sql, /ORDER BY/, 'the shots query must never sort last_prompt in SQL');
      return [
        { scene_number: 2, shot_index: 2, status: 'done', clip_url: 'c22', clip_duration: 5, image_url: null, last_error: null, last_prompt: 'p', failure_reason: null, enabled: 1, trim_start: null, trim_end: null, editorial_url: null, edit_revision: 0 },
        { scene_number: 1, shot_index: 2, status: 'done', clip_url: 'c12', clip_duration: 5, image_url: null, last_error: null, last_prompt: 'p', failure_reason: null, enabled: 1, trim_start: null, trim_end: null, editorial_url: null, edit_revision: 0 },
        { scene_number: 1, shot_index: 1, status: 'done', clip_url: 'c11', clip_duration: 5, image_url: null, last_error: null, last_prompt: 'p', failure_reason: null, enabled: 1, trim_start: null, trim_end: null, editorial_url: null, edit_revision: 0 },
      ];
    },
  });
  const body = await get(server, '/api/drafts/shots');
  assert.equal(body.ok, true);
  assert.deepEqual(body.scenes.map(s => s.sceneNumber), [1, 2]);
  assert.deepEqual(body.scenes[0].shots.map(s => s.shotIndex), [1, 2], 'shots within a scene must stay in shot_index order despite the DB returning them scrambled');
  assert.equal(body.scenes[1].compiledUrl, 'url-a');
});

'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const auth = require('../src/auth');

const dashboard = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../views/dashboard.html'), 'utf8');
const server = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '../index.js'), 'utf8');

test('Episodes list and editor buttons use the shared admin-authenticated publish flow', () => {
  assert.match(dashboard, /data-publish-episode="\$\{esc\(ep\.id\)\}"/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /id="episodePublishBtn"/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /episodePublishBtn\?\.addEventListener\('click'/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /episodesBody'\)\?\.addEventListener\('click'/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /function publishEpisode\(episodeId\)\s*\{\s*beginEpisodePublish/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /async function publishEditedEpisode\(\)[\s\S]*?beginEpisodePublish/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /function beginEpisodePublish\([\s\S]*?requireAdminAccess\(async[\s\S]*?adminFetch\([\s\S]*?\/publish/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /window\.publishEpisode = publishEpisode/);
  assert.match(dashboard, /window\.publishEditedEpisode = publishEditedEpisode/);
});

test('episode publish API requires an admin token', () => {
  assert.match(
    server,
    /app\.post\('\/api\/episodes\/:id\/publish',\s*auth\.requireAdmin,\s*async/
  );

  const response = {
    statusCode: null,
    body: null,
    status(code) { this.statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(body) { this.body = body; return this; },
  };
  let continued = false;
  auth.requireAdmin({ headers: {} }, response, () => { continued = true; });
  assert.equal(response.statusCode, 401);
  assert.equal(response.body.ok, false);
  assert.equal(continued, false);

  const adminResponse = {
    statusCode: null,
    status(code) { this.statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(body) { this.body = body; return this; },
  };
  const token = auth.createAdminSessionToken();
  const request = { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } };
  auth.requireAdmin(request, adminResponse, () => { continued = true; });
  assert.equal(continued, true);
  assert.equal(request.admin.role, 'admin');
});

test('episode scene location defaults do not reference the scene while it is initializing', () => {
  const rawSceneStart = scriptWriter.indexOf('const rawScene = result?.scene');
  const sceneStart = scriptWriter.indexOf('const scene = {', rawSceneStart);

    acts: [{ id: 'beginning', share: 0.2, summary: 's' }, { id: 'development', share: 0.25, summary: 's' }, { id: 'escalation', share: 0.25, summary: 's' }, { id: 'climax', share: 0.15, summary: 's' }, { id: 'resolution', share: 0.15, summary: 's' }],
    characters: [{ key: 'K', name: 'K', role: 'protagonist' }], locations: [{ key: 'L', name: 'L' }],
    ending: { type: 'emotional', resolves_threat: true, resolves_mystery: true, threat_outcome: 'destroyed', mystery_answer_shown: 'x', aftermath: 'things calm down and the crew walks out into daylight together', final_image: 'a calm street' } };
  const q = validateFilmBible(bible, { runtimeRange: { min: 900, max: null } });
  assert.ok(q.valid, `a very long duration must not be rejected when max is unbounded: ${q.errors.join('; ')}`);
  assert.ok(validateFilmBible({ ...bible, runtime_target: 899 }, { runtimeRange: { min: 900, max: null } }).errors.some(e => /must be >= 900s/.test(e)), 'the floor must still be enforced');

test('FilmOrchestrator + finalize: a film with a 30-minute (1800s) nominal target runs end-to-end with an unbounded runtimeRange, and QC\'s runtime gate evaluates correctly rather than always-failing on a null ceiling', async () => {
  const d = tmp();
  const bible = await new MockStoryProvider().generate({ theme: 'a long night tests everyone', threat_type: 'entity', threat_seed: 'a spreading thing', threat_clock: 'by morning' }, { runtime: 1800 });
  bible.film_id = nextFilmId(d, bible.title);
  const o = new FilmOrchestrator({ dataDir: d, bible, providers: { image: new P.MockImageGenerationProvider(), video: new P.MockVideoGenerationProvider(), vision: new P.MockVisionProvider() }, options: { runtimeRange: { min: 100, max: null }, maxRefs: 6 } });
  await o.prepareAssets();
  const plan = o.plan();
  assert.ok(plan.shots.length > 0);
  const r = await o.run();
  assert.equal(r.status, 'shots_complete');
  const { finalizeFilm } = require('../src/film/finalize');
  const out = await finalizeFilm(o, { runtimeRange: { min: 100, max: null } });
  assert.ok(out.qc.gates.assembly.checks.some(c => c.name.startsWith('runtime >=')), 'the unbounded-range label should read as a floor-only check, not "within X-nulls"');
  const runtimeCheck = out.qc.gates.assembly.checks.find(c => c.name.startsWith('runtime >='));
  assert.equal(runtimeCheck.passed, true, `runtime gate must not always-fail when max is null: ${JSON.stringify(runtimeCheck)}`);

'use strict';
const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs'); const os = require('os'); const path = require('path');

function bin() { try { return require('@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg').path; } catch { return 'ffmpeg'; } }
function tmp() { return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'svtest-')); }

/** Synthetic clip: moving test pattern + 440 Hz tone. */
function makeClip(file, { w = 720, h = 1280, secs = 6, audio = true, acodec = 'aac' } = {}) {
  const args = ['-y', '-loglevel', 'error', '-f', 'lavfi', '-i', `testsrc2=size=${w}x${h}:rate=24`];
  if (audio) args.push('-f', 'lavfi', '-i', 'sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100');
  args.push('-t', String(secs), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p');
  if (audio) args.push('-c:a', acodec, '-shortest');
  args.push(file);
  const r = spawnSync(bin(), args);
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error('makeClip failed: ' + r.stderr);
  return file;
}
function audioMd5(file) {
  const r = spawnSync(bin(), ['-loglevel', 'error', '-i', file, '-map', '0:a', '-c', 'copy', '-f', 'md5', '-']);
  return r.stdout.toString().trim();
}
module.exports = { makeClip, audioMd5, tmp, bin };

'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const {
  _buildIntent,
  _resolveDialogueBeatsForIntent,
} = require('../src/ltxVisionDirector');

const CHARACTERS = [
  { name: 'Silas Reeves' },
  { name: 'Bank Witness' },
];

const BEATS = [
  { speaker: 'Silas Reeves', line: 'You do not have access to the records?' },
  { speaker: 'Bank Witness', line: 'I have access to my own files.' },
  { speaker: 'Silas Reeves', line: 'What about the March transfer?' },
  { speaker: 'Bank Witness', line: 'I cannot speak to the full history.' },
  { speaker: 'Silas Reeves', line: 'Do you recognize your signature?' },
  { speaker: 'Bank Witness', line: 'Yes.' },
];

test('LTX vision requires every authoritative dialogue turn, not only a stale dialogue_or_action quote', () => {
  const intent = _buildIntent({
    shot: {
      dialogue_or_action: '"You do not have access to the records?"',
      authoritativeDialogueBeats: BEATS,
      characters_in_shot: CHARACTERS.map(character => character.name),
    },
    scene: {},
  });

  const resolved = _resolveDialogueBeatsForIntent(intent, CHARACTERS);

  assert.equal(resolved.source, 'authoritative-dialogue-registry');
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolved.beats.map(({ speaker, line }) => ({ speaker, line })),
    BEATS
  );
});

test('complete explicit speaker labels override stale ownership while preserving the authoritative turn order', () => {
  const labelledDialogue = BEATS
    .map(({ speaker, line }) => `${speaker}: "${line}"`)
    .join('\n');
  const staleRegistry = BEATS.map(beat => ({
    ...beat,
    speaker: 'Silas Reeves',
  }));
  const intent = _buildIntent({
    shot: {
      dialogue_or_action: labelledDialogue,
      authoritativeDialogueBeats: staleRegistry,
      characters_in_shot: CHARACTERS.map(character => character.name),
    },
    scene: {},
  });

  const resolved = _resolveDialogueBeatsForIntent(intent, CHARACTERS);

  assert.equal(resolved.source, 'explicit-labelled-dialogue');
  assert.deepEqual(
    resolved.beats.map(({ speaker, line }) => ({ speaker, line })),
    BEATS
  );
});

const test = require('node:test');

const config = require('../src/config');
const { _compactSceneBeatPlan } = require('../src/scriptWriter');

test('computeExpectedSceneCount: preserves old fixed behaviour at the old default (20min movie -> 20 scenes)', () => {
  assert.equal(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: true, targetMinutes: 20 }), 20);
});
test('computeExpectedSceneCount: scales for longer movies instead of a flat ceiling', () => {
  assert.equal(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: true, targetMinutes: 30 }), 30);
  assert.equal(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: true, targetMinutes: 45 }), 45);
  assert.ok(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: true, targetMinutes: 60 }) > config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: true, targetMinutes: 45 }));
});
test('computeExpectedSceneCount: regular short episodes unchanged at existing tiers', () => {
  assert.equal(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: false, targetMinutes: 2 }), 8);
  assert.equal(config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: false, targetMinutes: 5 }), 10);
});
test('computeExpectedSceneCount: episodes over 5 minutes scale instead of flatlining at 12', () => {
  const at6 = config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: false, targetMinutes: 6 });
  const at20 = config.computeExpectedSceneCount({ isSeriesMovie: false, targetMinutes: 20 });
  assert.ok(at20 > at6, `expected scene count to grow with runtime, got ${at6} then ${at20}`);
});
test('movieMinSeconds default is 1800s (30 minutes), not the old 1200s (20 minutes) ceiling', () => {
  assert.equal(config.movieMinSeconds, 1800);
});

test('_compactSceneBeatPlan: EVERY scene survives, including the ending, for a long (45-scene) film', () => {
  const scenes = Array.from({ length: 45 }, (_, i) => ({
    scene_number: i + 1, purpose: `purpose of scene ${i + 1} `.repeat(20), opening_state: 'x'.repeat(200),
    causal_event: 'y'.repeat(200), character_state_changes: ['a'.repeat(100)], environment_state_changes: ['b'.repeat(100)],
    dialogue_intent: 'z'.repeat(200), closing_state: 'w'.repeat(200), handoff_to_next_scene: 'v'.repeat(200),
  }));
  const compact = _compactSceneBeatPlan(scenes);
  assert.equal(compact.length, 45, 'no scene should be dropped, regardless of story length');
  assert.equal(compact[compact.length - 1].scene_number, 45, 'the final scene (the ending) must be present');
  const rawSize = JSON.stringify(scenes).length;
  const compactSize = JSON.stringify(compact).length;
  assert.ok(compactSize < rawSize * 0.5, `expected substantial compaction, raw=${rawSize} compact=${compactSize}`);
});
test('_compactSceneBeatPlan: a short plan is not over-compacted (full detail kept when it already fits)', () => {
  const scenes = [{ scene_number: 1, purpose: 'a short purpose', opening_state: 'calm', causal_event: 'a small thing happens', closing_state: 'tense', handoff_to_next_scene: 'walks off' }];
  const compact = _compactSceneBeatPlan(scenes);
  assert.equal(compact[0].purpose, 'a short purpose', 'short text should not be truncated when the budget is not a constraint');
});
test('_compactSceneBeatPlan: empty/missing plan returns empty array, never throws', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(_compactSceneBeatPlan(null), []);
  assert.deepEqual(_compactSceneBeatPlan([]), []);
  assert.deepEqual(_compactSceneBeatPlan(undefined), []);
});

'use strict';
// Full path: HTTP download (stand-in for the FFmpeg service URL) -> brand -> chunked upload to a mock Cloudinary.
const test = require('node:test'); const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path');
const { makeClip, tmp, bin } = require('./helpers');
const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');

test('publishBrandedMaster end-to-end over HTTP with chunked upload; download -> brand -> chunked upload completes (2 requests)', async () => {
  const d = tmp(); const src = makeClip(path.join(d, 'master.mp4'), { secs: 20 });
  const fileSrv = http.createServer((q, s) => fs.createReadStream(src).pipe(s));
  await new Promise(r => fileSrv.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  const got = []; let cloudBody = null;
  const cloud = http.createServer((q, s) => {
    const c = []; q.on('data', x => c.push(x)); q.on('end', () => {
      got.push({ range: q.headers['content-range'], n: Buffer.concat(c).length });
      const m = /-(\d+)\/(\d+)$/.exec(q.headers['content-range'] || '');
      s.end(JSON.stringify(!m || Number(m[1]) + 1 === Number(m[2]) ? { secure_url: 'https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/video/upload/ep.mp4' } : {}));
    });
  });
  await new Promise(r => cloud.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
  Object.assign(process.env, { CLOUDINARY_API_BASE: `http://127.0.0.1:${cloud.address().port}`, CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME: 'demo', CLOUDINARY_API_KEY: 'k', CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET: 's',
    CLOUDINARY_SINGLE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES: '1000', CLOUDINARY_CHUNK_BYTES: String(5 * 1024 * 1024) });
  for (const k of Object.keys(require.cache)) if (/src[\\/](cloudinary|config|configCore|branding)\.js$/.test(k)) delete require.cache[k];
  const branding = require('../src/branding');
  const url = await branding.publishBrandedMaster(`http://127.0.0.1:${fileSrv.address().port}/master.mp4`, 'streamverse/ep0001', { cfg: { ...branding.settings({}), tmpDir: d } });
  fileSrv.close(); cloud.close();
  assert.match(url, /cloudinary/); assert.ok(got.length >= 1);
  assert.ok(got.every(g => g.range || got.length === 1));
});

'use strict';
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair, _validateShotSimulationSpeech } = require('../src/scriptWriter');

const CHARACTERS = [{ name: 'Mara' }, { name: 'Dev' }];
const SCENE = { scene_number: 6, characters_present: ['Mara', 'Dev'] };

// Reproduces the exact reported crash: S6/2, dialogue_intent=spoken, two visible
// characters, model returned an empty speaker, and dialogue_purpose doesn't name
// either of them -- so deterministic inference genuinely cannot resolve it alone.
const AMBIGUOUS_SHOT = () => ({
  scene_number: 6, shot_index: 2, dialogue_intent: 'spoken', speaker: '',
  dialogue_purpose: 'A tense exchange about the missing keys.',
  characters_in_shot: ['Mara', 'Dev'],
});

test('reproduces the exact reported crash: _validateShotSimulationSpeech alone cannot resolve an ambiguous two-character shot', () => {
  const result = _validateShotSimulationSpeech(AMBIGUOUS_SHOT(), SCENE, CHARACTERS);
  assert.equal(result.valid, false);
  assert.match(result.reason, /dialogue_intent=spoken requires a named speaker/);
  assert.match(result.reason, /cannot be deterministically resolved/);
});

test('_resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair: resolves the ambiguous shot via a targeted LLM repair call instead of crashing', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const callLLM = async (system, user) => {
    calls.push({ system, user });
    return { speaker_name: 'Dev' };
  };
  const resolved = await _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair(AMBIGUOUS_SHOT(), SCENE, CHARACTERS, {
    sceneNo: 6, shotIndex: 2, callLLM,
  });
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1, 'expected exactly one small, targeted repair call');
  assert.match(calls[0].user, /FULL CAST: \["Mara","Dev"\]/);
  assert.match(calls[0].user, /A tense exchange about the missing keys\./);
  assert.equal(resolved.speaker, 'Dev');
  assert.equal(resolved.speaker_name, 'Dev');
});

test('_resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair: a hallucinated name (not in cast) is rejected and retried, not silently accepted', async () => {
  let call = 0;
  const callLLM = async () => {
    call += 1;
    return call === 1 ? { speaker_name: 'Zorblax' } : { speaker_name: 'Mara' };
  };
  const resolved = await _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair(AMBIGUOUS_SHOT(), SCENE, CHARACTERS, {
    sceneNo: 6, shotIndex: 2, callLLM, maxAttempts: 3,
  });
  assert.equal(call, 2, 'the hallucinated name must not be accepted on the first attempt');
  assert.equal(resolved.speaker, 'Mara');
});

test('_resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair: still throws SHOT_SIMULATION_SPEAKER_REQUIRED (not silently swallowed) if every repair attempt fails', async () => {
  const callLLM = async () => ({ speaker_name: '' });
  await assert.rejects(
    _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair(AMBIGUOUS_SHOT(), SCENE, CHARACTERS, { sceneNo: 6, shotIndex: 2, callLLM, maxAttempts: 2 }),
    /SHOT_SIMULATION_SPEAKER_REQUIRED S6\/2.*unresolved after 2 repair attempts/
  );
});

test('_resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair: an UNambiguous single-character shot needs no repair call at all', async () => {
  let called = false;
  const callLLM = async () => { called = true; return { speaker_name: 'Mara' }; };
  const shot = { scene_number: 6, shot_index: 1, dialogue_intent: 'spoken', speaker: '', dialogue_purpose: 'greets warmly', characters_in_shot: ['Mara'] };
  const resolved = await _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair(shot, SCENE, CHARACTERS, { sceneNo: 6, shotIndex: 1, callLLM });
  assert.equal(called, false, 'deterministic single-character inference should resolve this without any LLM call');
  assert.equal(resolved.speaker, 'Mara');
});

test('_resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair: a non-audible shot (ambient/action) is returned untouched, no repair attempted', async () => {
  let called = false;
  const callLLM = async () => { called = true; return {}; };
  const shot = { scene_number: 6, shot_index: 3, dialogue_intent: 'ambient', speaker: '', characters_in_shot: ['Mara', 'Dev'] };
  const resolved = await _resolveShotSpeakerWithRepair(shot, SCENE, CHARACTERS, { sceneNo: 6, shotIndex: 3, callLLM });
  assert.equal(called, false);
  assert.deepEqual(resolved, shot);
});
