  function adminHeaders() {
    return _adminToken ? { 'Content-Type':'application/json', Authorization:`Bearer ${_adminToken}` } : { 'Content-Type':'application/json' };
  }
  function requireAdminAccess(next) {
    if (_adminToken) return next();
    document.getElementById('adminLoginModal').classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('adminPassword').focus();
    window._afterAdminLogin = next;
  }
  async function adminLogin() {
    const errEl=document.getElementById('adminLoginError'); errEl.style.display='none';
    try {
      const r=await fetch('/api/admin/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({password:document.getElementById('adminPassword').value})});
      const d=await r.json(); if(!r.ok||!d.ok) throw new Error(d.error||'Admin login failed');
      _adminToken=d.token; localStorage.setItem('sv_admin_token',_adminToken); document.getElementById('adminPassword').value=''; closeAdminLogin();
      const next=window._afterAdminLogin; window._afterAdminLogin=null; if(next) next();
    } catch(e){errEl.textContent=e.message;errEl.style.display='block';}
  }
  function closeAdminLogin(){document.getElementById('adminLoginModal').classList.remove('open');}
  function invalidateAdmin(){_adminToken='';localStorage.removeItem('sv_admin_token');requireAdminAccess(()=>switchTab(_activeTab));}
  async function adminFetch(url, options={}) {
    const r=await fetch(url,{...options,headers:{...adminHeaders(),...(options.headers||{})}});
    if(r.status===401){invalidateAdmin();throw new Error('Admin session expired');}
    const d=await r.json().catch(()=>({})); if(!r.ok||d.ok===false) throw new Error(d.error||`Request failed (${r.status})`); return d;
  }

'—'}</td><td>${esc(cp.status)}</td><td>${esc(cp.created_at || '')}</td><td><button class="shot-fail-btn" onclick="rollbackCheckpoint('${cp.id}')">Rollback here</button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:20px;text-align:center">No checkpoints.</td></tr>';

    if (!confirm('Rollback to this checkpoint? Downstream production artifacts will be removed.')) return;

      const d = await adminFetch('/api/checkpoints/rollback', {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({checkpoint_id:id})});

  function switchTab(tab) {
    _activeTab = tab;
    const panels=['control','episodes','analytics','users','announcements','checkpoints'];
    for(const name of panels){const panel=document.getElementById(`tabPanel${name[0].toUpperCase()+name.slice(1)}`); if(panel) panel.style.display=name===tab?'':'none';}
    const activeStyle='background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:none;color:var(--text);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer';
    const inactiveStyle='background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer';
    for(const name of panels){const btn=document.getElementById(`tabBtn${name[0].toUpperCase()+name.slice(1)}`);if(btn)btn.style.cssText=name===tab?activeStyle:inactiveStyle;}
    if(tab==='episodes') loadEpisodesTab();
    if(tab==='checkpoints') loadCheckpointEpisodes();
    if(['analytics','users','announcements'].includes(tab)) requireAdminAccess(()=>{ if(tab==='analytics')loadAnalytics(); if(tab==='users')loadUsers(); if(tab==='announcements')loadAnnouncements(); });
  }


  // ── Episodes tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function loadEpisodesTab() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('episodesBody');
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/episodes');
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!d.ok) throw new Error(d.error);
      renderEpisodesTab(d.episodes || []);
    } catch (e) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--danger);text-align:center;padding:20px">Failed to load: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
    }
  }

  function renderEpisodesTab(episodes) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('episodesBody');
    if (!episodes.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:20px">No episodes yet</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const ep of episodes) {
      const key = ep.showId || ep.showTitle || 'Unknown Show';
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, { title: ep.showTitle || key, genre: ep.genre || '', episodes: [] });
      groups.get(key).episodes.push(ep);
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = [...groups.values()].map((g, gi) => `
      <tr><td colspan="6" style="padding:16px 10px 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)">
        <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700">${esc(g.title)}</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px">${esc(g.genre)}</div>
      </td></tr>
      ${g.episodes.map((ep, i) => `
      <tr id="ep-row-${esc(ep.id)}">
        <td style="color:var(--muted)">${i + 1}</td>
        <td><div style="font-weight:600">Season ${ep.seasonNumber} · Episode ${ep.episodeNumber}</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">${esc(ep.title)}</div></td>
        <td><span class="pill ${ep.status === 'posted' ? '' : 'idle'}" style="font-size:11px;padding:2px 9px">${esc(ep.status)}</span></td>
        <td style="color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap">${ep.shotsDone}/${ep.shotsTotal} video · ${ep.shotsWithImage}/${ep.shotsTotal} image</td>
        <td>${ep.videoUrl ? `<a href="${esc(ep.videoUrl)}" target="_blank" class="lnk">View ↗</a>` : '<span style="color:var(--muted)">—</span>'}</td>
        <td style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <button onclick="openEpisodeEditor('${esc(ep.id)}')" style="background:rgba(8,145,178,.12);color:#67e8f9;border:1px solid rgba(8,145,178,.35);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer">✎ Edit Episode</button>
          <button onclick="regenerateEpisodeVideos('${esc(ep.id)}')" id="ep-regen-btn-${esc(ep.id)}" style="background:rgba(245,158,11,.1);color:var(--warning);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.3);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer" title="Regenerate video only from saved stills">🔁 Regen Videos</button>
          ${ep.status === 'ready' && ep.videoUrl ? `<button type="button" data-publish-episode="${esc(ep.id)}" id="ep-publish-btn-${esc(ep.id)}" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:#86efac;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.35);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600" title="Publish this reviewed episode">🚀 Publish Episode</button>` : ''}
        </td>
      </tr>`).join('')}`).join('');
  }

  async function regenerateEpisodeVideos(episodeId) {
    if (!confirm('This will purge every compiled clip for this episode and re-render all videos from the existing shot images (no CF Worker calls). Continue?')) return;
    const btn = document.getElementById(`ep-regen-btn-${episodeId}`);
    const originalLabel = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Regenerating…'; }
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/episodes/${episodeId}/regenerate-videos`, { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (d.ok) {
        alert(`Done — ${d.successes}/${d.totalShots} shot video(s) regenerated${d.skipped ? `, ${d.skipped} skipped (no saved image)` : ''}.`);
      } else {
        alert(`Regeneration stopped: ${d.error}`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert(`Request failed: ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = originalLabel; }
      loadEpisodesTab();
    }
  }


  function fmtSeconds(s){s=Math.max(0,Math.round(Number(s)||0));const h=Math.floor(s/3600),m=Math.floor((s%3600)/60),sec=s%60;return h?`${h}h ${m}m`:m?`${m}m ${sec}s`:`${sec}s`;}
  function flagEmoji(code){if(!code||!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(code))return '🌐';return String.fromCodePoint(...code.split('').map(c=>127397+c.charCodeAt(0)));}

  function goToAnalyticsRequestPage(page) {
    _analyticsRequestPage = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
    loadAnalytics();
  }

  function renderAnalyticsRequestPagination(pagination) {
    const el = document.getElementById('analyticsRequestsPagination');
    if (!el) return;

    const current = Math.max(1, Number(pagination?.page || 1));
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Number(pagination?.totalPages || 1));
    const total = Math.max(0, Number(pagination?.total || 0));
    _analyticsRequestPage = current;

    if (totalPages <= 1) {
      el.innerHTML = total ? `<span class="muted-mini">${total.toLocaleString()} request${total === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>` : '';
      return;
    }

    const pages = new Set([1, totalPages, current - 1, current, current + 1]);
    const ordered = [...pages].filter(p => p >= 1 && p <= totalPages).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const controls = [
      `<button class="analytics-page-btn" ${current === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="goToAnalyticsRequestPage(${current - 1})">‹</button>`,
    ];
    let previous = 0;
    for (const page of ordered) {
      if (previous && page - previous > 1) controls.push('<span class="muted-mini" style="padding:0 3px">…</span>');
      controls.push(`<button class="analytics-page-btn ${page === current ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="goToAnalyticsRequestPage(${page})">${page}</button>`);
      previous = page;
    }
    controls.push(`<button class="analytics-page-btn" ${current === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="goToAnalyticsRequestPage(${current + 1})">›</button>`);
    controls.push(`<span class="muted-mini" style="margin-left:6px">${total.toLocaleString()} total</span>`);
    el.innerHTML = controls.join('');
  }

  async function loadAnalytics(resetRequestPage = false){
    if (resetRequestPage) _analyticsRequestPage = 1;
    requireAdminAccess(async()=>{
      try{
        const days=document.getElementById('analyticsDays').value;

  async function loadUsers(){
    try{const d=await adminFetch('/api/admin/users');document.getElementById('usersBody').innerHTML=(d.users||[]).map(u=>`<tr><td><strong>${esc(u.email)}</strong><div class="muted-mini">${esc(u.id)}</div></td><td>${esc(u.display_name||'—')}</td><td><span class="pill-mini ${u.email_verified?'pill-green':'pill-red'}">${u.email_verified?'Verified':'Unverified'}</span></td><td><span class="pill-mini ${u.is_active?'pill-green':'pill-red'}">${u.is_active?'Active':'Disabled'}</span></td><td>${fmtDate(u.created_at)}</td><td>${fmtDate(u.last_login_at)}</td><td>${Number(u.favorite_count||0)}</td><td>${Number(u.video_starts||0)}</td><td><button class="refresh-btn" onclick='openEditUser(${JSON.stringify({id:u.id,email:u.email,displayName:u.display_name||'',emailVerified:!!u.email_verified,isActive:!!u.is_active}).replace(/'/g,"&#39;")})'>✎ Edit</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="9" class="muted-mini" style="text-align:center;padding:18px">No users yet.</td></tr>';}catch(e){document.getElementById('usersBody').innerHTML=`<tr><td colspan="9" style="color:var(--danger);text-align:center;padding:18px">${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;}
  }
  function openCreateUser(){_editingUserId=null;document.getElementById('userModalTitle').textContent='Create User';document.getElementById('userModalEmail').disabled=false;document.getElementById('userModalEmail').value='';document.getElementById('userModalName').value='';document.getElementById('userModalPassword').value='';document.getElementById('userModalVerified').checked=true;document.getElementById('userModalActiveWrap').style.display='none';document.getElementById('userModal').style.display='flex';}
  function openEditUser(u){_editingUserId=u.id;document.getElementById('userModalTitle').textContent='Edit User';document.getElementById('userModalEmail').disabled=true;document.getElementById('userModalEmail').value=u.email;document.getElementById('userModalName').value=u.displayName;document.getElementById('userModalPassword').value='';document.getElementById('userModalVerified').checked=u.emailVerified;document.getElementById('userModalActive').checked=u.isActive;document.getElementById('userModalActiveWrap').style.display='flex';document.getElementById('userModal').style.display='flex';}
  function closeUserModal(){document.getElementById('userModal').style.display='none';}
  async function saveUserModal(){try{const payload={displayName:document.getElementById('userModalName').value,emailVerified:document.getElementById('userModalVerified').checked};const email=document.getElementById('userModalEmail').value.trim();const pw=document.getElementById('userModalPassword').value;if(!_editingUserId){payload.email=email;payload.password=pw;}else{payload.isActive=document.getElementById('userModalActive').checked;if(pw)payload.password=pw;}const d=await adminFetch(_editingUserId?`/api/admin/users/${encodeURIComponent(_editingUserId)}`:'/api/admin/users',{method:_editingUserId?'PUT':'POST',body:JSON.stringify(payload)});if(!d.ok)throw new Error(d.error||'User save failed');closeUserModal();loadUsers();}catch(e){document.getElementById('userModalError').textContent=e.message;document.getElementById('userModalError').style.display='block';}}

  async function deleteAnnouncement(id){if(!confirm('Delete this announcement? This cannot be undone.'))return;try{await adminFetch(`/api/admin/announcements/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,{method:'DELETE'});loadAnnouncements();}catch(e){alert(e.message);}}
  async function sendAnnouncement(){const title=document.getElementById('announcementTitle').value.trim(),body=document.getElementById('announcementBody').value.trim();if(!title||!body)return alert('Enter a title and message.');try{await adminFetch('/api/admin/announcements',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({title,body,publish:true})});document.getElementById('announcementTitle').value='';document.getElementById('announcementBody').value='';alert('Announcement published.');loadAnnouncements();}catch(e){alert(e.message);}}
